````html
              <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M8 5H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v12a2 2 0 002 2h10a2 2 0 002-2v-1M8 5a2 2 0 002 2h2a2 2 0 002-2M8 5a2 2 0 012-2h2a2 2 0 012 2m0 0h2a2 2 0 012 2v3m2 4H10m0 0l3-3m-3 3l3 3"/>
            </svg>
            Copiar
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="grid gap-6 lg:grid-cols-[1.2fr_0.8fr]">
    <!-- Lista de Contactos -->
    <div class="space-y-4">
      <div class="atp-panel p-4">
        <div class="relative">
          <svg class="absolute left-4 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor">
            <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M21 21l-6-6m2-5a7 7 0 11-14 0 7 7 0 0114 0z"/>
          </svg>
          <input
            class="input input-bordered w-full pl-11 border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 focus:bg-white"
            placeholder="Buscar jugador..."
            [(ngModel)]="searchTerm"
          />
        </div>
        <p class="mt-2 text-xs text-slate-500">{{ contacts.length }} contactos&nbsp;&middot;&nbsp;{{ withOrdersCount }} con pedidos</p>
      </div>

      <div class="space-y-3">
        <button
          *ngFor="let contact of sortedContacts"
          (click)="selectContact(contact)"
          class="atp-card flex w-full items-center justify-between p-4 text-left hover-lift"
          [class.border-atp-teal]="selectedId === contact.id"
          [class.border-2]="selectedId === contact.id"
        >
          <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div class="flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-gradient-to-br from-atp-blue to-atp-navy text-white font-semibold text-sm">
              {{ (contact.name || '?').charAt(0) }}{{ contact.lastName ? contact.lastName.charAt(0) : '' }}
            </div>
            <div>
              <div class="text-sm font-semibold">{{ contact.name }} {{ contact.lastName }}</div>
              <div class="text-xs text-slate-500">
                <span *ngIf="contact.phone">{{ contact.phone }}</span>
                <span *ngIf="!contact.phone && contact.username">@{{ contact.username }}</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span *ngIf="contact.hasTournament" class="badge bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 text-xs">Asignado</span>
          </div>
        </button>

        <div *ngIf="sortedContacts.length === 0" class="empty-state">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor">
            <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="1.5" d="M17 20h5v-2a3 3 0 00-5.356-1.857M17 14H5v2a3 3 0 005.356 1.857M7 10v5a3 3 0 003 3h2a3 3 0 003-3v-5"/>
          </svg>
          <p class="empty-state-title">Sin resultados</p>
          <p class="empty-state-description">Crea un nuevo contacto desde el panel lateral.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Panel lateral: alta / edición -->
    <aside class="atp-panel animate-rise p-5 space-y-4">
      <h2 class="text-lg font-semibold text-atp-navy">
        <span *ngIf="isNewMode">Nuevo contacto</span>
        <span *ngIf="!isNewMode && isEditing">Editar contacto</span>
        <span *ngIf="!isNewMode && !isEditing && selectedContact">Ficha del contacto</span>
        <span *ngIf="!isNewMode && !isEditing && !selectedContact">Selecciona un contacto</span>
      </h2>

      <div *ngIf="!isNewMode && !isEditing && selectedContact as contact" class="space-y-3 text-sm">
        <div class="rounded-xl bg-slate-50 p-3">
          <div class="text-slate-500 text-xs">Usuario</div>
          <div class="font-medium">@{{ contact.username }}</div>
        </div>
        <div class="rounded-xl bg-slate-50 p-3">
          <div class="text-slate-500 text-xs">Email</div>
          <div class="font-medium">{{ contact.email || '-' }}</div>
        </div>
        <div class="rounded-xl bg-slate-50 p-3">
          <div class="text-slate-500 text-xs">Tel&eacute;fono</div>
          <div class="font-medium">{{ contact.phone || '-' }}</div>
        </div>
        <div class="flex gap-2 pt-2">
          <button class="btn btn-sm btn-primary rounded-full" (click)="startEdit(contact)">Editar</button>
          <button class="btn btn-sm btn-error rounded-full" (click)="confirmDelete(contact)">Eliminar</button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <form *ngIf="isNewMode || isEditing" (submit)="$event.preventDefault(); saveContact()" class="space-y-3">
        <div *ngIf="isNewMode && !selectedTournamentId" class="rounded-xl bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 text-amber-700 p-3 text-xs">
          Selecciona un torneo en el desplegable superior para asignar el contacto.
        </div>
        <div>
          <label class="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-600 mb-1">Nombre *</label>
          <input [(ngModel)]="form.name" name="name" class="input input-bordered w-full" required minlength="3" />
        </div>
        <div>
          <label class="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-600 mb-1">Apellidos</label>
          <input [(ngModel)]="form.lastName" name="lastName" class="input input-bordered w-full" />
        </div>
        <div>
          <label class="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-600 mb-1">Email</label>
          <input type="email" [(ngModel)]="form.email" name="email" class="input input-bordered w-full" placeholder="opcional" />
        </div>
        <div>
          <label class="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-600 mb-1">Tel&eacute;fono</label>
          <input type="tel" [(ngModel)]="form.phone" name="phone" class="input input-bordered w-full" placeholder="34612345678" />
        </div>
        <div class="flex gap-2 pt-2">
          <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-ghost rounded-full" (click)="resetForm(); isNewMode = false">Cancelar</button>
          <button type="submit" class="btn btn-sm btn-primary rounded-full">
            {{ isNewMode ? 'Crear' : 'Guardar' }}
          </button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </aside>
  </div>

  <!-- Confirm Delete Dialog -->
  <div *ngIf="showDeleteConfirm" class="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center">
    <div class="absolute inset-0 bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-sm" (click)="cancelDelete()"></div>
    <div class="relative bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-2xl max-w-md w-full mx-4 p-6 animate-rise text-center">
      <div class="inline-flex items-center justify-center w-14 h-14 rounded-full bg-red-100 text-red-600 mb-3">
        <svg width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor">
          <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M19 7l-.867 12.142A2 2 0 0116.138 21H7.862a2 2 0 01-1.995-1.858L5 7m5 4v6m4-6v6m1-10V4a1 1 0 00-1-1h-4a1 1 0 00-1 1v3M4 7h16"/>
        </svg>
      </div>
      <h3 class="text-lg font-bold text-slate-800">Eliminar contacto</h3>
      <p class="text-sm text-slate-500 mt-2">
        &iquest;Eliminar a <strong>{{ contactToDelete?.name }}</strong>? Esta acci&oacute;n no se puede deshacer.
      </p>
      <div class="flex gap-3 justify-center mt-6">
        <button class="btn btn-ghost rounded-full" (click)="cancelDelete()">Cancelar</button>
        <button class="btn btn-error rounded-full" (click)="executeDelete()">Eliminar</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
````

````typescript
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { Component, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms';
import { Router } from '@angular/router';
import { ToastService } from '../components/toast-notification/toast.service';
import { AuthService } from '../services/auth.service';
import { UsersService, ContactoRequestDto, UserProfile } from '../services/users.service';
import { TournamentsService, TournamentItem } from '../services/tournaments.service';

interface ContactHistory {
  id: string;
  status: 'pendiente' | 'completado';
  pedidoDate: string;
  requeridaDate: string;
  racket: string;
  total: number;
}

interface Contact {
  id: string;
  username: string;
  name: string;
  lastName: string;
  phone: string;
  email: string;
  notes: string;
  hasTournament: boolean;
  history: ContactHistory[];
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-contactos-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule, FormsModule],
  templateUrl: './contactos.page.html',
  styleUrl: './contactos.page.css'
})
export class ContactosPage implements OnInit {
  searchTerm = '';
  showDeleteConfirm = false;
  contactToDelete: Contact | null = null;

  sortBy: 'name' | 'recent' | 'orders' = 'name';
  searchFocused = false;
  isNewMode = false;

  private toast = new ToastService();

  contacts: Contact[] = [];
  tournaments: TournamentItem[] = [];
  selectedTournamentId = '';

  selectedId: string | null = null;
  isEditing = false;
  form = { name: '', lastName: '', phone: '', email: '', notes: '' };

  constructor(
    private router: Router,
    private usersService: UsersService,
    private tournamentsService: TournamentsService,
    private auth: AuthService
  ) {}

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.loadTournaments();
  }

  private loadTournaments(): void {
    this.tournamentsService.list({ page: 0, pageSize: 100, sortBy: 'name', direction: 'asc' }).subscribe({
      next: (page) => {
        this.tournaments = page.content;
        if (this.tournaments.length > 0 && !this.selectedTournamentId) {
          this.selectedTournamentId = this.tournaments[0].id;
        }
        this.loadContacts();
      },
      error: () => {
        this.toast.error('Error', 'No se pudieron cargar los torneos');
        this.loadContacts();
      }
    });
  }

  onTournamentChange(): void {
    this.loadContacts();
  }

  get selectedContact(): Contact | null {
    return this.contacts.find(c => c.id === this.selectedId) ?? null;
  }

  get filteredContacts(): Contact[] {
    const term = this.searchTerm.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!term) return this.contacts;
    return this.contacts.filter(c =>
      `${c.name} ${c.lastName} ${c.phone} ${c.email}`.toLowerCase().includes(term)
    );
  }

  get sortedContacts(): Contact[] {
    const filtered = [...this.filteredContacts];
    switch (this.sortBy) {
      case 'recent':
        return filtered.sort((a, b) => b.history.length - a.history.length);
      case 'orders':
        return filtered.sort((a, b) => b.history.length - a.history.length);
      case 'name':
      default:
        return filtered.sort((a, b) => {
          const nameA = `${a.name} ${a.lastName}`.toLowerCase();
          const nameB = `${b.name} ${b.lastName}`.toLowerCase();
          return nameA.localeCompare(nameB);
        });
    }
  }

  get withOrdersCount(): number {
    return this.contacts.filter(c => c.history.length > 0).length;
  }

  toggleNewMode(): void {
    this.isNewMode = !this.isNewMode;
    if (this.isNewMode) {
      this.resetForm();
      this.selectedId = null;
    }
  }

  onSearchKeydown(event: KeyboardEvent): void {
    if (event.key === 'ArrowDown' || event.key === 'ArrowUp') {
      event.preventDefault();
    }
  }

  selectContact(contact: Contact): void {
    this.selectedId = contact.id;
  }

  startEdit(contact: Contact): void {
    this.isEditing = true;
    this.selectedId = contact.id;
    this.form = {
      name: contact.name,
      lastName: contact.lastName,
      phone: contact.phone,
      email: contact.email,
      notes: contact.notes
    };
  }

  confirmDelete(contact: Contact): void {
    this.contactToDelete = contact;
    this.showDeleteConfirm = true;
  }

  cancelDelete(): void {
    this.showDeleteConfirm = false;
    this.contactToDelete = null;
  }

  executeDelete(): void {
    if (!this.contactToDelete) {
      this.cancelDelete();
      return;
    }
    const target = this.contactToDelete;
    this.usersService.delete(target.id).subscribe({
      next: () => {
        this.contacts = this.contacts.filter(c => c.id !== target.id);
        if (this.selectedId === target.id) {
          this.selectedId = this.contacts[0]?.id ?? null;
        }
        this.toast.success('Contacto eliminado', `${target.name} ha sido eliminado.`);
      },
      error: () => {
        this.toast.error('Error', 'No se pudo eliminar el contacto');
      }
    });
    this.cancelDelete();
  }

  deleteContact(contact: Contact): void {
    this.confirmDelete(contact);
  }

  saveContact(): void {
    if (this.isNewMode) {
      if (!this.selectedTournamentId) {
        this.toast.error('Torneo', 'Selecciona un torneo para crear el contacto');
        return;
      }
      const fullName = `${this.form.name} ${this.form.lastName}`.trim();
      const request: ContactoRequestDto = {
        name: fullName,
        email: this.form.email || undefined,
        phone: this.form.phone || undefined,
        tournamentId: this.selectedTournamentId
      };

      this.usersService.createContact(request).subscribe({
        next: (created) => {
          this.contacts.unshift({
            id: created.username,
            username: created.username,
            name: this.form.name,
            lastName: this.form.lastName,
            phone: this.form.phone,
            email: this.form.email,
            notes: this.form.notes,
            hasTournament: true,
            history: []
          });
          this.isNewMode = false;
          this.resetForm();
          this.toast.success('Contacto creado', `${created.name} ha sido añadido como contacto.`);
        },
        error: () => {
          this.toast.error('Error', 'No se pudo crear el contacto');
        }
      });
    } else if (this.isEditing && this.selectedContact) {
      const id = this.selectedContact.id;
      this.usersService.update(id, {
        name: `${this.form.name} ${this.form.lastName}`.trim() || undefined,
        telefono: this.form.phone || undefined,
        email: this.form.email || undefined
      }).subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Contacto actualizado', 'Los cambios han sido guardados.');
          this.isEditing = false;
          this.loadContacts();
        },
        error: () => this.toast.error('Error', 'No se pudo actualizar el contacto')
      });
    }
  }

  resetForm(): void {
    this.isEditing = false;
    this.form = { name: '', lastName: '', phone: '', email: '', notes: '' };
  }

  createNewOrder(): void {
    if (this.selectedContact) {
      this.router.navigate(['/pedidos']);
      this.toast.info('Nuevo pedido', `Creando pedido para ${this.selectedContact.name}`);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Importa contactos desde un CSV (formato: nombre,apellidos,email,telefono).
   * Crea cada contacto en el torneo seleccionado vía /User/create-contact.
   */
  importContacts(event?: Event): void {
    if (!event) {
      this.toast.info('Importar', 'Selecciona un CSV con columnas: nombre, apellidos, email, telefono');
      return;
    }
    const input = event.target as HTMLInputElement;
    const file = input.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;
    if (!this.selectedTournamentId) {
      this.toast.error('Sin torneo', 'Selecciona un torneo antes de importar contactos');
      input.value = '';
      return;
    }
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = () => {
      const text = String(reader.result || '');
      const rows = text.split(/\r?\n/).filter(l => l.trim().length > 0);
      // Skip header if present
      const dataRows = rows[0].toLowerCase().includes('nombre') ? rows.slice(1) : rows;
      let created = 0;
      let failed = 0;
      let pending = dataRows.length;
      if (!pending) {
        this.toast.info('CSV vacío', 'El archivo no contiene contactos válidos');
        input.value = '';
        return;
      }
      for (const row of dataRows) {
        const cols = row.split(',').map(c => c.trim());
        const [nombre, apellidos, email, telefono] = cols;
        const fullName = `${nombre || ''} ${apellidos || ''}`.trim();
        if (!fullName) { failed++; pending--; continue; }
        const req: ContactoRequestDto = {
          name: fullName,
          email: email || undefined,
          phone: telefono || undefined,
          tournamentId: this.selectedTournamentId
        };
        this.usersService.createContact(req).subscribe({
          next: () => { created++; pending--; if (pending === 0) this.afterImport(created, failed, input); },
          error: () => { failed++; pending--; if (pending === 0) this.afterImport(created, failed, input); }
        });
      }
    };
    reader.readAsText(file);
  }

  private afterImport(created: number, failed: number, input: HTMLInputElement): void {
    if (created > 0) this.toast.success('Importación completada', `${created} contactos creados${failed ? `, ${failed} fallidos` : ''}.`);
    else this.toast.error('Importación fallida', 'No se pudo crear ningún contacto');
    input.value = '';
    this.loadContacts();
  }

  copyContacts(): void {
    const data = this.contacts.map(c => `${c.name} ${c.lastName}, ${c.phone}`).join('\n');
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(data).then(() => {
      this.toast.success('Copiado', `${this.contacts.length} contactos copiados al portapapeles.`);
    });
  }

  viewOrderDetails(order: ContactHistory): void {
    this.toast.info('Ver detalles', `Pedido ${order.id} - ${order.racket}`);
  }

  getStatusClass(status: string): string {
    return status === 'completado' ? 'badge-success' : 'badge-warning';
  }

  loadContacts(): void {
    const params = { findUsers: true, page: 0, size: 100, sortBy: 'name', direction: 'asc' as const };
    const obs = this.selectedTournamentId
      ? this.usersService.getAllUsersByTournament(this.selectedTournamentId, params)
      : this.usersService.listUsers(params);
    obs.subscribe({
      next: (page) => {
        this.contacts = page.content.map((user) => this.mapUserToContact(user, !!this.selectedTournamentId));
        this.selectedId = this.contacts[0]?.id ?? null;
      },
      error: () => {
        this.toast.error('Error', 'No se pudieron cargar los contactos');
      }
    });
  }

  private mapUserToContact(user: UserProfile, hasTournament: boolean): Contact {
    const { name, lastName } = this.splitName(user.name || user.username);
    return {
      id: user.id || user.username,
      username: user.username,
      name,
      lastName,
      phone: user.phoneNumber || '',
      email: user.email || '',
      notes: '',
      hasTournament,
      history: []
    };
  }

  private splitName(fullName: string): { name: string; lastName: string } {
    const parts = (fullName || '').trim().split(' ');
    if (parts.length <= 1) {
      return { name: fullName, lastName: '' };
    }
    return {
      name: parts[0],
      lastName: parts.slice(1).join(' ')
    };
  }
}
````

````html
<section class="space-y-6">
  <!-- Hero Header -->
  <div class="relative overflow-hidden rounded-3xl animate-rise">
    <div class="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-br from-atp-navy via-atp-deep to-atp-blue"></div>
    <div class="absolute inset-0 opacity-25">
      <div class="absolute -top-12 -right-12 w-80 h-80 bg-atp-sky/30 rounded-full blur-3xl"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="relative px-6 py-7 sm:px-8 sm:py-8 text-white">
      <div class="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-end justify-between gap-5">
        <div>
          <div class="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-white/60 mb-1.5">Catálogo</div>
          <h1 class="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-extrabold tracking-tight">Gestión de Cordajes</h1>
          <p class="text-white/70 text-[13px] mt-1.5">Catálogo completo de cuerdas disponibles</p>
        </div>
        <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
          <button class="btn h-10 px-4 rounded-xl bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/15 backdrop-blur-sm border border-white/15 text-white gap-2" (click)="importExcel()">
            <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor">
              <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M4 16v1a3 3 0 003 3h10a3 3 0 003-3v1m-4-8l-4-4m0 0L8 8m4-4v12"/>
            </svg>
            Importar
          </button>
          <button class="btn h-10 px-4 rounded-xl bg-white text-atp-navy hover:bg-atp-ice font-bold gap-2 shadow-lg shadow-black/10" (click)="exportExcel()">
            <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor">
              <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M4 16v1a3 3 0 003 3h10a3 3 0 003-3v1m-4-4l-4 4m0 0l-4-4m4 4V4"/>
            </svg>
            Exportar
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="grid gap-6 lg:grid-cols-[1.2fr_0.8fr]">
    <!-- Lista de Cordajes -->
    <div class="space-y-4">
      <div class="atp-panel p-4">
        <p class="text-sm text-slate-500">{{ strings.length }} cordajes disponibles</p>
      </div>

      <div class="space-y-3">
        <div
          *ngFor="let item of strings"
          class="atp-card flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 p-4 cursor-pointer hover-lift"
          [class.border-atp-blue]="selectedId === item.id"
          [class.border-2]="selectedId === item.id"
          (click)="selectString(item)"
        >
          <div>
            <div class="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-800">{{ item.brand }} {{ item.model }}</div>
            <div class="text-xs text-slate-500">Formato: {{ item.stringFormat }} | Tipo: {{ item.stringsType }} | Stock: {{ item.stock }}</div>
          </div>
          <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
            <span class="text-sm font-bold text-gradient">{{ item.price }}€</span>
            <button class="btn btn-xs btn-error btn-outline rounded-full" (click)="removeString(item); $event.stopPropagation()">
              <svg width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor">
                <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M19 7l-.867 12.142A2 2 0 0116.138 21H7.862a2 2 0 01-1.995-1.858L5 7m5 4v6m4-6v6m1-10V4a1 1 0 00-1-1h-4a1 1 0 00-1 1v3M4 7h16"/>
              </svg>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div *ngIf="strings.length === 0" class="empty-state">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor">
            <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="1.5" d="M20 7l-8-4-8 4m16 0l-8 4m8-4v10l-8 4m0-10V4l8 4m-8-4v10l-8 4m0-10V4l8 4"/>
          </svg>
          <p class="empty-state-title">Sin cordajes</p>
          <p class="empty-state-description">Añade tu primer cordaje.</p>
        </div>
      </div>

      <button class="btn btn-sm btn-ghost w-full rounded-xl gap-2" (click)="addNew()">
        <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor">
          <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M12 4v16m8-8H4"/>
        </svg>
        Añadir Nuevo Cordaje
      </button>
    </div>

    <!-- Editor -->
    <aside class="atp-panel animate-rise p-5">
      <h2 class="text-lg font-semibold">Editar Cordaje</h2>
      <form class="mt-4 space-y-4" (ngSubmit)="updateString()">
        <label class="form-control">
          <div class="label"><span class="label-text">Marca *</span></div>
          <input class="input input-bordered border-slate-200 bg-white" name="brand" [(ngModel)]="form.brand" required />
        </label>

        <label class="form-control">
          <div class="label"><span class="label-text">Modelo *</span></div>
          <input class="input input-bordered border-slate-200 bg-white" name="model" [(ngModel)]="form.model" required />
        </label>

        <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
          <label class="form-control">
            <div class="label"><span class="label-text">Formato</span></div>
            <input class="input input-bordered border-slate-200 bg-white" name="stringFormat" [(ngModel)]="form.stringFormat" placeholder="12m" />
          </label>
          <label class="form-control">
            <div class="label"><span class="label-text">Tipo</span></div>
            <input class="input input-bordered border-slate-200 bg-white" name="stringsType" [(ngModel)]="form.stringsType" placeholder="Polyester" />
          </label>
        </div>

        <label class="form-control">
          <div class="label"><span class="label-text">Stock</span></div>
          <input class="input input-bordered border-slate-200 bg-white" name="stock" type="number" [(ngModel)]="form.stock" min="0" />
        </label>

        <label class="form-control">
          <div class="label"><span class="label-text">Precio (EUR) *</span></div>
          <input class="input input-bordered border-slate-200 bg-white" name="price" type="number" [(ngModel)]="form.price" required />
        </label>

        <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
          <button class="btn btn-ghost rounded-full" type="button" (click)="cancelEdit()">Cancelar</button>
          <button class="btn btn-primary rounded-full" type="submit">Actualizar</button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </aside>
  </div>

  <!-- Delete Confirm Dialog -->
  <dialog [class.modal]="showDeleteConfirm" [open]="showDeleteConfirm" class="modal">
    <div class="modal-backdrop" (click)="cancelDelete()"></div>
    <div class="modal-card" *ngIf="showDeleteConfirm">
      <div class="modal-header">
        <div class="modal-icon icon-error">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor">
            <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M19 7l-.867 12.142A2 2 0 0116.138 21H7.862a2 2 0 01-1.995-1.858L5 7m5 4v6m4-6v6m1-10V4a1 1 0 00-1-1h-4a1 1 0 00-1 1v3M4 7h16"/>
          </svg>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="modal-body text-center">
        <h3 class="modal-title">Eliminar Cordaje</h3>
        <p class="modal-message">¿Eliminar <strong>{{ stringToDelete?.brand }} {{ stringToDelete?.model }}</strong>?</p>
      </div>
      <div class="modal-footer justify-center">
        <button class="btn btn-ghost rounded-full" (click)="cancelDelete()">Cancelar</button>
        <button class="btn btn-error rounded-full" (click)="executeDelete()">Eliminar</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </dialog>
</section>
````

````typescript
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { Component, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms';
import { ToastService } from '../components/toast-notification/toast.service';
import { CuerdasService, CuerdaItem, CuerdaPatchDto, CuerdaRequestDto } from '../services/cuerdas.service';
import { TournamentsService, TournamentItem } from '../services/tournaments.service';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-cordajes-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule, FormsModule],
  templateUrl: './cordajes.page.html',
  styleUrl: './cordajes.page.css'
})
export class CordajesPage implements OnInit {
  private toast = new ToastService();
  tournaments: TournamentItem[] = [];
  selectedTournamentId = '';

  brandFilter = '';

  strings: CuerdaItem[] = [];

  selectedId = this.strings[0]?.id ?? '';
  showDeleteConfirm = false;
  stringToDelete: CuerdaItem | null = null;

  form = { brand: '', model: '', stringFormat: '', stringsType: '', stock: 0, price: 0 };
  isCreating = false;

  constructor(
    private cuerdasService: CuerdasService,
    private tournamentsService: TournamentsService
  ) {}

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.tournamentsService.list({ page: 0, pageSize: 100, sortBy: 'name', direction: 'asc' }).subscribe({
      next: (page) => {
        this.tournaments = page.content;
        if (this.tournaments.length > 0) {
          this.selectedTournamentId = this.tournaments[0].id;
        }
        this.loadCuerdas();
      },
      error: () => {
        this.toast.error('Error', 'No se pudieron cargar los torneos');
      }
    });
  }

  onTournamentChange(): void {
    this.loadCuerdas();
  }

  get selectedItem(): CuerdaItem | undefined {
    return this.strings.find(item => item.id === this.selectedId);
  }

  get filteredStrings(): CuerdaItem[] {
    if (!this.brandFilter) return this.strings;
    return this.strings.filter(s => s.brand === this.brandFilter);
  }

  get moCount(): number {
    return this.strings.filter(s => s.brand === 'M/O').length;
  }

  get babolatCount(): number {
    return this.strings.filter(s => s.brand === 'Babolat').length;
  }

  get headCount(): number {
    return this.strings.filter(s => s.brand === 'Head').length;
  }

  get averagePrice(): number {
    if (this.strings.length === 0) return 0;
    const total = this.strings.reduce((sum, s) => sum + s.price, 0);
    return total / this.strings.length;
  }

  selectString(item: CuerdaItem): void {
    this.selectedId = item.id;
    this.isCreating = false;
    this.form = {
      brand: item.brand,
      model: item.model,
      stringFormat: item.stringFormat,
      stringsType: item.stringsType,
      stock: item.stock,
      price: item.price
    };
  }

  confirmDelete(item: CuerdaItem): void {
    this.stringToDelete = item;
    this.showDeleteConfirm = true;
  }

  cancelDelete(): void {
    this.showDeleteConfirm = false;
    this.stringToDelete = null;
  }

  executeDelete(): void {
    if (this.stringToDelete) {
      const id = Number(this.stringToDelete.id);
      this.cuerdasService.remove(id).subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Cordaje eliminado', `${this.stringToDelete!.brand} ${this.stringToDelete!.model} eliminado.`);
          this.loadCuerdas();
        },
        error: () => {
          this.toast.error('Error', 'No se pudo eliminar el cordaje');
        }
      });
    }
    this.cancelDelete();
  }

  removeString(item: CuerdaItem): void {
    this.confirmDelete(item);
  }

  cancelEdit(): void {
    if (this.selectedItem) {
      this.selectString(this.selectedItem);
      this.toast.info('Editar cancelado', 'Los cambios no se han guardado.');
    }
  }

  updateString(): void {
    if (this.isCreating) {
      if (!this.selectedTournamentId) {
        this.toast.error('Torneo', 'Selecciona un torneo antes de crear');
        return;
      }
      const request: CuerdaRequestDto = {
        marca: this.form.brand.trim(),
        tournamentId: this.selectedTournamentId,
        modelo: this.form.model.trim(),
        stock: Number(this.form.stock) || 0,
        precio: Number(this.form.price) || 0,
        stringFormat: this.form.stringFormat.trim(),
        stringsType: this.form.stringsType.trim()
      };
      this.cuerdasService.create(request).subscribe({
        next: (created) => {
          this.toast.success('Cordaje creado', `${created.brand} ${created.model} guardado.`);
          this.isCreating = false;
          this.loadCuerdas();
        },
        error: () => {
          this.toast.error('Error', 'No se pudo crear el cordaje');
        }
      });
      return;
    }

    if (!this.selectedItem) return;
    const id = Number(this.selectedItem.id);
    const request: CuerdaPatchDto = {
      marca: this.form.brand.trim(),
      modelo: this.form.model.trim(),
      stock: Number(this.form.stock) || 0,
      precio: Math.max(0.1, Number(this.form.price) || 0.1),
      stringFormat: this.form.stringFormat.trim(),
      stringsType: this.form.stringsType.trim()
    };
    this.cuerdasService.update(id, request).subscribe({
      next: () => {
        this.toast.success('Cordaje actualizado', `${this.form.brand} ${this.form.model} guardado.`);
        this.loadCuerdas();
      },
      error: () => {
        this.toast.error('Error', 'No se pudo actualizar el cordaje');
      }
    });
  }

  addNew(): void {
    this.isCreating = true;
    this.selectedId = '';
    this.form = { brand: '', model: '', stringFormat: '', stringsType: '', stock: 0, price: 0 };
    this.toast.info('Nuevo cordaje', 'Edita los datos y guarda.');
  }

  importExcel(): void {
    this.toast.info('Importar Excel', 'Funcionalidad en desarrollo. Formato esperado: CSV con columnas marca,modelo,calibre,color,precio.');
  }

  exportExcel(): void {
    const data = this.strings.map(s => `${s.brand},${s.model},${s.stringFormat},${s.stringsType},${s.stock},${s.price}`).join('\n');
    const header = 'marca,modelo,formato,tipo,stock,precio\n';
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(header + data).then(() => {
      this.toast.success('Copiado', `${this.strings.length} cordajes copiados al portapapeles.`);
    });
  }

  private loadCuerdas(): void {
    const params: { size: number; sortBy: string; direction: string; tournamentId?: string } = { size: 100, sortBy: 'id', direction: 'asc' };
    if (this.selectedTournamentId) params.tournamentId = this.selectedTournamentId;
    this.cuerdasService.list(params).subscribe({
      next: (page) => {
        this.strings = page.content;
        if (!this.selectedId && this.strings.length) {
          this.selectString(this.strings[0]);
        }
      },
      error: () => {
        this.toast.error('Error', 'No se pudieron cargar los cordajes');
      }
    });
  }
}
````

````html
            <button class="btn btn-xs btn-ghost rounded-full" (click)="viewOrderDetails(order)">Ver</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </article>

      <div *ngIf="filteredOrders.length === 0" class="empty-state">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor">
          <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="1.5" d="M9.172 16.172a4 4 0 015.656 0M9 10h.01M15 10h.01M21 12a9 9 0 11-18 0 9 9 0 0118 0z"/>
        </svg>
        <p class="empty-state-title">Sin resultados</p>
        <p class="empty-state-description">No hay pedidos para los filtros actuales.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>
</section>
````

````typescript
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { Component, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms';
import { NgApexchartsModule } from 'ng-apexcharts';
import { ToastService } from '../components/toast-notification/toast.service';
import { PurchasedService } from '../services/purchased.service';
import { PedidoCard, formatDate } from '../models/pedido.model';
import { AuthService } from '../services/auth.service';
import { AdminService } from '../services/admin.service';
import { TournamentsService, TournamentItem } from '../services/tournaments.service';

type ReportStatus = 'proceso' | 'lista' | 'entregada' | 'anulada';

interface ReportOrder {
  id: string;
  player: string;
  encorder: string;
  status: ReportStatus;
  pedidoDate: string;
  requeridaDate: string;
  createdAtMs: number;
  items: number;
  total: number;
  racket: string;
  paymentStatus: string;
  machine: string;
  tournamentId: string;
}

interface ChartOptions {
  chart?: any;
  series?: any;
  labels?: any;
  colors?: any;
  plotOptions?: any;
  legend?: any;
  dataLabels?: any;
  stroke?: any;
  tooltip?: any;
  responsive?: any;
  xaxis?: any;
  yaxis?: any;
  fill?: any;
  grid?: any;
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-informes-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule, FormsModule, NgApexchartsModule],
  templateUrl: './informes.page.html',
  styleUrl: './informes.page.css'
})
export class InformesPage implements OnInit {
  private toast = new ToastService();

  // Filtros
  torneos: TournamentItem[] = [];
  selectedTournamentId: string | null = null;
  selectedTournamentName = '';
  fromDate = '';
  toDate = '';
  playerFilter = '';
  statusFilters: Record<ReportStatus, boolean> = { proceso: true, lista: true, entregada: true, anulada: false };

  isLoading = false;
  orders: ReportOrder[] = [];

  // ============================================================
  //  CHARTS — definiciones estáticas (las series se rellenan en código)
  // ============================================================
  chartOptionsStatus: ChartOptions = {
    chart: { type: 'donut', height: 300, fontFamily: 'Inter, sans-serif', background: 'transparent' },
    plotOptions: {
      pie: {
        donut: {
          size: '68%',
          labels: {
            show: true,
            name: { show: true, fontSize: '13px', fontWeight: 600 },
            value: { show: true, fontSize: '22px', fontWeight: 800, color: '#0A1A3A', formatter: (v: string) => v },
            total: { show: true, label: 'Pedidos', fontSize: '12px', fontWeight: 600, color: '#64748B' }
          }
        }
      }
    },
    labels: ['En Proceso', 'Listos', 'Entregados', 'Anulados'],
    colors: ['#1E4D8C', '#0EA5A4', '#16A34A', '#EF4444'],
    legend: { position: 'bottom', fontSize: '12px', markers: { radius: 12 }, itemMargin: { horizontal: 12 } },
    dataLabels: { enabled: false },
    stroke: { width: 0 },
    tooltip: { theme: 'light' }
  };

  chartOptionsType: ChartOptions = {
    chart: { type: 'bar', height: 300, fontFamily: 'Inter, sans-serif', background: 'transparent', toolbar: { show: false }, stacked: true },
    plotOptions: { bar: { horizontal: false, columnWidth: '60%', borderRadius: 6 } },
    colors: ['#1E4D8C', '#0EA5A4', '#16A34A', '#EF4444'],
    dataLabels: { enabled: false },
    stroke: { show: true, width: 2, colors: ['transparent'] },
    xaxis: { categories: [], labels: { style: { fontSize: '11px', colors: '#64748B' } } },
    yaxis: { labels: { style: { fontSize: '11px', colors: '#64748B' }, formatter: (val: number) => val.toString() } },
    tooltip: { theme: 'light', y: { formatter: (val: number) => `${val} pedidos` } },
    fill: { opacity: 1 },
    legend: { position: 'top', fontSize: '12px', markers: { radius: 12 } },
    grid: { borderColor: '#E2E8F0', strokeDashArray: 4 }
  };

  chartOptionsRevenue: ChartOptions = {
    chart: { type: 'area', height: 300, fontFamily: 'Inter, sans-serif', background: 'transparent', toolbar: { show: false } },
    colors: ['#1E4D8C', '#3B82F6'],
    dataLabels: { enabled: false },
    stroke: { curve: 'smooth', width: 3 },
    xaxis: { categories: [], labels: { style: { fontSize: '11px', colors: '#64748B' } } },
    yaxis: { labels: { style: { fontSize: '11px', colors: '#64748B' }, formatter: (val: number) => `${val.toFixed(0)} €` } },
    tooltip: { theme: 'light', y: { formatter: (val: number) => `${val.toFixed(2)} €` } },
    fill: {
      type: 'gradient',
      gradient: { shadeIntensity: 1, opacityFrom: 0.45, opacityTo: 0.05, stops: [0, 100] }
    },
    legend: { position: 'top', fontSize: '12px', markers: { radius: 12 } },
    grid: { borderColor: '#E2E8F0', strokeDashArray: 4 }
  };

  chartOptionsEncorders: ChartOptions = {
    chart: { type: 'bar', height: 300, fontFamily: 'Inter, sans-serif', background: 'transparent', toolbar: { show: false } },
    plotOptions: { bar: { horizontal: true, borderRadius: 6, distributed: true } },
    colors: ['#1E4D8C', '#3B82F6', '#0EA5A4', '#16A34A', '#F59E0B', '#EF4444', '#8B5CF6', '#EC4899'],
    dataLabels: { enabled: true, style: { fontSize: '11px', colors: ['#FFFFFF'] } },
    stroke: { width: 0 },
    xaxis: { categories: [], labels: { style: { fontSize: '11px', colors: '#64748B' } } },
    yaxis: { labels: { style: { fontSize: '11px', colors: '#64748B' } } },
    tooltip: { theme: 'light', y: { formatter: (val: number) => `${val} pedidos` } },
    legend: { show: false },
    grid: { borderColor: '#E2E8F0', strokeDashArray: 4 }
  };

  // Series rellenadas dinámicamente
  seriesStatus: number[] = [0, 0, 0, 0];
  seriesType: { name: string; data: number[] }[] = [];
  seriesRevenue: { name: string; data: number[] }[] = [];
  seriesEncorders: { name: string; data: number[] }[] = [];

  constructor(
    private purchasedService: PurchasedService,
    private auth: AuthService,
    private adminService: AdminService,
    private tournamentsService: TournamentsService
  ) {}

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.tournamentsService.list({ page: 0, pageSize: 100 }).subscribe({
      next: (page) => {
        this.torneos = page.content;
        // Para supervisor, autoseleccionar el primer torneo. Admin/Jefe puede ver todos.
        if (this.torneos.length && (this.isSupervisor || this.auth.role === 'owner')) {
          this.selectedTournamentId = this.torneos[0].id;
          this.selectedTournamentName = this.torneos[0].name;
        }
        this.loadOrders();
      },
      error: () => {
        this.loadOrders();
      }
    });
  }

  // ============================================================
  //  Permission flags
  // ============================================================
  get canImport(): boolean { return this.auth.can('excel:import'); }
  get isSupervisor(): boolean { return this.auth.role === 'supervisor'; }

  // ============================================================
  //  Tournament filter
  // ============================================================
  onTournamentChange(): void {
    const t = this.torneos.find(x => x.id === this.selectedTournamentId);
    this.selectedTournamentName = t?.name || '';
    this.loadOrders();
  }

  clearTournamentFilter(): void {
    this.selectedTournamentId = null;
    this.selectedTournamentName = '';
    this.loadOrders();
  }

  toggleStatus(status: ReportStatus): void {
    this.statusFilters[status] = !this.statusFilters[status];
    this.recomputeCharts();
  }

  get filteredOrders(): ReportOrder[] {
    const term = this.playerFilter.trim().toLowerCase();
    const from = this.fromDate ? new Date(this.fromDate).getTime() : null;
    const to = this.toDate ? new Date(this.toDate).getTime() + 24 * 3600 * 1000 : null;
    return this.orders.filter((o) => {
      if (!this.statusFilters[o.status]) return false;
      if (from && o.createdAtMs < from) return false;
      if (to && o.createdAtMs > to) return false;
      if (term) {
        const haystack = `${o.player} ${o.encorder} ${o.id} ${o.racket}`.toLowerCase();
        if (!haystack.includes(term)) return false;
      }
      return true;
    });
  }

  get summary() {
    const orders = this.filteredOrders;
    return {
      pedidos: orders.length,
      articulos: orders.reduce((sum, o) => sum + o.items, 0),
      facturado: orders.reduce((sum, o) => sum + o.total, 0),
      procesando: orders.filter(o => o.status === 'proceso').length,
      listas: orders.filter(o => o.status === 'lista').length,
      entregadas: orders.filter(o => o.status === 'entregada').length,
      anuladas: orders.filter(o => o.status === 'anulada').length
    };
  }

  statusLabel(s: ReportStatus): string {
    return { proceso: 'En proceso', lista: 'Lista', entregada: 'Entregada', anulada: 'Anulada' }[s];
  }

  clearFilters(): void {
    this.playerFilter = '';
    this.fromDate = '';
    this.toDate = '';
    this.statusFilters = { proceso: true, lista: true, entregada: true, anulada: true };
    this.toast.success('Filtros limpiados', 'Todos los filtros se han reseteado.');
    this.recomputeCharts();
  }

  exportExcel(): void {
    const tid = this.selectedTournamentId;
    if (!tid) {
      this.toast.error('Sin torneo', 'Selecciona un torneo antes de exportar');
      return;
    }
    const obs = this.isSupervisor
      ? this.adminService.exportExcelSupervisor(tid)
      : this.adminService.exportExcelAdmin(tid);
    obs.subscribe({
      next: (blob) => {
        this.downloadBlob(blob, `informe-${this.isSupervisor ? 'supervisor' : 'admin'}-${tid}-${Date.now()}.xlsx`);
        this.toast.success('Exportado', 'El informe ha sido descargado.');
      },
      error: (err) => this.toast.error('Error', err?.error?.message || 'No se pudo exportar')
    });
  }

  onImportExcel(event: Event): void {
    if (!this.canImport) return;
    const input = event.target as HTMLInputElement;
    const file = input.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;
    const tid = this.selectedTournamentId;
    if (!tid) {
      this.toast.error('Sin torneo', 'Selecciona un torneo antes de importar');
      input.value = '';
      return;
    }
    if (!confirm(`¿Importar "${file.name}" al torneo seleccionado?`)) { input.value = ''; return; }
    this.adminService.importExcel(file, tid).subscribe({
      next: () => {
        this.toast.success('Importado', `${file.name} se ha procesado correctamente.`);
        input.value = '';
        this.loadOrders();
      },
      error: (err) => {
        this.toast.error('Error', err?.error?.message || 'No se pudo importar');
        input.value = '';
      }
    });
  }

  viewOrderDetails(order: ReportOrder): void {
    this.toast.info('Pedido', `${order.id} · ${order.player} · ${order.racket} · ${order.total}€`);
  }

  get totalFacturado(): number {
    return this.filteredOrders.reduce((sum, o) => sum + o.total, 0);
  }

  // ============================================================
  //  CARGA DE PEDIDOS desde el backend
  // ============================================================
  private loadOrders(): void {
    this.isLoading = true;
    const params: Parameters<PurchasedService['list']>[0] = { page: 0, size: 500, sortBy: 'createdAt', direction: 'desc' };
    if (this.selectedTournamentId) params.tournamentId = this.selectedTournamentId;

    this.purchasedService.list(params).subscribe({
      next: (page) => {
        this.orders = page.content.map((o) => this.mapOrder(o));
        this.isLoading = false;
        this.recomputeCharts();
      },
      error: () => {
        this.isLoading = false;
        this.toast.error('Error', 'No se pudieron cargar los pedidos');
      }
    });
  }

  // Public alias used by some templates / callbacks
  loadOrdersPublic(): void { this.loadOrders(); }

  private mapOrder(order: PedidoCard): ReportOrder {
    return {
      id: order.id,
      player: order.nombre,
      encorder: order.asignadoA || '—',
      status: this.mapReportStatus(order),
      pedidoDate: order.pedidoDate,
      requeridaDate: formatDate(order.requeridaDateTime),
      createdAtMs: this.parseDate(order.pedidoDate),
      items: order.lineas?.length || 0,
      total: order.total || 0,
      racket: order.lineas?.[0]?.raquetaModelo || '—',
      paymentStatus: order.paymentStatus || '',
      machine: order.machine || '',
      tournamentId: order.tournamentId || ''
    };
  }

  private mapReportStatus(order: PedidoCard): ReportStatus {
    switch (order.estado) {
      case 'proceso':   return 'proceso';
      case 'lista':     return 'lista';
      case 'entregada': return 'entregada';
      case 'cancelado':
      default:          return 'anulada';
    }
  }

  private parseDate(s: string): number {
    const d = new Date(s);
    return isNaN(d.getTime()) ? 0 : d.getTime();
  }

  // ============================================================
  //  RECOMPUTAR GRÁFICOS — basado en datos reales del backend
  // ============================================================
  private recomputeCharts(): void {
    const orders = this.filteredOrders;

    // 1) Distribución por estado (donut)
    const proc = orders.filter(o => o.status === 'proceso').length;
    const lis  = orders.filter(o => o.status === 'lista').length;
    const ent  = orders.filter(o => o.status === 'entregada').length;
    const anu  = orders.filter(o => o.status === 'anulada').length;
    this.seriesStatus = [proc, lis, ent, anu];

    // 2) Evolución diaria por estado (barras apiladas)
    const buckets = this.bucketByDay(orders);
    const days = Object.keys(buckets).sort();
    const categoriesShort = days.map(d => this.shortDay(d));
    this.chartOptionsType = {
      ...this.chartOptionsType,
      xaxis: { ...this.chartOptionsType.xaxis, categories: categoriesShort }
    };
    this.seriesType = [
      { name: 'En proceso', data: days.map(d => buckets[d].proceso) },
      { name: 'Listas',     data: days.map(d => buckets[d].lista) },
      { name: 'Entregadas', data: days.map(d => buckets[d].entregada) },
      { name: 'Anuladas',   data: days.map(d => buckets[d].anulada) }
    ];

    // 3) Facturación diaria (área) — separa pagado vs pendiente
    const paidByDay = days.map(d => buckets[d].paid);
    const pendingByDay = days.map(d => buckets[d].pending);
    this.chartOptionsRevenue = {
      ...this.chartOptionsRevenue,
      xaxis: { ...this.chartOptionsRevenue.xaxis, categories: categoriesShort }
    };
    this.seriesRevenue = [
      { name: 'Pagado',     data: paidByDay },
      { name: 'Pendiente',  data: pendingByDay }
    ];

    // 4) Top encordadores (barras horizontales) — top 8
    const byEncorder = new Map<string, number>();
    for (const o of orders) {
      const k = o.encorder || '—';
      byEncorder.set(k, (byEncorder.get(k) || 0) + 1);
    }
    const top = Array.from(byEncorder.entries())
      .filter(([k]) => k && k !== '—')
      .sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1])
      .slice(0, 8);
    this.chartOptionsEncorders = {
      ...this.chartOptionsEncorders,
      xaxis: { ...this.chartOptionsEncorders.xaxis, categories: top.map(([k]) => k) }
    };
    this.seriesEncorders = [{ name: 'Pedidos', data: top.map(([, v]) => v) }];
  }

  private bucketByDay(orders: ReportOrder[]): Record<string, {
    proceso: number; lista: number; entregada: number; anulada: number;
    paid: number; pending: number;
  }> {
    const m: Record<string, any> = {};
    for (const o of orders) {
      const day = this.toDayKey(o.createdAtMs);
      if (!m[day]) m[day] = { proceso: 0, lista: 0, entregada: 0, anulada: 0, paid: 0, pending: 0 };
      m[day][o.status] += 1;
      if ((o.paymentStatus || '').toUpperCase() === 'PAID') m[day].paid += o.total;
      else m[day].pending += o.total;
    }
    return m;
  }

  private toDayKey(ms: number): string {
    if (!ms) return '0000-00-00';
    const d = new Date(ms);
    const y = d.getFullYear();
    const mo = String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
    const da = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
    return `${y}-${mo}-${da}`;
  }

  private shortDay(iso: string): string {
    // 'YYYY-MM-DD' → 'DD MMM'
    if (!iso || iso.length < 10) return iso;
    const d = new Date(iso);
    if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return iso;
    return d.toLocaleDateString('es-ES', { day: '2-digit', month: 'short' });
  }

  private downloadBlob(blob: Blob, filename: string): void {
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = url;
    a.download = filename;
    document.body.appendChild(a);
    a.click();
    document.body.removeChild(a);
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  }
}
````

````html
                    <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M12 15v2m-6 4h12a2 2 0 002-2v-6a2 2 0 00-2-2H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v6a2 2 0 002 2zm10-10V7a4 4 0 00-8 0v4h8z" />

                />
                <button

                  aria-label="Toggle password"
                >
                  <svg *ngIf="!showPassword" class="w-[18px] h-[18px]" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">

                  </svg>
                  <svg *ngIf="showPassword" class="w-[18px] h-[18px]" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                    <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M15 12a3 3 0 11-6 0 3 3 0 016 0z" />
                    <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M2.458 12C3.732 7.943 7.523 5 12 5c4.478 0 8.268 2.943 9.542 7-1.274 4.057-5.064 7-9.542 7-4.478 0-8.268-2.943-9.542-7z" />
                  </svg>
                </button>

            </label>

            <button
              type="submit"
              [disabled]="isLoading"
              class="btn btn-primary w-full h-12 text-[15px] font-bold rounded-xl mt-2"
            >
              <span *ngIf="isLoading" class="spinner spinner-sm"></span>
              {{ isLoading ? 'Entrando...' : 'Entrar al panel' }}
              <svg *ngIf="!isLoading" class="w-4 h-4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2.5" d="M13 7l5 5m0 0l-5 5m5-5H6"/>
              </svg>
            </button>
          </form>
        </div>

        <!-- Demo users panel -->
        <div class="bg-white rounded-3xl shadow-lg border border-slate-100 p-6 sm:p-7">
          <div class="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
            <div>
              <div class="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-atp-blue mb-1">Acceso rápido</div>
              <h3 class="text-base font-bold text-atp-navy">Usuarios de demo</h3>
            </div>

          <div class="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-2.5">
            <button

              (click)="loginAsDemo(user)"

            >
              <div class="w-10 h-10 rounded-lg bg-gradient-to-br {{ user.color }} flex items-center justify-center text-lg shadow-sm ring-1 ring-white/40 group-hover:scale-105 transition-transform">

              </div>
              <div class="flex-1 min-w-0">
                <div class="text-[13px] font-bold text-slate-800 group-hover:text-atp-blue transition-colors truncate">{{ user.label }}</div>
                <div class="text-[11px] text-slate-400 font-mono truncate">{{ user.username }}</div>
              </div>
              <svg class="w-4 h-4 text-slate-300 group-hover:text-atp-blue group-hover:translate-x-0.5 transition-all" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2.5" d="M9 5l7 7-7 7"/>

            </button>
          </div>

          <div class="mt-5 pt-4 border-t border-slate-100 flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] text-slate-400">
            <span class="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <span class="status-dot success pulse"></span>
              Backend conectado
            </span>
            <span>© ETR · TFG</span>
          </div>
        </div>

      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- Modal: ¿Olvidaste la contraseña? -->
  <div *ngIf="forgotOpen" class="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
    <div class="absolute inset-0 bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-sm" (click)="forgotOpen = false"></div>
    <div class="relative bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-2xl max-w-md w-full p-6 animate-rise">
      <h3 class="text-xl font-bold text-atp-navy mb-2">Recuperar contraseña</h3>
      <p class="text-sm text-slate-500 mb-4">Te enviaremos un email con un enlace para restablecer tu contraseña.</p>
      <form (submit)="$event.preventDefault(); submitForgot()" class="space-y-4">
        <input type="email" [(ngModel)]="forgotEmail" name="forgotEmail" class="input input-bordered w-full" placeholder="tu@email.com" required />
        <div class="flex gap-3 justify-end">
          <button type="button" class="btn btn-ghost" (click)="forgotOpen = false">Cancelar</button>
          <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary" [disabled]="forgotLoading">
            <span *ngIf="forgotLoading" class="spinner spinner-sm mr-2"></span>
            <span>{{ forgotLoading ? 'Enviando…' : 'Enviar email' }}</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- Modal: Crear cuenta -->
  <div *ngIf="registerOpen" class="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
    <div class="absolute inset-0 bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-sm" (click)="registerOpen = false"></div>
    <div class="relative bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-2xl max-w-md w-full p-6 animate-rise">
      <h3 class="text-xl font-bold text-atp-navy mb-2">Crear cuenta</h3>
      <p class="text-sm text-slate-500 mb-4">Te registras como jugador. Tu rol podrá cambiarse después por un administrador.</p>
      <form (submit)="$event.preventDefault(); submitRegister()" class="space-y-3">
        <div>
          <label class="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-600 mb-1">Usuario</label>
          <input [(ngModel)]="regUsername" name="regUsername" class="input input-bordered w-full" minlength="3" required />
        </div>
        <div>
          <label class="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-600 mb-1">Email</label>
          <input type="email" [(ngModel)]="regEmail" name="regEmail" class="input input-bordered w-full" required />
        </div>
        <div>
          <label class="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-600 mb-1">Contraseña</label>
          <input type="password" [(ngModel)]="regPassword" name="regPassword" class="input input-bordered w-full" minlength="6" required />
        </div>
        <div class="flex gap-3 justify-end pt-2">
          <button type="button" class="btn btn-ghost" (click)="registerOpen = false">Cancelar</button>
          <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary" [disabled]="regLoading">
            <span *ngIf="regLoading" class="spinner spinner-sm mr-2"></span>
            <span>{{ regLoading ? 'Creando…' : 'Crear cuenta' }}</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
````

## File: front-encordados/src/app/pages/login.page.ts
````typescript
import { Component } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms';
import { Router } from '@angular/router';
import { AuthService, DEMO_USERS } from '../services/auth.service';
import { ToastService } from '../components/toast-notification/toast.service';
import { UserRole } from '../models/roles.model';

interface DemoUserInfo {
  role: UserRole;
  label: string;
  username: string;
  password: string;
  color: string;
  icon: string;
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-login-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule, FormsModule],
  templateUrl: './login.page.html',
  styleUrl: './login.page.css'
})
export class LoginPage {
  username = '';
  password = '';
  rememberMe = false;
  isLoading = false;
  showPassword = false;

  forgotOpen = false;
  forgotEmail = '';
  forgotLoading = false;

  registerOpen = false;
  regUsername = '';
  regEmail = '';
  regPassword = '';
  regLoading = false;

  private toast = new ToastService();

  demoUsers: DemoUserInfo[] = [
    { role: 'admin',      label: 'Administrador',   username: 'admin_encordados',  password: 'admin123',      color: 'from-rose-500 to-rose-700',     icon: '👑' },
    { role: 'owner',      label: 'Jefe de Taller',  username: 'owner_principal',   password: 'owner123',      color: 'from-atp-navy to-atp-blue',     icon: '🏭' },
    { role: 'supervisor', label: 'Supervisor',      username: 'supervisor_luis',   password: 'supervisor123', color: 'from-amber-400 to-amber-600',   icon: '🏅' },
    { role: 'tenista',    label: 'Tenista',         username: 'jugador_juan',      password: 'user123',       color: 'from-sky-400 to-atp-sky',       icon: '🎾' },
    { role: 'encordador', label: 'Encordador',      username: 'carlos_encordador', password: 'encorder123',   color: 'from-emerald-400 to-emerald-600', icon: '🔧' }
  ];

  constructor(private auth: AuthService, private router: Router) {}

  onLogin(): void {
    if (!this.username || !this.password) {
      this.toast.error('Campos requeridos', 'Por favor introduce usuario y contraseña');
      return;
    }

    this.isLoading = true;
    this.auth.login(this.username, this.password).subscribe({
      next: (result) => {
        this.isLoading = false;
        if (result.success && result.user) {
          this.toast.success('Bienvenido', `Hola ${result.user.name}`);
          this.redirectByRole(result.user.role);
        } else {
          this.toast.error('Error', result.error || 'Credenciales incorrectas');
        }
      },
      error: () => {
        this.isLoading = false;
        this.toast.error('Error', 'No se pudo conectar al servidor');
      }
    });
  }

  loginAsDemo(user: DemoUserInfo): void {
    this.username = user.username;
    this.password = user.password;
    this.onLogin();
  }

  submitForgot(): void {
    if (!this.forgotEmail) {
      this.toast.error('Email requerido', 'Introduce tu email');
      return;
    }
    this.forgotLoading = true;
    this.auth.requestPasswordChange(this.forgotEmail).subscribe((result) => {
      this.forgotLoading = false;
      if (result.success) {
        this.toast.success('Email enviado', 'Revisa tu correo para continuar');
        this.forgotOpen = false;
        this.forgotEmail = '';
      } else {
        this.toast.error('Error', result.error || 'No se pudo procesar la solicitud');
      }
    });
  }

  submitRegister(): void {
    if (!this.regUsername || !this.regEmail || !this.regPassword) {
      this.toast.error('Campos requeridos', 'Completa todos los campos');
      return;
    }
    if (this.regPassword.length < 6) {
      this.toast.error('Contraseña corta', 'Debe tener al menos 6 caracteres');
      return;
    }
    this.regLoading = true;
    this.auth.signup(this.regUsername, this.regEmail, this.regPassword).subscribe((result) => {
      this.regLoading = false;
      if (result.success && result.user) {
        this.toast.success('Cuenta creada', `Bienvenido ${result.user.name}`);
        this.redirectByRole(result.user.role);
      } else {
        this.toast.error('Error', result.error || 'No se pudo completar el registro');
      }
    });
  }

  private redirectByRole(role: UserRole): void {
    switch (role) {
      case 'admin':
      case 'jefe_taller':
      case 'owner':
        this.router.navigate(['/pedidos']);
        break;
      case 'organizador':
        this.router.navigate(['/torneos']);
        break;
      case 'tenista':
        this.router.navigate(['/mis-pedidos']);
        break;
      case 'supervisor':
        this.router.navigate(['/supervisor']);
        break;
      case 'encordador':
        this.router.navigate(['/mis-asignados']);
        break;
      default:
        this.router.navigate(['/pedidos']);
    }
  }
}
````

````css
.atp-panel {
  border-radius: 22px;
  background: #ffffff;
  border: 1px solid rgba(11, 30, 59, 0.08);
  box-shadow: 0 18px 45px -32px rgba(11, 30, 59, 0.55);

  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  background: rgba(14, 165, 164, 0.12);
  color: #0ea5a4;
}

.empty-state {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 48px 24px;
  text-align: center;
}

.animate-rise {
  animation: riseIn 0.6s ease both;
}

@keyframes riseIn {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(12px); }
  to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}
````

````html
<section class="space-y-6">

      <div class="mt-3 pt-3 border-t border-slate-100">
        <div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
          <button (click)="adjustStock(item, -1)" class="btn btn-xs btn-ghost rounded-full w-8 h-8 flex items-center justify-center p-0">-</button>
          <div class="flex-1 text-center">
            <div class="text-xs text-slate-400">Stock</div>
            <div [class.text-red-600]="isLowStock(item)" class="font-bold">{{ item.stock }}</div>
          </div>
          <button (click)="adjustStock(item, 1)" class="btn btn-xs btn-ghost rounded-full w-8 h-8 flex items-center justify-center p-0">+</button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- Progress bar stock -->
      <div class="mt-2 h-1.5 bg-slate-100 rounded-full overflow-hidden">
        <div class="h-full rounded-full transition-all duration-300" 
             [class.bg-emerald-500]="item.stock > item.minStock" 
             [class.bg-amber-500]="item.stock <= item.minStock && item.stock > 0"
             [class.bg-red-500]="item.stock === 0"
             [style.width.%]="Math.min(100, (item.stock / Math.max(item.minStock * 2, 1)) * 100)"></div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Empty State -->
    <div *ngIf="filteredItems.length === 0" class="col-span-full empty-state py-16">
      <svg class="w-20 h-20 text-slate-300 mx-auto" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
        <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="1.5" d="M20 7l-8-4-8 4m16 0l-8 4m8-4v10l-8 4m0-10L4 7m8 4v10M4 7v10l8 4" />
      </svg>
      <p class="text-lg font-semibold text-slate-600 mt-4">No se encontraron materiales</p>
      <p class="text-sm text-slate-400">Prueba con otros filtros o crea uno nuevo.</p>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- Modal Create/Edit -->
  <div *ngIf="showModal" class="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center">
    <div class="absolute inset-0 bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-sm" (click)="closeModal()"></div>
    <div class="relative bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-2xl max-w-xl w-full mx-4 p-6 animate-rise max-h-[90vh] overflow-auto">
      <h3 class="text-xl font-bold text-atp-navy mb-6">{{ isEditMode ? 'Editar' : 'Nuevo' }} Material</h3>
      
      <form (submit)="$event.preventDefault(); saveItem()" class="space-y-4">
        <div class="grid md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
          <div class="col-span-2">
            <label class="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1.5">Nombre *</label>
            <input [(ngModel)]="form.name" name="name" class="input input-bordered w-full" required />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label class="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1.5">Categor&iacute;a</label>
            <select [(ngModel)]="form.category" name="category" class="select select-bordered w-full">
              <option *ngFor="let cat of categories" [value]="cat.value">{{ cat.icon }} {{ cat.label }}</option>
            </select>
          </div>
          <div>
            <label class="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1.5">Marca</label>
            <input [(ngModel)]="form.brand" name="brand" class="input input-bordered w-full" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label class="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1.5">Modelo</label>
            <input [(ngModel)]="form.model" name="model" class="input input-bordered w-full" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label class="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1.5">Color</label>
            <input [(ngModel)]="form.color" name="color" class="input input-bordered w-full" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label class="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1.5">Precio (&euro;)</label>
            <input type="number" step="0.01" [(ngModel)]="form.price" name="price" class="input input-bordered w-full" min="0" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label class="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1.5">Stock actual</label>
            <input type="number" [(ngModel)]="form.stock" name="stock" class="input input-bordered w-full" min="0" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label class="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1.5">Stock m&iacute;nimo</label>
            <input type="number" [(ngModel)]="form.minStock" name="minStock" class="input input-bordered w-full" min="0" />
          </div>
          <div class="col-span-2">
            <label class="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1.5">Descripci&oacute;n</label>
            <textarea [(ngModel)]="form.description" name="description" class="textarea textarea-bordered w-full" rows="3"></textarea>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="flex gap-3 justify-end pt-4">
          <button (click)="closeModal()" type="button" class="btn btn-ghost">Cancelar</button>
          <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary">{{ isEditMode ? 'Guardar' : 'Crear' }}</button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
````

````typescript
import { Component, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms';
import { ToastService } from '../components/toast-notification/toast.service';
import { MaterialItem, MATERIAL_CATEGORIES, MaterialCategory } from '../models/material.model';
import { MaterialsService, MaterialPatchDto, MaterialRequestDto } from '../services/materials.service';
import { AuthService } from '../services/auth.service';
import { TournamentsService, TournamentItem } from '../services/tournaments.service';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-materiales-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule, FormsModule],
  templateUrl: './materiales.page.html',
  styleUrl: './materiales.page.css'
})
export class MaterialesPage implements OnInit {
  private toast = new ToastService();
  private defaultTournamentId = '';

  Math = Math;

  searchTerm = '';
  selectedCategory: MaterialCategory | '' = '';
  lowStockOnly = false;
  showModal = false;
  isEditMode = false;

  form: MaterialItem = this.createEmptyForm();
  selectedId = '';

  // Tournament filter (owner sees materials by tournament)
  torneos: TournamentItem[] = [];
  selectedTournamentId: string | null = null;
  selectedTournamentName = '';

  categories = MATERIAL_CATEGORIES;
  items: MaterialItem[] = [];

  constructor(
    private materialsService: MaterialsService,
    public auth: AuthService,
    private tournamentsService: TournamentsService
  ) {}

  ngOnInit(): void {
    if (this.needsTournamentFilter) {
      this.tournamentsService.list({ page: 0, pageSize: 100 }).subscribe({
        next: (page) => { this.torneos = page.content; },
        error: () => {}
      });
    } else {
      this.loadMaterials();
    }
  }

  get needsTournamentFilter(): boolean {
    return this.auth.role === 'owner';
  }

  selectTournament(t: TournamentItem): void {
    this.selectedTournamentId = t.id;
    this.selectedTournamentName = t.name;
    this.defaultTournamentId = t.id;
    this.loadMaterials();
  }

  clearTournamentFilter(): void {
    this.selectedTournamentId = null;
    this.selectedTournamentName = '';
    this.items = [];
  }

  getStatus(t: TournamentItem): 'activo' | 'pendiente' | 'cerrado' {
    const now = new Date();
    const start = new Date(t.startTournament);
    const end = new Date(t.endTournament);
    if (start > now) return 'pendiente';
    if (end < now) return 'cerrado';
    return 'activo';
  }

  get filteredItems(): MaterialItem[] {
    let list = this.items;

    if (this.selectedCategory) {
      list = list.filter(i => i.category === this.selectedCategory);
    }

    if (this.lowStockOnly) {
      list = list.filter(i => i.stock <= i.minStock);
    }

    if (this.searchTerm.trim()) {
      const term = this.searchTerm.toLowerCase();
      list = list.filter(i =>
        i.name.toLowerCase().includes(term) ||
        i.brand.toLowerCase().includes(term) ||
        i.id.toLowerCase().includes(term)
      );
    }

    return list;
  }

  get selectedItem(): MaterialItem | undefined {
    return this.items.find(i => i.id === this.selectedId);
  }

  get totalValue(): number {
    return this.items.reduce((sum, i) => sum + (i.price * i.stock), 0);
  }

  get totalItems(): number {
    return this.items.reduce((sum, i) => sum + i.stock, 0);
  }

  get lowStockCount(): number {
    return this.items.filter(i => i.stock <= i.minStock).length;
  }

  get categoryStats(): { category: MaterialCategory; label: string; count: number; icon: string }[] {
    return MATERIAL_CATEGORIES.map(cat => {
      const count = this.items.filter(i => i.category === cat.value).length;
      return { category: cat.value, label: cat.label, count, icon: cat.icon };
    }).filter(c => c.count > 0);
  }

  selectItem(item: MaterialItem): void {
    this.selectedId = item.id;
  }

  openNew(): void {
    this.isEditMode = false;
    this.form = this.createEmptyForm();
    this.showModal = true;
  }

  openEdit(item: MaterialItem): void {
    this.isEditMode = true;
    this.form = { ...item };
    this.showModal = true;
  }

  closeModal(): void {
    this.showModal = false;
  }

  saveItem(): void {
    if (this.isEditMode) {
      const id = Number(this.form.id);
      const request: MaterialPatchDto = {
        marca: this.form.brand,
        modelo: this.form.model,
        stock: this.form.stock,
        precio: this.form.price,
        type: this.form.category
      };
      this.materialsService.update(id, request).subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Material actualizado', `${this.form.name} guardado.`);
          this.closeModal();
          this.loadMaterials();
        },
        error: () => {
          this.toast.error('Error', 'No se pudo actualizar el material');
        }
      });
    } else {
      if (!this.selectedTournamentId) {
        this.toast.error('Torneo', 'Selecciona un torneo antes de crear');
        return;
      }
      const request: MaterialRequestDto = {
        marca: this.form.brand,
        tournamentId: this.selectedTournamentId,
        modelo: this.form.model,
        stock: this.form.stock,
        precio: this.form.price,
        type: this.form.category
      };
      this.materialsService.create(request).subscribe({
        next: (created) => {
          this.toast.success('Material creado', `${created.name} añadido.`);
          this.closeModal();
          this.loadMaterials();
        },
        error: () => {
          this.toast.error('Error', 'No se pudo crear el material');
        }
      });
    }
  }

  confirmDelete(item: MaterialItem): void {
    if (confirm(`¿Eliminar ${item.name}?`)) {
      const id = Number(item.id);
      this.materialsService.remove(id).subscribe({
        next: () => {
          if (this.selectedId === item.id) this.selectedId = '';
          this.toast.success('Material eliminado', `${item.name} ha sido eliminado.`);
          this.loadMaterials();
        },
        error: () => {
          this.toast.error('Error', 'No se pudo eliminar el material');
        }
      });
    }
  }

  adjustStock(item: MaterialItem, delta: number): void {
    const updatedStock = Math.max(0, item.stock + delta);
    const id = Number(item.id);
    // El backend de MaterialPatchDto usa defaults (0, "") cuando un campo no llega
    // y luego sobreescribe si !=0 / no vacío. Para no resetear los demás campos
    // enviamos todos.
    const request: MaterialPatchDto = {
      marca: item.brand,
      modelo: item.model,
      stock: updatedStock,
      precio: item.price,
      type: item.category
    };
    this.materialsService.update(id, request).subscribe({
      next: () => {
        this.toast.info('Stock actualizado', `${item.name}: ${updatedStock} unidades`);
        this.loadMaterials();
      },
      error: () => {
        this.toast.error('Error', 'No se pudo actualizar el stock');
      }
    });
  }

  getStockClass(item: MaterialItem): string {
    if (item.stock === 0) return 'bg-red-100 text-red-700';
    if (item.stock <= item.minStock) return 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-700';
    return 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700';
  }

  getCategoryIcon(category: string): string {
    const icons: Record<string, string> = {
      raqueta: '🎾', cordaje: '🧵', grip: '🤚', overgrip: '🖐️',
      antivibrador: '〰️', bolsa: '🎒', calzado: '👟', ropa: '👕',
      pelotas: '⚾', accesorio: '🔧', herramienta: '🛠️'
    };
    return icons[category] || '📦';
  }

  isLowStock(item: MaterialItem): boolean {
    return item.stock <= item.minStock;
  }

  private createEmptyForm(): MaterialItem {
    return {
      id: '',
      category: 'raqueta',
      name: '',
      brand: '',
      model: '',
      color: '',
      price: 0,
      stock: 0,
      minStock: 5,
      description: ''
    };
  }

  private loadMaterials(): void {
    const tid = this.selectedTournamentId || undefined;
    this.materialsService.list({ size: 100, sortBy: 'id', direction: 'asc', tournamentId: tid }).subscribe({
      next: (page) => {
        this.items = page.content;
        if (!this.selectedId && this.items.length) {
          this.selectedId = this.items[0].id;
        }
      },
      error: () => {
        this.toast.error('Error', 'No se pudieron cargar los materiales');
      }
    });
  }
}
````

````html
<section class="space-y-6">

  <!-- Tournament selector for OWNER / SUPERVISOR -->
  <ng-container *ngIf="needsTournamentFilter">

    <!-- No tournament selected yet: show picker -->
    <div *ngIf="!selectedTournamentId" class="atp-panel animate-rise p-7">
      <div class="text-eyebrow mb-1">Paso 1</div>
      <h2 class="text-2xl font-bold text-atp-navy tracking-tight mb-1">Selecciona un torneo</h2>
      <p class="text-sm text-slate-500 mb-6">Los pedidos se muestran filtrados por torneo. Elige uno para continuar.</p>
      <div *ngIf="torneos.length === 0" class="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 text-slate-400 py-8">
        <span class="spinner spinner-sm"></span> Cargando torneos...
      </div>
      <div class="grid sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
        <button *ngFor="let t of torneos"
          (click)="selectTournament(t)"
          class="group flex items-center gap-3 p-4 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white hover:border-atp-blue hover:shadow-md hover:-translate-y-0.5 transition-all text-left">
          <span class="status-dot"
            [class.success]="getStatus(t) === 'activo'"
            [class.warning]="getStatus(t) === 'pendiente'"
            [class.idle]="getStatus(t) === 'cerrado'"
            [class.pulse]="getStatus(t) === 'activo'"></span>
          <div class="flex-1 min-w-0">
            <p class="text-[13px] font-bold text-atp-navy truncate group-hover:text-atp-blue">{{ t.name }}</p>
            <p class="text-[11px] text-slate-400">{{ t.startTournament | date:'dd MMM yyyy' }}</p>
          </div>
          <svg class="w-4 h-4 text-slate-300 group-hover:text-atp-blue group-hover:translate-x-0.5 transition-all flex-shrink-0" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
            <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2.5" d="M9 5l7 7-7 7"/>
          </svg>
        </button>

      <button (click)="clearTournamentFilter()" class="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-slate-500 hover:text-atp-blue hover:bg-slate-50 transition-all font-semibold">
        <svg class="w-3.5 h-3.5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
          <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2.5" d="M15 19l-7-7 7-7"/>
        </svg>
        Torneos

      <svg class="w-3 h-3 text-slate-300" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
        <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2.5" d="M9 5l7 7-7 7"/>
      </svg>
      <span class="font-bold text-atp-navy">{{ selectedTournamentName }}</span>
    </div>

  </ng-container>

  <!-- Main content: only show when not needing filter OR tournament already selected -->
  <ng-container *ngIf="!needsTournamentFilter || selectedTournamentId">

  <div class="relative overflow-hidden rounded-3xl animate-rise">
    <div class="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-br from-atp-navy via-atp-deep to-atp-blue"></div>
    <div class="absolute inset-0 opacity-25">
      <div class="absolute -top-12 -right-12 w-80 h-80 bg-atp-sky/30 rounded-full blur-3xl"></div>
    </div>

    <div class="relative px-6 py-6 sm:px-8 sm:py-8 text-white">

          <div class="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2">
            <span class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full bg-white/15 backdrop-blur-sm text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] ring-1 ring-white/20">Workflow ATP</span>

              </svg>

            <input
              class="h-11 w-full pl-10 pr-4 rounded-xl bg-white/10 backdrop-blur-sm border border-white/15 text-white text-[13px] placeholder-white/50 focus:bg-white/15 focus:border-white/30 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-white/20 transition-all"
              placeholder="Buscar nombre, email, ID..."

            />
````
