              <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor">
                <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M3 4a1 1 0 011-1h16a1 1 0 011 1v2.586a1 1 0 01-.293.707l-6.414 6.414a1 1 0 00-.293.707V17a1 1 0 01-1 1H6a1 1 0 01-1-1v-2.586a1 1 0 00-.293-.707L3.293 7.293A1 1 0 013 6.586V4z" />
              </svg>
              <span class="hidden sm:inline">Filtros</span>
            </button>

            <button class="btn h-11 px-4 rounded-xl bg-white text-atp-navy hover:bg-atp-ice font-bold gap-2 shadow-lg shadow-black/10" data-nuevo-pedido (click)="nuevoPedido?.open()">
              <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor">

          <div class="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-orange-400 animate-pulse"></div>
          <span class="text-white/80">En Proceso</span>
          <strong class="text-white tabular-nums">{{ filteredInProcess.length }}</strong>
        </div>
        <div class="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-white/10 backdrop-blur-sm border border-white/15 text-[12px]">
          <div class="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-400"></div>
          <span class="text-white/80">Listas</span>
          <strong class="text-white tabular-nums">{{ filteredReviewed.length }}</strong>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- Kanban Boards -->
  <div cdkDropListGroup class="grid gap-6 lg:grid-cols-2">
    <!-- Columna: En Proceso -->
    <section class="atp-panel p-5">
      <div class="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
        <div>
          <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div class="w-3 h-3 rounded-full bg-orange-500 animate-pulse-subtle"></div>
            <h2 class="text-lg font-semibold text-slate-800">En Proceso</h2>
            <span class="badge bg-orange-100 text-orange-700">{{ filteredInProcess.length }}</span>
          </div>
          <p class="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-1"> Pedidos en taller esperando terminaci&oacute;n</p>
        </div>
        <button class="btn btn-xs btn-ghost rounded-full" *ngIf="isAdminOrJefe">
          <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor">
            <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M3 4a1 1 0 011-1h16a1 1 0 011 1v2.586a1 1 0 01-.293.707l-6.414 6.414a1 1 0 00-.293.707V17a1 1 0 01-1 1H6a1 1 0 01-1-1v-2.586a1 1 0 00-.293-.707L3.293 7.293A1 1 0 013 6.586V4z" />
          </svg>
        </button>
      </div>

      <div
        cdkDropList
        [cdkDropListData]="inProcess"
        [cdkDropListDisabled]="isSearching || isTenista || isSupervisor || isEncordador"

        class="min-h-[300px] flex flex-col gap-4"
      >
        <ng-container *ngFor="let order of filteredInProcess; trackBy: trackById">
          <article 
            cdkDrag 
            [cdkDragDisabled]="isTenista || isSupervisor || isEncordador"
            class="atp-card p-5 cursor-pointer status-in-progress hover-lift"
            (click)="openDetail(order)"
          >
            <!-- Header Card -->
            <div class="flex items-start justify-between gap-3 mb-3">
              <div class="min-w-0">
                <h3 class="text-base font-semibold text-slate-800 truncate">{{ order.nombre }}</h3>
                <p class="text-xs text-slate-400 font-mono">{{ order.id }}</p>
                <p class="text-xs text-slate-400">{{ order.email }}</p>
              </div>
              <div class="text-right shrink-0">
                <span class="text-xs text-slate-500 block">Pedido: {{ order.pedidoDate }}</span>
                <span class="text-xs block mt-0.5" [class.text-orange-600]="isUrgent(order)" [class.text-slate-400]="!isUrgent(order)">
                  Req: {{ formatDateTime(order.requeridaDateTime) }}
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>

            <!-- Lines Summary -->
            <div class="rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-br from-slate-50 to-slate-100 p-4 mb-3">
              <div class="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                <span class="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700">
                  {{ order.lineas.length }} l&iacute;nea{{ order.lineas.length > 1 ? 's' : '' }}
                </span>
                <span class="atp-chip">{{ order.lineas[0]?.tipo || 'M.O' }}</span>
              </div>
              
              <div *ngFor="let linea of order.lineas.slice(0, 2); let i = index" class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-xs text-slate-600 mb-1">
                <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <span class="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-atp-blue"></span>
                  <span class="truncate">V: {{ linea.vertical }}</span>
                </div>
                <div class="text-right text-slate-500">{{ linea.tensionV }}</div>
                <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <span class="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-atp-teal"></span>
                  <span class="truncate">H: {{ linea.horizontal }}</span>
                </div>
                <div class="text-right text-slate-500">{{ linea.tensionH }}</div>
              </div>
              <div *ngIf="order.lineas.length > 2" class="text-xs text-slate-400 italic mt-1">+{{ order.lineas.length - 2 }} m&aacute;s</div>
              
              <div class="mt-3 pt-3 border-t border-slate-200 flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-slate-500">
                <span>&#10013; {{ order.lineas.reduce((sum, l) => sum + l.nudos, 0) }} nudos total</span>
                <span>&#9670; Logo: {{ order.lineas[0]?.logo || 'Negro' }}</span>
              </div>
            </div>

            <!-- Assignment -->
            <div class="mb-3 text-xs text-slate-500">
              Asignado: <span class="font-medium">{{ order.asignadoA }}</span>
            </div>

            <!-- Footer -->
            <div class="flex items-center justify-between pt-3 border-t border-slate-100">
              <div class="text-lg font-bold text-gradient">{{ order.total }}&euro;</div>
              <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
                <button 
                  class="btn btn-xs btn-secondary rounded-full"
                  (click)="$event.stopPropagation(); moveToList(order)"
                  *ngIf="isAdminOrJefe"
                >
                  Completar
                </button>
                <button 
                  class="btn btn-xs btn-ghost rounded-full"
                  (click)="$event.stopPropagation(); printOrderTicket(order)"
                >
                  &#128424;
                </button>
                <button 
                  class="btn btn-xs btn-accent rounded-full"
                  (click)="openRepeatModal(order, $event)"
                  *ngIf="isAdminOrJefe || isOrganizador"
                >
                  &#128260; Repetir
                </button>
                <button 
                  class="btn btn-xs btn-error rounded-full"
                  (click)="cancelOrder(order, $event)"
                  *ngIf="isAdminOrJefe || isOrganizador || (isTenista && order.playerUsername === currentUsername) || (isEncordador && order.encorderUsername === currentUsername)"
                >
                  &#128465; Cancelar
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </article>
        </ng-container>

        <div *ngIf="filteredInProcess.length === 0" class="empty-state">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor">
            <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="1.5" d="M9 5H7a2 2 0 00-2 2v12a2 2 0 002 2h10a2 2 0 002-2V7a2 2 0 00-2-2h-2M9 5a2 2 0 002 2h2a2 2 0 002-2M9 5a2 2 0 012-2h2a2 2 0 012 2" />
          </svg>
          <p class="empty-state-title">No hay pedidos</p>
          <p class="empty-state-description">
            No hay pedidos en proceso en este momento
          </p>
          <button class="btn btn-sm btn-primary mt-4" data-nuevo-pedido (click)="nuevoPedido?.open()" *ngIf="isAdminOrJefe || isOrganizador">
            Crear nuevo pedido
          </button>

    </section>

    <!-- Columna: Listos/Entregados -->
    <section class="atp-panel p-5">
      <div class="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
        <div>
          <div class="flex items-center gap-3">

              <div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 mb-2">

              <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
                <button

                  *ngIf="isAdminOrJefe"

  <!-- Modals -->
  <app-detalle-pedido-modal
    [pedido]="selectedPedido"
    [visible]="modalVisible"
    (close)="closeModal()"

````typescript
import { CdkDragDrop, DragDropModule, moveItemInArray, transferArrayItem } from '@angular/cdk/drag-drop';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { Component, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms';
import { DetallePedidoModalComponent } from '../components/detalle-pedido-modal/detalle-pedido-modal.component';
import { NuevoPedidoComponent } from '../components/nuevo-pedido/nuevo-pedido.component';
import { ToastService } from '../components/toast-notification/toast.service';
import { AuthService } from '../services/auth.service';
import { PurchasedPatchDto, PurchasedRequestDto, PurchasedService } from '../services/purchased.service';
import { TournamentsService, TournamentItem } from '../services/tournaments.service';
import { PedidoCard, PedidoEstado, formatDateTime, mapUiStatusToBackend } from '../models/pedido.model';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router } from '@angular/router';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-pedidos-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule, FormsModule, DragDropModule, DetallePedidoModalComponent, NuevoPedidoComponent],
  templateUrl: './pedidos.page.html',
  styleUrl: './pedidos.page.css'
})
export class PedidosPage implements OnInit {
  searchTerm = '';
  selectedPedido: PedidoCard | null = null;
  modalVisible = false;
  repeatModalVisible = false;
  pedidoToRepeat: PedidoCard | null = null;

  private toast = new ToastService();
  isLoading = false;

  inProcess: PedidoCard[] = [];
  reviewed: PedidoCard[] = [];
  canceled: PedidoCard[] = [];

  // Tournament filter (required for OWNER / SUPERVISOR)
  torneos: TournamentItem[] = [];
  selectedTournamentId: string | null = null;
  selectedTournamentName: string = '';

  // Encordador filter (via query param)
  encorderFilter: string | null = null;

  constructor(
    private auth: AuthService,
    private router: Router,
    private route: ActivatedRoute,
    private purchasedService: PurchasedService,
    private tournamentsService: TournamentsService
  ) { }

  availableTournaments: { id: string; name: string }[] = [];

  ngOnInit(): void {
    // Read query params (torneo + encordador) to support deep-link from torneo detail
    this.route.queryParamMap.subscribe((qp) => {
      const torneo = qp.get('torneo');
      const enc = qp.get('encordador');
      this.encorderFilter = enc;

      if (torneo) {
        // Resolve torneo name lazily
        this.selectedTournamentId = torneo;
        this.selectedTournamentName = this.torneos.find(t => t.id === torneo)?.name || '';
        if (!this.selectedTournamentName) {
          this.tournamentsService.getById(torneo).subscribe({
            next: (det) => { this.selectedTournamentName = det.name; },
            error: () => {}
          });
        }
        this.loadOrders();
      } else if (this.needsTournamentFilter) {
        this.tournamentsService.list({ page: 0, pageSize: 100 }).subscribe({
          next: (page) => { this.torneos = page.content; },
          error: () => {}
        });
      } else {
        this.loadOrders();
      }
    });
  }

  clearEncorderFilter(): void {
    this.encorderFilter = null;
    this.router.navigate([], { queryParams: { encordador: null }, queryParamsHandling: 'merge' });
  }

  get needsTournamentFilter(): boolean {
    const role = this.auth.role;
    return role === 'owner' || role === 'supervisor';
  }

  selectTournament(torneo: TournamentItem): void {
    this.selectedTournamentId = torneo.id;
    this.selectedTournamentName = torneo.name;
    this.loadOrders();
  }

  clearTournamentFilter(): void {
    this.selectedTournamentId = null;
    this.selectedTournamentName = '';
    this.inProcess = [];
    this.reviewed = [];
    this.canceled = [];
  }

  private loadOrders(): void {
    this.isLoading = true;
    const params: Parameters<PurchasedService['list']>[0] = { size: 100, sortBy: 'id', direction: 'desc' };
    if (this.selectedTournamentId) {
      params.tournamentId = this.selectedTournamentId;
    }
    this.purchasedService.list(params).subscribe({
      next: (page) => {
        this.setOrders(page.content);
        this.isLoading = false;
      },
      error: () => {
        this.isLoading = false;
        this.toast.error('Error', 'No se pudieron cargar los pedidos');
      }
    });
  }

  private setOrders(orders: PedidoCard[]): void {
    this.inProcess = orders.filter((order) => order.estado === 'proceso');
    this.reviewed = orders.filter((order) => order.estado === 'lista');
    this.canceled = orders.filter((order) => order.estado === 'cancelado' || order.estado === 'entregada');
  }

  getStatus(t: TournamentItem): 'activo' | 'pendiente' | 'cerrado' {
    const now = new Date();
    const start = new Date(t.startTournament);
    const end = new Date(t.endTournament);
    if (start > now) return 'pendiente';
    if (end < now) return 'cerrado';
    return 'activo';
  }

  get isAdminOrJefe(): boolean {
    return this.auth.isAdmin || this.auth.isJefeTaller;
  }

  /** Backend permite crear pedidos a ADMIN, OWNER y ENCORDER. */
  get canCreateOrder(): boolean {
    return this.auth.isAdmin || this.auth.isJefeTaller || this.auth.isOrganizador || this.auth.isEncordador;
  }

  get isOrganizador(): boolean {
    return this.auth.isOrganizador;
  }

  get isEncordador(): boolean {
    return this.auth.isEncordador;
  }

  get isTenista(): boolean {
    return this.auth.isTenista;
  }

  get isSupervisor(): boolean {
    return this.auth.isSupervisor;
  }

  get currentUsername(): string | null {
    return this.auth.user?.username || null;
  }

  get visibleInProcess(): PedidoCard[] {
    return this.filterOrders(this.inProcess);
  }

  get visibleReviewed(): PedidoCard[] {
    return this.filterOrders(this.reviewed);
  }

  get filteredInProcess(): PedidoCard[] {
    return this.visibleInProcess;
  }

  get filteredReviewed(): PedidoCard[] {
    return this.visibleReviewed;
  }

  get isSearching(): boolean {
    return this.searchTerm.trim().length > 0;
  }

  drop(event: CdkDragDrop<PedidoCard[]>, nextStatus: PedidoEstado): void {
    if (this.isTenista || this.isSupervisor) return;
    if (event.previousContainer === event.container) {
      moveItemInArray(event.container.data, event.previousIndex, event.currentIndex);
      this.toast.info('Orden cambiado', 'La posicion ha sido actualizada');
      return;
    }

    transferArrayItem(
      event.previousContainer.data,
      event.container.data,
      event.previousIndex,
      event.currentIndex
    );

    const moved = event.container.data[event.currentIndex];
    const backendStatus = mapUiStatusToBackend(nextStatus);
    this.purchasedService.changeStatus(moved.id, backendStatus).subscribe({
      next: () => {
        this.toast.success(
          nextStatus === 'lista' ? 'Pedido completado' : 'Pedido reactivado',
          `El pedido se movio a ${nextStatus === 'lista' ? 'lista' : 'proceso'}`
        );
        this.loadOrders();
      },
      error: () => {
        this.toast.error('Error', 'No se pudo cambiar el estado del pedido');
        this.loadOrders();
      }
    });
  }

  trackById(index: number, order: PedidoCard): string {
    return order.id;
  }

  private filterOrders(orders: PedidoCard[]): PedidoCard[] {
    let list = orders;

    // Filter by encordador if requested via query param
    if (this.encorderFilter) {
      const enc = this.encorderFilter.toLowerCase();
      list = list.filter(o =>
        (o.encorderUsername || '').toLowerCase() === enc ||
        (o.asignadoA || '').toLowerCase() === enc
      );
    }

    const term = this.searchTerm.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!term) return list;

    return list.filter((order) => {
      const haystack = `${order.nombre} ${order.id} ${order.email} ${order.asignadoA}`.toLowerCase();
      return haystack.includes(term);
    });
  }

  openDetail(pedido: PedidoCard): void {
    this.selectedPedido = pedido;
    this.modalVisible = true;
  }

  closeModal(): void {
    this.modalVisible = false;
    this.selectedPedido = null;
  }

  onSavePedido(updated: PedidoCard): void {
    const patch = this.toPatch(updated);
    this.purchasedService.update(updated.id, patch).subscribe({
      next: () => {
        this.toast.success('Pedido actualizado', 'Los cambios se han guardado correctamente.');
        this.closeModal();
        this.loadOrders();
      },
      error: () => {
        this.toast.error('Error', 'No se pudo actualizar el pedido');
      }
    });
  }

  onDeletePedido(id: string): void {
    this.purchasedService.cancel(id).subscribe({
      next: () => {
        this.toast.success('Pedido cancelado', 'El pedido ha sido cancelado.');
        this.closeModal();
        this.loadOrders();
      },
      error: () => {
        this.toast.error('Error', 'No se pudo cancelar el pedido');
      }
    });
  }

  onMarkEntregada(pedido: PedidoCard): void {
    if (this.isEncordador || this.isTenista) return;
    const backendStatus = mapUiStatusToBackend('entregada');
    this.purchasedService.changeStatus(pedido.id, backendStatus).subscribe({
      next: () => {
        this.toast.success('Pedido entregado', 'El pedido se marco como entregado.');
        this.closeModal();
        this.loadOrders();
      },
      error: () => {
        this.toast.error('Error', 'No se pudo marcar como entregado');
      }
    });
  }

  onStatusChange(pedido: PedidoCard): void {
    const backendStatus = mapUiStatusToBackend(pedido.estado);
    this.purchasedService.changeStatus(pedido.id, backendStatus).subscribe({
      next: () => {
        this.toast.success('Estado actualizado', 'El estado del pedido ha sido actualizado.');
        this.loadOrders();
      },
      error: () => {
        this.toast.error('Error', 'No se pudo actualizar el estado del pedido');
      }
    });
  }

  onCreatePedido(request: PurchasedRequestDto): void {
    if (this.isTenista || this.isSupervisor || this.isEncordador) return;
    this.purchasedService.create(request).subscribe({
      next: (created) => {
        this.toast.success('Pedido creado', `El pedido ${created.id} ha sido creado correctamente.`);
        this.loadOrders();
      },
      error: () => {
        this.toast.error('Error', 'No se pudo crear el pedido');
      }
    });
  }

  isUrgent(order: PedidoCard): boolean {
    if (!order.requeridaDateTime) return false;
    const today = new Date();
    const required = new Date(order.requeridaDateTime);
    const diffMs = required.getTime() - today.getTime();
    const diffHours = diffMs / (1000 * 60 * 60);
    return diffHours <= 24;
  }

  moveToList(order: PedidoCard): void {
    if (this.isEncordador || this.isTenista || this.isSupervisor) return;
    const backendStatus = mapUiStatusToBackend('lista');
    this.purchasedService.changeStatus(order.id, backendStatus).subscribe({
      next: () => {
        this.toast.success('Pedido completado', 'El pedido se movio a lista de listos.');
        this.loadOrders();
      },
      error: () => {
        this.toast.error('Error', 'No se pudo cambiar el estado del pedido');
      }
    });
  }

  deliverOrder(order: PedidoCard): void {
    if (this.isEncordador || this.isTenista) return;
    const backendStatus = mapUiStatusToBackend('entregada');
    this.purchasedService.changeStatus(order.id, backendStatus).subscribe({
      next: () => {
        this.toast.success('Pedido entregado', `El pedido ${order.id} ha sido marcado como entregado.`);
        this.loadOrders();
      },
      error: () => {
        this.toast.error('Error', 'No se pudo marcar el pedido como entregado');
      }
    });
  }

  cancelOrder(order: PedidoCard, event: Event): void {
    event.stopPropagation();
    if (this.isSupervisor) return;

    this.purchasedService.cancel(order.id).subscribe({
      next: () => {
        this.toast.success('Pedido cancelado', `El pedido ${order.id} ha sido cancelado.`);
        this.loadOrders();
      },
      error: () => {
        this.toast.error('Error', 'No se pudo cancelar el pedido');
      }
    });
  }

  // REPETIR PEDIDO
  openRepeatModal(pedido: PedidoCard, event: Event): void {
    event.stopPropagation();
    this.pedidoToRepeat = pedido;
    this.repeatModalVisible = true;
  }

  closeRepeatModal(): void {
    this.repeatModalVisible = false;
    this.pedidoToRepeat = null;
  }

  confirmRepeat(): void {
    if (!this.pedidoToRepeat) return;
    const request = this.toRepeatRequest(this.pedidoToRepeat);
    this.purchasedService.create(request).subscribe({
      next: (created) => {
        this.toast.success('Pedido repetido', `Se ha creado el pedido ${created.id} como repeticion.`);
        this.closeRepeatModal();
        this.loadOrders();
      },
      error: () => {
        this.toast.error('Error', 'No se pudo repetir el pedido');
      }
    });
  }

  printOrderTicket(order: PedidoCard): void {
    const printWindow = window.open('', '_blank');
    if (printWindow) {
      printWindow.document.write(`
        <!DOCTYPE html>
        <html>
        <head><title>Ticket ${order.id}</title>
        <style>
          * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
          body { font-family: 'Courier New', monospace; padding: 20px; font-size: 12px; }
          .header { text-align: center; border-bottom: 2px dashed #000; padding-bottom: 10px; margin-bottom: 10px; }
          .title { font-size: 18px; font-weight: bold; }
          .section { margin: 12px 0; }
          .section-title { font-weight: bold; border-bottom: 1px solid #ccc; padding-bottom: 4px; margin-bottom: 8px; }
          .row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; margin: 4px 0; }
          .label { color: #666; }
          .value { font-weight: bold; }
          .total { font-size: 18px; font-weight: bold; text-align: right; margin-top: 16px; padding-top: 8px; border-top: 2px dashed #000; }
          .footer { text-align: center; margin-top: 20px; font-size: 10px; color: #666; }
        </style></head>
        <body>
          <div class="header"><div class="title">ENCORDADOS TENNIS CLUB</div><div>Ticket de Encordado</div></div>
          <div class="section">
            <div class="row"><span class="label">Pedido:</span><span class="value">${order.id}</span></div>
            <div class="row"><span class="label">Cliente:</span><span class="value">${order.nombre}</span></div>
            <div class="row"><span class="label">Email:</span><span class="value">${order.email}</span></div>
            <div class="row"><span class="label">Fecha:</span><span class="value">${order.pedidoDate}</span></div>
            <div class="row"><span class="label">Req.:</span><span class="value">${formatDateTime(order.requeridaDateTime)}</span></div>
          </div>
          ${order.lineas.map((l, i) => `
            <div class="section">
              <div class="section-title">Línea ${i + 1}</div>
              <div class="row"><span class="value">${l.raquetaModelo}</span></div>
              <div class="row"><span class="label">Tipo:</span><span class="value">${l.tipo}</span></div>
              <div class="row"><span class="label">Vertical:</span><span class="value">${l.vertical}</span></div>
              <div class="row"><span class="label">Tensión V:</span><span class="value">${l.tensionV}</span></div>
              <div class="row"><span class="label">Horizontal:</span><span class="value">${l.horizontal}</span></div>
              <div class="row"><span class="label">Tensión H:</span><span class="value">${l.tensionH}</span></div>
              <div class="row"><span class="label">Nudos:</span><span class="value">${l.nudos}</span></div>
              <div class="row"><span class="label">Logo:</span><span class="value">${l.logo}</span></div>
            </div>
          `).join('')}
          <div class="total">TOTAL: ${order.total} EUR</div>
          <div class="footer">¡Gracias por confiar en nosotros!</div>
          <script>window.onload = function() { window.print(); }</script>
        </body></html>
      `);
      printWindow.document.close();
    }
    this.toast.info('Imprimiendo ticket', `Ticket ${order.id} enviado a imprimir`);
  }

  formatDateTime(iso: string): string {
    return formatDateTime(iso);
  }

  private toPatch(order: PedidoCard): PurchasedPatchDto {
    return {
      machine: order.machine,
      comments: order.comments,
      payStatus: order.paymentStatus
    };
  }

  private toRepeatRequest(order: PedidoCard): PurchasedRequestDto {
    const requiredDate = new Date(Date.now() + 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString();
    const lineas = order.lineas.map((linea) => ({
      raquetModel: linea.raquetaModelo || linea.raquetaId || '',
      nudos: linea.nudos || 2,
      dateString: requiredDate,
      logotype: (linea.logo || '').toLowerCase() !== 'sin logo',
      color: linea.logo || '',
      stringSetup: {
        stringV: linea.vertical || '',
        tensionV: this.parseTension(linea.tensionV || ''),
        preStetchV: 0,
        stringH: linea.horizontal || '',
        tensionH: this.parseTension(linea.tensionH || ''),
        preStetchH: 0
      }
    }));
    return {
      tournamentId: order.tournamentId || this.selectedTournamentId || '',
      playerName: order.playerUsername || order.nombre,
      assignedToName: order.encorderUsername || order.asignadoA,
      machine: order.machine || 'N/A',
      comments: order.comments || '',
      payStatus: order.paymentStatus || 'PENDING_PAYMENT',
      price: order.total,
      lineas
    };
  }

  private parseTension(value: string): number {
    if (!value) return 0;
    const parsed = Number.parseFloat(value.replace(',', '.'));
    return Number.isNaN(parsed) ? 0 : parsed;
  }
}

import { Component, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms';
import { AuthService } from '../services/auth.service';
import { UsersService, UserRequestDto } from '../services/users.service';
import { ToastService } from '../components/toast-notification/toast.service';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-perfil-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule, FormsModule],
  templateUrl: './perfil.page.html',
  styleUrl: './perfil.page.css'
})
export class PerfilPage implements OnInit {
  editing = false;
  isLoading = false;
  selectedAvatar: File | null = null;

  private toast = new ToastService();

  form = {
    name: 'Carlos Tenista',
    email: 'tenista@encordados.com',
    phone: '+34 600 000 003',
    username: 'carlos_tenista'
  };

  constructor(private auth: AuthService, private usersService: UsersService) { }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.loadProfile();
  }

  get user() {
    return this.auth.user;
  }

  onAvatarSelected(event: Event): void {
    const input = event.target as HTMLInputElement;
    this.selectedAvatar = input.files?.[0] ?? null;
  }

  saveProfile(): void {
    const request: UserRequestDto = {
      name: this.form.name,
      email: this.form.email || undefined,
      telefono: this.form.phone || undefined,
      username: this.form.username || this.auth.user?.username,
      avatar: this.selectedAvatar
    };

    this.isLoading = true;
    this.usersService.updateMe(request).subscribe({
      next: (profile) => {
        this.isLoading = false;
        this.form.username = profile.username;
        this.form.name = profile.name;
        this.form.email = profile.email ?? '';
        this.form.phone = profile.phoneNumber ?? '';
        this.toast.success('Perfil actualizado', 'Los cambios se han guardado.');
        this.auth.refreshProfile().subscribe();
      },
      error: () => {
        this.isLoading = false;
        this.toast.error('Error', 'No se pudo actualizar el perfil');
      }
    });
  }

  private loadProfile(): void {
    this.isLoading = true;
    this.usersService.getMe().subscribe({
      next: (profile) => {
        this.isLoading = false;
        this.form.username = profile.username;
        this.form.name = profile.name;
        this.form.email = profile.email ?? '';
        this.form.phone = profile.phoneNumber ?? '';
      },
      error: () => {
        this.isLoading = false;
        this.toast.error('Error', 'No se pudo cargar el perfil');
      }
    });
  }
}
````

````typescript
import { Component, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { Router } from '@angular/router';
import { AuthService } from '../services/auth.service';
import { TournamentsService, TournamentItem } from '../services/tournaments.service';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-supervisor-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule],
  templateUrl: './supervisor.page.html',
  styleUrl: './supervisor.page.css'
})
export class SupervisorPage implements OnInit {
  torneos: TournamentItem[] = [];
  loading = true;

  constructor(
    public auth: AuthService,
    private tournamentsService: TournamentsService,
    private router: Router
  ) {}

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.tournamentsService.list({ page: 0, pageSize: 100, sortBy: 'name', direction: 'asc' }).subscribe({
      next: (page) => { this.torneos = page.content; this.loading = false; },
      error: () => { this.loading = false; }
    });
  }

  getStatus(t: TournamentItem): 'activo' | 'pendiente' | 'cerrado' {
    const now = new Date();
    const start = new Date(t.startTournament);
    const end = new Date(t.endTournament);
    if (start > now) return 'pendiente';
    if (end < now) return 'cerrado';
    return 'activo';
  }

  get activeCount(): number { return this.torneos.filter(t => this.getStatus(t) === 'activo').length; }
  get pendingCount(): number { return this.torneos.filter(t => this.getStatus(t) === 'pendiente').length; }

  goToDetail(id: string): void { this.router.navigate(['/torneos', id]); }

  formatDate(d: string): string {
    if (!d) return '—';
    return new Date(d).toLocaleDateString('es-ES', { day: '2-digit', month: 'short', year: 'numeric' });
  }
}
````

  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-between: padding: 1.5rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #f1f5f9;
}

.modal-title {
  font-size: 1.25rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #0b1e3b;
  margin: 0;
}

.modal-subtitle {
  font-size: 0.875rem;
  color: #64748b;
  margin-top: 0.25rem;
  font-family: monospace;
}

.modal-close {
  width: 2rem;
  height: 2rem;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  border: none;
  background: #f1f5f9;
  border-radius: 0.5rem;
  cursor: pointer;
  color: #64748b;
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
}

.modal-close:hover {
  background: #e2e8f0;
  color: #0b1e3b;
}

.modal-body {
  padding: 1.5rem;
}

/* Client Info */
.client-info {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 1rem;
  padding: 1rem;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f8fafc 0%, #f1f5f9 100%);
  border-radius: 12px;
  margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
}

.client-avatar {
  width: 3rem;
  height: 3rem;
  border-radius: 0.75rem;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0b1e3b 0%, #0e4b8a 100%);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  color: white;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 1rem;
}

.client-name {
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #0b1e3b;
  font-size: 1rem;
}

.client-id {
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  color: #64748b;
  font-family: monospace;
}

/* Detail Grid */
.detail-grid {
  display: grid;
  gap: 1rem;
}

.detail-section {
  padding: 1rem;
  background: #f8fafc;
  border-radius: 12px;
}

.detail-section.full-width {
  grid-column: span 2;
}

.section-title {
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #64748b;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
}

.detail-row {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 0.5rem 0;
}

.detail-row:not(:last-child) {
  border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
}

.detail-label {
  font-size: 0.875rem;
  color: #64748b;
}

.detail-value {
  font-size: 0.875rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: #0b1e3b;
}

/* Status Badge */
.status-badge {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  padding: 0.375rem 0.75rem;
  border-radius: 999px;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.status-badge.entregado {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #dcfce7 0%, #bbf7d0 100%);
  color: #166534;
}

.status-badge.anulado {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ffe4e6 0%, #fecdd3 100%);
  color: #9f1239;
}

/* Timeline */
.timeline {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 1rem 0;
  margin: 1rem 0;
  position: relative;
}

.timeline::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  height: 2px;
  background: #e2e8f0;
}

.timeline-point {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
}

.timeline-dot {
  width: 0.75rem;
  height: 0.75rem;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: #e2e8f0;
  border: 3px solid white;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #e2e8f0;
}

.timeline-dot.active {
  background: #0ea5a4;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #0ea5a4;
}

.timeline-label {
  font-size: 0.625rem;
  color: #64748b;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.timeline-date {
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #0b1e3b;
}

/* Payment Section */
.payment-section {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 1rem;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0b1e3b 0%, #0e4b8a 100%);
  border-radius: 12px;
  color: white;
  margin-top: 1rem;
}

.payment-label {
  font-size: 0.875rem;
  opacity: 0.8;
}

.payment-value {
  font-size: 1.5rem;
  font-weight: 700;
}

/* Actions */
.modal-actions {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0.75rem;
  padding: 1rem 1.5rem 1.5rem;
  border-top: 1px solid #f1f5f9;
}

.modal-actions .btn {
  flex: 1;
  justify-content: center;
}

/* Responsive */
@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .modal-card {
    border-radius: 16px 16px 0 0;
    position: fixed;
    bottom: 0;
    max-height: 85vh;
  }

  .detail-section.full-width {
    grid-column: span 1;
  }

  .timeline-label {
    display: none;
  }
}

/* Animations */
@keyframes slideUp {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(20px) scale(0.95);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0) scale(1);
  }
}

@keyframes fadeIn {
  from { opacity: 0; }
  to { opacity: 1; }
}

````typescript
import { Component, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms';
import { ToastService } from '../components/toast-notification/toast.service';
import { PurchasedService } from '../services/purchased.service';
import { TournamentsService } from '../services/tournaments.service';
import { AuthService } from '../services/auth.service';
import { PedidoCard, formatDateTime, paymentLabel, paymentBadgeClass } from '../models/pedido.model';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-terminados-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule, FormsModule],
  templateUrl: './terminados.page.html',
  styleUrl: './terminados.page.css'
})
export class TerminadosPage implements OnInit {
  private toast = new ToastService();

  searchTerm = '';

  delivered: PedidoCard[] = [];
  canceled: PedidoCard[] = [];

  selectedOrder: PedidoCard | null = null;
  tournaments: { id: string; name: string }[] = [];
  selectedTournamentId = '';
  isLoading = false;

  constructor(
    private purchasedService: PurchasedService,
    private tournamentsService: TournamentsService,
    private auth: AuthService
  ) {}

  ngOnInit(): void {
    if (this.requiresTournament) {
      this.tournamentsService.list({ page: 0, pageSize: 100, sortBy: 'name', direction: 'asc' }).subscribe({
        next: (page) => {
          this.tournaments = page.content.map((t) => ({ id: t.id, name: t.name }));
          this.selectedTournamentId = this.tournaments[0]?.id || '';
          this.loadOrders();
        },
        error: () => this.toast.error('Error', 'No se pudieron cargar los torneos')
      });
    } else {
      this.loadOrders();
    }
  }

  private get requiresTournament(): boolean {
    return this.auth.isOrganizador || this.auth.isSupervisor;
  }

  onTournamentChange(): void {
    this.loadOrders();
  }

  loadOrders(): void {
    this.isLoading = true;
    const params: { page: number; size: number; sortBy: string; direction: string; tournamentId?: string } = {
      page: 0,
      size: 200,
      sortBy: 'createdAt',
      direction: 'desc'
    };
    if (this.selectedTournamentId) params.tournamentId = this.selectedTournamentId;
    this.purchasedService.list(params).subscribe({
      next: (page) => {
        this.delivered = page.content.filter((o) => o.estado === 'entregada' || o.estado === 'lista');
        this.canceled = page.content.filter((o) => o.estado === 'cancelado');
        this.isLoading = false;
      },
      error: () => {
        this.isLoading = false;
        this.toast.error('Error', 'No se pudieron cargar los pedidos finalizados');
      }
    });
  }

  get filteredDelivered(): PedidoCard[] {
    return this.filterOrders(this.delivered);
  }

  get filteredCanceled(): PedidoCard[] {
    return this.filterOrders(this.canceled);
  }

  private filterOrders(orders: PedidoCard[]): PedidoCard[] {
    const term = this.searchTerm.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!term) return orders;
    return orders.filter(order =>
      `${order.nombre} ${order.id} ${order.lineas[0]?.raquetaModelo ?? ''}`.toLowerCase().includes(term)
    );
  }

  viewDetails(order: PedidoCard): void {
    this.selectedOrder = order;
  }

  closeDetail(): void {
    this.selectedOrder = null;
  }

  formatDateTime(iso: string): string {
    return formatDateTime(iso);
  }

  paymentLabel(status: string | undefined): string {
    return paymentLabel(status);
  }

  paymentBadgeClass(status: string | undefined): string {
    return paymentBadgeClass(status);
  }

  totalNudos(order: PedidoCard): number {
    return order.lineas.reduce((sum, l) => sum + (l.nudos || 0), 0);
  }
}
````

        <button (click)="goBack()" class="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[12px] font-semibold text-white/70 hover:text-white transition-colors">
          <svg class="w-3.5 h-3.5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
            <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2.5" d="M15 19l-7-7 7-7"/>
          </svg>
          Volver a torneos
        </button>
      </div>

      <div class="relative px-6 pb-8 pt-4 sm:px-8 text-white">
        <div class="flex flex-col lg:flex-row lg:items-end justify-between gap-6">
          <!-- Left: title -->
          <div class="flex items-start gap-4 min-w-0">
            <div *ngIf="torneo.logotype" class="w-16 h-16 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden ring-2 ring-white/20 bg-white/10 backdrop-blur-sm flex-shrink-0">
              <img [src]="torneo.logotype" [alt]="torneo.name" class="w-full h-full object-cover" onerror="this.style.display='none'">
            </div>
            <div class="min-w-0">
              <div class="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2">
                <span class="status-dot"
                  [class.success]="status === 'activo'"
                  [class.warning]="status === 'pendiente'"
                  [class.idle]="status === 'cerrado'"
                  [class.pulse]="status === 'activo'"></span>
                <span class="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-white/15 backdrop-blur-sm text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] ring-1 ring-white/20">
                  {{ status }}
                </span>
              </div>
              <h1 class="text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-tight truncate">{{ torneo.name }}</h1>
              <div class="flex items-center gap-3 mt-3 text-white/70 text-[13px] flex-wrap">
                <span class="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <svg class="w-3.5 h-3.5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                    <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M8 7V3m8 4V3m-9 8h10M5 21h14a2 2 0 002-2V7a2 2 0 00-2-2H5a2 2 0 00-2 2v12a2 2 0 002 2z"/>
                  </svg>
                  {{ formatDate(torneo.startTournament) }} → {{ formatDate(torneo.endTournament) }}
                </span>
                <span class="text-white/30">·</span>
                <span class="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <svg class="w-3.5 h-3.5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                    <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M12 8v4l3 3m6-3a9 9 0 11-18 0 9 9 0 0118 0z"/>
                  </svg>
                  {{ durationDays }} día{{ durationDays !== 1 ? 's' : '' }}
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <!-- Right: ID + actions -->
          <div class="flex items-center gap-2 flex-shrink-0">
            <button (click)="copyId()" class="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/15 border border-white/15 text-white/90 text-[12px] font-mono backdrop-blur-sm transition-all">
              <svg class="w-3.5 h-3.5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M8 16H6a2 2 0 01-2-2V6a2 2 0 012-2h8a2 2 0 012 2v2m-6 12h8a2 2 0 002-2v-8a2 2 0 00-2-2h-8a2 2 0 00-2 2v8a2 2 0 002 2z"/>
              </svg>
              <span class="hidden sm:inline truncate max-w-[120px]">{{ torneo.id }}</span>
              <span class="sm:hidden">Copiar ID</span>
            </button>

        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Stats bar -->
    <div class="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
      <div class="stats-card">
        <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
          <div class="stats-label">Encordadores</div>
          <div class="w-7 h-7 rounded-lg bg-atp-ice flex items-center justify-center">
            <svg class="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-atp-blue" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
              <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M17 20h5v-2a3 3 0 00-5.356-1.857M17 20H7m10 0v-2c0-.656-.126-1.283-.356-1.857M7 20H2v-2a3 3 0 015.356-1.857M7 20v-2c0-.656.126-1.283.356-1.857m0 0a5.002 5.002 0 019.288 0M15 7a3 3 0 11-6 0 3 3 0 016 0zm6 3a2 2 0 11-4 0 2 2 0 014 0zM7 10a2 2 0 11-4 0 2 2 0 014 0z"/>
            </svg>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="stats-value text-atp-blue">{{ workerMachines.length || torneo.workers.length }}</div>

      <div class="stats-card">

              <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M9 3H5a2 2 0 00-2 2v4m6-6h10a2 2 0 012 2v4M9 3v18m0 0h10a2 2 0 002-2V9M9 21H5a2 2 0 01-2-2V9m0 0h18"/>

        </div>

        </div>

    </div>

    <!-- Workers per machine -->
    <ng-container *ngIf="workerMachines.length > 0">

        </div>

                </div>

                  <span class="badge badge-success">{{ w.bonos }} bonos</span>
                </div>
                <svg class="w-4 h-4 text-slate-300 group-hover:text-atp-blue group-hover:translate-x-0.5 transition-all" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                  <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2.5" d="M9 5l7 7-7 7"/>
                </svg>
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </ng-container>

    <!-- Workers list fallback -->
    <ng-container *ngIf="workerMachines.length === 0 && torneo.workers.length > 0">
      <div class="atp-panel p-6 animate-rise">
        <div class="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
          <h2 class="text-eyebrow">Encordadores</h2>
          <span class="badge badge-primary">{{ torneo.workers.length }}</span>

        <div class="grid sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
          <button *ngFor="let w of torneo.workers" (click)="goToEncorderOrders(w)"
            class="text-left flex items-center gap-3 p-3 rounded-xl bg-atp-mist border border-slate-100 hover:border-atp-blue/40 hover:bg-atp-ice cursor-pointer transition-all group">
            <div class="avatar avatar-md">
              <img *ngIf="w.imageUrl" [src]="w.imageUrl" [alt]="w.name">
              <span *ngIf="!w.imageUrl">{{ w.name.charAt(0).toUpperCase() }}</span>
            </div>
            <div class="min-w-0 flex-1">
              <p class="text-[13px] font-bold text-atp-navy truncate group-hover:text-atp-blue transition-colors">{{ w.name }}</p>
              <p class="text-[11px] text-slate-400 truncate">@{{ w.username }} · Ver pedidos →</p>
            </div>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </ng-container>

    <!-- Tenistas dashboard -->
    <div *ngIf="tournamentUsers.length > 0" class="atp-panel p-6 animate-rise">
      <div class="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
        <h2 class="text-eyebrow">Tenistas registrados</h2>
        <span class="badge badge-success">{{ tournamentUsers.length }} jugador{{ tournamentUsers.length !== 1 ? 'es' : '' }}</span>
      </div>
      <div class="grid sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
        <div *ngFor="let u of tournamentUsers" class="flex items-center gap-3 p-3 rounded-xl bg-atp-mist border border-slate-100 hover:border-emerald-200 hover:bg-emerald-50/30 transition-all">
          <div class="avatar avatar-md bg-gradient-to-br from-emerald-400 to-emerald-600">
            <img *ngIf="u.imageUrl" [src]="u.imageUrl" [alt]="u.name">
            <span *ngIf="!u.imageUrl">{{ (u.name || u.username).charAt(0).toUpperCase() }}</span>
          </div>
          <div class="min-w-0">
            <p class="text-[13px] font-bold text-atp-navy truncate">{{ u.name || u.username }}</p>
            <p class="text-[11px] text-slate-400 truncate">@{{ u.username }}</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Empty state -->
    <div *ngIf="workerMachines.length === 0 && torneo.workers.length === 0 && tournamentUsers.length === 0" class="atp-panel p-10 text-center">
      <div class="w-16 h-16 mx-auto rounded-2xl bg-slate-50 flex items-center justify-center mb-4">
        <svg class="w-8 h-8 text-slate-300" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
          <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="1.5" d="M17 20h5v-2a3 3 0 00-5.356-1.857M17 20H7m10 0v-2c0-.656-.126-1.283-.356-1.857M7 20H2v-2a3 3 0 015.356-1.857M7 20v-2c0-.656.126-1.283.356-1.857m0 0a5.002 5.002 0 019.288 0"/>
        </svg>
      </div>
      <h3 class="text-base font-bold text-atp-navy">Sin participantes</h3>
      <p class="text-sm text-slate-500 mt-1">No hay participantes asignados a este torneo todavía</p>
    </div>

  </ng-container>

</section>

## File: front-encordados/src/app/pages/torneo-detail.page.ts
````typescript
import { Component, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router } from '@angular/router';
import { forkJoin } from 'rxjs';
import { catchError } from 'rxjs/operators';
import { of } from 'rxjs';
import {
  TournamentsService,
  TournamentDetails,
  WorkerMachineAssignmentResponseDto,
  UserResponseDto
} from '../services/tournaments.service';
import { UsersService, UserWithId } from '../services/users.service';
import { OfflineCacheService } from '../services/offline-cache.service';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-torneo-detail',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule],
  templateUrl: './torneo-detail.page.html',
  styleUrl: './torneo-detail.page.css'
})
export class TorneoDetailPage implements OnInit {
  torneo: TournamentDetails | null = null;
  workerMachines: WorkerMachineAssignmentResponseDto[] = [];
  tournamentUsers: UserWithId[] = [];
  loading = true;
  error: string | null = null;

  constructor(
    private route: ActivatedRoute,
    private router: Router,
    private tournamentsService: TournamentsService,
    private usersService: UsersService,
    private cache: OfflineCacheService
  ) {}

  ngOnInit(): void {
    const id = this.route.snapshot.paramMap.get('id');
    if (!id) { this.router.navigate(['/torneos']); return; }

    // Try cache first for offline support
    const cached = this.cache.getTournamentDetail(id);
    if (cached) {
      this.torneo = cached.details;
      this.workerMachines = cached.workerMachines;
      this.tournamentUsers = cached.users;
      this.loading = false;
    }

    forkJoin([
      this.tournamentsService.getById(id),
      this.tournamentsService.getWorkers(id),
      this.usersService.getTournamentUsers(id).pipe(catchError(() => of([])))
    ]).subscribe({
      next: ([details, workers, users]) => {
        this.torneo = details;
        this.workerMachines = workers;
        this.tournamentUsers = users;
        this.loading = false;
        // Persist to cache for offline use
        this.cache.saveTournamentDetail(id, { details, workerMachines: workers, users });
      },
      error: () => {
        if (!cached) {
          this.error = 'No se pudo cargar el torneo';
        }
        this.loading = false;
      }
    });
  }

  // Click encordador → ver sus pedidos en este torneo
  goToEncorderOrders(worker: UserResponseDto): void {
    if (!this.torneo) return;
    this.router.navigate(['/pedidos'], {
      queryParams: { torneo: this.torneo.id, encordador: worker.username }
    });
  }

  get status(): 'activo' | 'pendiente' | 'cerrado' {
    if (!this.torneo) return 'cerrado';
    const now = new Date();
    const start = new Date(this.torneo.startTournament);
    const end = new Date(this.torneo.endTournament);
    if (start > now) return 'pendiente';
    if (end < now) return 'cerrado';
    return 'activo';
  }

  get durationDays(): number {
    if (!this.torneo) return 0;
    const start = new Date(this.torneo.startTournament);
    const end = new Date(this.torneo.endTournament);
    return Math.max(0, Math.ceil((end.getTime() - start.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)));
  }

  get machines(): string[] {
    return [...new Set(this.workerMachines.map(w => w.machineName))];
  }

  workersForMachine(machine: string): UserResponseDto[] {
    return this.workerMachines.filter(w => w.machineName === machine).map(w => w.user);
  }

  goBack(): void {
    this.router.navigate(['/torneos']);
  }

  formatDate(dateStr: string): string {
    if (!dateStr) return '—';
    return new Date(dateStr).toLocaleDateString('es-ES', { day: '2-digit', month: 'short', year: 'numeric' });
  }

  copyId(): void {
    if (this.torneo) {
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(this.torneo.id).catch(() => {});
    }
  }
}
````

  <!-- Stats -->
  <div class="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
    <div class="stats-card">
      <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div class="stats-label">Total</div>
        <div class="w-7 h-7 rounded-lg bg-atp-ice flex items-center justify-center">
          <svg class="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-atp-blue" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
            <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2.5" d="M9 19V6l12-3v13M9 19c0 1.105-1.343 2-3 2s-3-.895-3-2 1.343-2 3-2 3 .895 3 2zm12-3c0 1.105-1.343 2-3 2s-3-.895-3-2 1.343-2 3-2 3 .895 3 2zM9 10l12-3"/>
          </svg>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="stats-value">{{ visibleTorneos.length }}</div>
    </div>
    <div class="stats-card">
      <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div class="stats-label">Activos</div>
        <span class="status-dot success pulse"></span>
      </div>
      <div class="stats-value text-emerald-600">{{ activeCount }}</div>
    </div>
    <div class="stats-card">
      <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div class="stats-label">Pendientes</div>
        <span class="status-dot warning"></span>
      </div>
      <div class="stats-value text-amber-500">{{ visibleTorneos.filter(t => getStatus(t) === 'pendiente').length }}</div>
    </div>
    <div class="stats-card">
      <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div class="stats-label">Cerrados</div>
        <span class="status-dot idle"></span>
      </div>
      <div class="stats-value text-slate-400">{{ visibleTorneos.filter(t => getStatus(t) === 'cerrado').length }}</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- Torneos grid -->
  <div *ngIf="visibleTorneos.length > 0" class="grid md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-5">
    <div *ngFor="let t of visibleTorneos; let i = index"
         class="atp-card p-5 hover-lift cursor-pointer group relative overflow-hidden animate-rise"
         [style.animation-delay.ms]="i * 40"
         (click)="goToDetail(t)">

      <!-- Top accent bar -->
      <div class="absolute top-0 left-0 right-0 h-1"
           [class.bg-gradient-to-r]="true"
           [class.from-emerald-400]="getStatus(t) === 'activo'"
           [class.to-emerald-600]="getStatus(t) === 'activo'"
           [class.from-amber-400]="getStatus(t) === 'pendiente'"
           [class.to-amber-600]="getStatus(t) === 'pendiente'"
           [class.from-slate-300]="getStatus(t) === 'cerrado'"
           [class.to-slate-400]="getStatus(t) === 'cerrado'"></div>

      <div class="flex items-start justify-between mb-4 pt-1">
        <div class="flex-1 min-w-0">
          <div class="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1.5">
            <span class="status-dot"
              [class.success]="getStatus(t) === 'activo'"
              [class.warning]="getStatus(t) === 'pendiente'"
              [class.idle]="getStatus(t) === 'cerrado'"
              [class.pulse]="getStatus(t) === 'activo'"></span>
            <span class="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.14em]"
              [class.text-emerald-600]="getStatus(t) === 'activo'"
              [class.text-amber-600]="getStatus(t) === 'pendiente'"
              [class.text-slate-400]="getStatus(t) === 'cerrado'">{{ getStatus(t) }}</span>
          </div>
          <h3 class="text-lg font-bold text-atp-navy leading-tight tracking-tight truncate">{{ t.name }}</h3>
        </div>
        <button class="p-2 rounded-lg text-slate-300 hover:text-atp-blue hover:bg-atp-ice transition-all opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100"
                *ngIf="canCreate" (click)="$event.stopPropagation(); openEditModal(t)">
          <svg class="w-4 h-4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
            <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M15.232 5.232l3.536 3.536m-2.036-5.036a2.5 2.5 0 113.536 3.536L6.5 21.036H3v-3.572L16.732 3.732z" />
          </svg>
        </button>
      </div>

      <div class="space-y-2.5 mb-4">
        <div class="flex items-center gap-2 text-[13px] text-slate-600">
          <div class="w-7 h-7 rounded-lg bg-atp-ice flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0">
            <svg class="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-atp-blue" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
              <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M8 7V3m8 4V3m-9 8h10M5 21h14a2 2 0 002-2V7a2 2 0 00-2-2H5a2 2 0 00-2 2v12a2 2 0 002 2z" />
            </svg>
          </div>
          <span class="truncate">{{ t.startTournament }} → {{ t.endTournament }}</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="flex items-center justify-between pt-3 border-t border-slate-100">
        <span class="text-[10px] font-mono text-slate-300 truncate max-w-[140px]" title="{{ t.id }}">{{ t.id }}</span>
        <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
          <button *ngIf="canCreate" (click)="$event.stopPropagation(); deleteTorneo(t)"
                  class="text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-400 hover:text-red-600 transition-colors">
            Eliminar
          </button>
          <span class="text-[11px] font-bold text-atp-blue group-hover:translate-x-0.5 transition-transform inline-flex items-center gap-0.5">
            Ver
            <svg class="w-3 h-3" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
              <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2.5" d="M9 5l7 7-7 7"/>
            </svg>
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- Empty state -->
  <div *ngIf="visibleTorneos.length === 0" class="atp-panel p-12 text-center animate-rise">
    <div class="w-16 h-16 mx-auto rounded-2xl bg-atp-ice flex items-center justify-center mb-4">
      <svg class="w-8 h-8 text-atp-blue" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
        <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="1.5" d="M5 3v4M3 5h4M6 17v4m-2-2h4m5-16l2.286 6.857L21 12l-5.714 2.143L13 21l-2.286-6.857L5 12l5.714-2.143L13 3z"/>
      </svg>
    </div>
    <h3 class="text-lg font-bold text-atp-navy">Sin torneos aún</h3>
    <p class="text-sm text-slate-500 mt-1 max-w-sm mx-auto">{{ searchTerm ? 'No se encontraron torneos con ese criterio' : 'Crea tu primer torneo para empezar a gestionar partidos y encordadores' }}</p>
    <button *ngIf="canCreate && !searchTerm" (click)="openCreateModal()" class="empty-state-cta mt-5">
      <svg class="w-4 h-4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
        <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2.5" d="M12 4v16m8-8H4" />
      </svg>
      Crear primer torneo
    </button>
  </div>

  <!-- Create/Edit Modal -->
  <div *ngIf="showCreateModal || showEditModal" class="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
    <div class="absolute inset-0 bg-atp-navy/40 backdrop-blur-sm" (click)="closeCreateModal(); closeEditModal()"></div>
    <div class="relative bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-2xl max-w-lg w-full max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto animate-rise">

      <!-- Modal header -->
      <div class="sticky top-0 z-10 px-6 py-5 border-b border-slate-100 bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-between">
        <div>
          <div class="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-atp-blue mb-0.5">{{ showCreateModal ? 'Nuevo' : 'Editar' }}</div>
          <h3 class="text-xl font-bold text-atp-navy tracking-tight">{{ showCreateModal ? 'Crear torneo' : 'Editar torneo' }}</h3>
        </div>
        <button (click)="showCreateModal ? closeCreateModal() : closeEditModal()"
                class="p-2 rounded-lg text-slate-400 hover:text-atp-navy hover:bg-slate-50 transition-all">
          <svg class="w-5 h-5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
            <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M6 18L18 6M6 6l12 12"/>
          </svg>
        </button>
      </div>

      <form (submit)="$event.preventDefault(); showCreateModal ? createTorneo() : updateTorneo()" class="p-6 space-y-5">
        <div>
          <label class="block text-[12px] font-bold text-slate-700 mb-1.5 uppercase tracking-wider">Nombre</label>
          <input [(ngModel)]="form.name" name="name" class="input input-bordered w-full" placeholder="Ej: Roland Garros 2026" required />
        </div>

        <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
          <div>
            <label class="block text-[12px] font-bold text-slate-700 mb-1.5 uppercase tracking-wider">Fecha inicio</label>
            <input type="date" [(ngModel)]="form.startTournament" name="startTournament" class="input input-bordered w-full" required />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label class="block text-[12px] font-bold text-slate-700 mb-1.5 uppercase tracking-wider">Fecha fin</label>
            <input type="date" [(ngModel)]="form.endTournament" name="endTournament" class="input input-bordered w-full" required />
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Supervisor selector (only in create mode) -->
        <div *ngIf="showCreateModal">
          <div class="flex items-center justify-between mb-1.5">
            <label class="block text-[12px] font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase tracking-wider">Supervisores</label>
            <span *ngIf="selectedSupervisorIds.length > 0" class="badge badge-primary">{{ selectedSupervisorIds.length }} seleccionados</span>
          </div>

          <div *ngIf="supervisorsLoading" class="flex items-center gap-2 py-4 text-slate-400 text-[13px]">
            <span class="spinner spinner-sm"></span>
            Cargando supervisores...
          </div>

          <div *ngIf="!supervisorsLoading && availableSupervisors.length === 0"
               class="text-[13px] text-slate-400 py-4 px-4 bg-slate-50 rounded-xl text-center border border-dashed border-slate-200">
            No hay supervisores disponibles
          </div>

          <div *ngIf="!supervisorsLoading && availableSupervisors.length > 0"
               class="max-h-52 overflow-y-auto rounded-xl border border-slate-200 divide-y divide-slate-100 bg-white">
            <div *ngFor="let s of availableSupervisors"
                 class="flex items-center gap-3 px-3.5 py-2.5 cursor-pointer hover:bg-atp-ice/40 transition-colors"
                 [class.bg-atp-ice]="isSupervisorSelected(s.id || '')"
                 (click)="toggleSupervisor(s.id || '')">
              <div class="w-5 h-5 rounded-md border-2 flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0 transition-all"
                   [class.bg-atp-blue]="isSupervisorSelected(s.id || '')"
                   [class.border-atp-blue]="isSupervisorSelected(s.id || '')"
                   [class.border-slate-300]="!isSupervisorSelected(s.id || '')">
                <svg *ngIf="isSupervisorSelected(s.id || '')" class="w-3 h-3 text-white" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                  <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="3" d="M5 13l4 4L19 7"/>
                </svg>
              </div>
              <div class="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-gradient-to-br from-amber-400 to-amber-600 flex items-center justify-center text-white text-[11px] font-bold flex-shrink-0">
                {{ (s.name || s.username).charAt(0).toUpperCase() }}
              </div>
              <div class="min-w-0 flex-1">
                <p class="text-[13px] font-semibold text-atp-navy truncate">{{ s.name || s.username }}</p>
                <p class="text-[11px] text-slate-400 truncate">@{{ s.username }}</p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="flex gap-3 justify-end pt-4 border-t border-slate-100">
          <button (click)="showCreateModal ? closeCreateModal() : closeEditModal()" type="button" class="btn btn-ghost">Cancelar</button>
          <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary">{{ showCreateModal ? 'Crear torneo' : 'Guardar cambios' }}</button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- Details Modal (workers + supervisors) -->
  <div *ngIf="showDetailsModal && selectedDetails" class="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center">
    <div class="absolute inset-0 bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-sm" (click)="closeDetails()"></div>
    <div class="relative bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-2xl max-w-3xl w-full mx-4 p-6 animate-rise max-h-[90vh] overflow-auto">
      <div class="flex items-start justify-between mb-4">
        <div>
          <h3 class="text-xl font-bold text-atp-navy">{{ selectedDetails.name }}</h3>
          <p class="text-sm text-slate-500">{{ formatRange(selectedDetails) }}</p>
        </div>
        <button class="btn btn-sm btn-ghost rounded-full" (click)="closeDetails()">&times;</button>
      </div>

      <div class="grid md:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
        <!-- Workers -->
        <section class="space-y-3">
          <h4 class="font-semibold text-atp-navy">&#128296; Trabajadores ({{ workers.length }})</h4>
          <ul class="space-y-2 max-h-64 overflow-auto">
            <li *ngFor="let w of workers" class="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 p-2 rounded-lg bg-slate-50">
              <div class="text-sm">
                <div class="font-medium">{{ w.user.name || w.user.username }}</div>
                <div class="text-xs text-slate-500">M&aacute;quina: {{ w.machineName }}</div>
              </div>
              <button *ngIf="canManage" class="btn btn-xs btn-error rounded-full" (click)="removeWorker(w.user.username)">&times;</button>
            </li>
            <li *ngIf="workers.length === 0" class="text-sm text-slate-500 text-center py-3">Sin trabajadores asignados.</li>
          </ul>

          <div *ngIf="canManage" class="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 p-3 space-y-2">
            <p class="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600">Asignar encordador</p>
            <select [(ngModel)]="workerForm.userId" class="select select-sm select-bordered w-full">
              <option value="" disabled>-- Encordador --</option>
              <option *ngFor="let e of availableEncorders" [value]="e.id">{{ e.name || e.username }}</option>
            </select>
            <input [(ngModel)]="workerForm.machineName" class="input input-sm input-bordered w-full" placeholder="M&aacute;quina (p.ej. Machine-1)" />
            <button class="btn btn-sm btn-primary w-full" (click)="assignWorker()">A&ntilde;adir</button>
          </div>
        </section>

        <!-- Supervisors -->
        <section class="space-y-3">
          <h4 class="font-semibold text-atp-navy">&#128065;&#65039; Supervisores ({{ supervisors.length }})</h4>
          <ul class="space-y-2 max-h-64 overflow-auto">
            <li *ngFor="let s of supervisors" class="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 p-2 rounded-lg bg-slate-50">
              <div class="text-sm">
                <div class="font-medium">{{ s.name || s.username }}</div>
                <div class="text-xs text-slate-500">@{{ s.username }}</div>
              </div>
              <button *ngIf="canManage" class="btn btn-xs btn-error rounded-full" (click)="removeSupervisorFromTournament(s)">&times;</button>
            </li>
            <li *ngIf="supervisors.length === 0" class="text-sm text-slate-500 text-center py-3">Sin supervisores asignados.</li>
          </ul>

          <div *ngIf="canManage" class="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 p-3 space-y-2">
            <p class="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600">Asignar supervisor</p>
            <select [(ngModel)]="supervisorForm.supervisorId" class="select select-sm select-bordered w-full">
              <option value="" disabled>-- Supervisor --</option>
              <option *ngFor="let s of availableSupervisors" [value]="s.id">{{ s.name || s.username }}</option>
            </select>
            <button class="btn btn-sm btn-primary w-full" (click)="assignSupervisorToTournament()">A&ntilde;adir</button>
          </div>
        </section>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
