````typescript
import { Component, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms';
import { Router } from '@angular/router';
import { forkJoin } from 'rxjs';
import { catchError } from 'rxjs/operators';
import { of } from 'rxjs';
import { AuthService } from '../services/auth.service';
import { ToastService } from '../components/toast-notification/toast.service';
import {
  TournamentsService,
  TournamentItem,
  TournamentDetails,
  TournamentPatchDto,
  TournamentRequestForm,
  UserResponseDto,
  WorkerMachineAssignmentResponseDto
} from '../services/tournaments.service';
import { UsersService, UserWithId, UserProfile } from '../services/users.service';

type TournamentRequestDto = TournamentRequestForm;
type UserResponse = UserResponseDto;
type WorkerEntry = WorkerMachineAssignmentResponseDto;

@Component({
  selector: 'app-torneos-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule, FormsModule],
  templateUrl: './torneos.page.html',
  styleUrl: './torneos.page.css'
})
export class TorneosPage implements OnInit {
  searchTerm = '';
  showCreateModal = false;
  showEditModal = false;
  showDetailsModal = false;

  selectedTorneo: TournamentItem | null = null;
  selectedDetails: TournamentDetails | null = null;
  workers: WorkerEntry[] = [];
  supervisors: UserResponse[] = [];

  private toast = new ToastService();
  form: { name: string; startTournament: string; endTournament: string; logotype?: File | null; ownerId?: string } =
    { name: '', startTournament: '', endTournament: '', logotype: null, ownerId: '' };
  torneos: TournamentItem[] = [];
  owners: UserProfile[] = [];
  availableSupervisors: UserProfile[] = [];
  availableEncorders: UserProfile[] = [];
  selectedSupervisorIds: string[] = [];
  supervisorsLoading = false;
  supervisorForm: { supervisorId: string } = { supervisorId: '' };
  workerForm: { userId: string; machineName: string } = { userId: '', machineName: 'Machine-1' };

  constructor(
    private auth: AuthService,
    private tournamentsService: TournamentsService,
    private usersService: UsersService,
    private router: Router
  ) {}

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.loadTorneos();
    if (this.isAdminOrJefe) this.loadOwners();
  }

  get isOrganizador(): boolean {
    return this.auth.isOrganizador;
  }

  get isAdminOrJefe(): boolean {
    return this.auth.isAdmin || this.auth.isJefeTaller;
  }

  get canCreate(): boolean {
    return this.isAdminOrJefe || this.isOrganizador;
  }

  get canManage(): boolean {
    return this.canCreate;
  }

  get visibleTorneos(): TournamentItem[] {
    if (!this.searchTerm.trim()) return this.torneos;
    const term = this.searchTerm.toLowerCase();
    return this.torneos.filter(t => `${t.name}`.toLowerCase().includes(term));
  }

  get activeCount(): number {
    return this.visibleTorneos.filter(t => this.getStatus(t) === 'activo').length;
  }

  get pendingCount(): number {
    return this.visibleTorneos.filter(t => this.getStatus(t) === 'pendiente').length;
  }

  get closedCount(): number {
    return this.visibleTorneos.filter(t => this.getStatus(t) === 'cerrado').length;
  }

  onLogotypeSelected(event: Event): void {
    const input = event.target as HTMLInputElement;
    this.form.logotype = input.files?.[0] ?? null;
  }

  openCreateModal(): void {
    this.showCreateModal = true;
    this.resetForm();
    this.loadSupervisors();
  }

  closeCreateModal(): void {
    this.showCreateModal = false;
  }

  private loadSupervisors(): void {
    this.supervisorsLoading = true;
    this.usersService.listSupervisors({ size: 100 }).subscribe({
      next: (page) => {
        this.availableSupervisors = page.content;
        this.supervisorsLoading = false;
      },
      error: () => {
        this.availableSupervisors = [];
        this.supervisorsLoading = false;
      }
    });
  }

  toggleSupervisor(userId: string): void {
    const idx = this.selectedSupervisorIds.indexOf(userId);
    if (idx >= 0) this.selectedSupervisorIds.splice(idx, 1);
    else this.selectedSupervisorIds.push(userId);
  }

  isSupervisorSelected(userId: string): boolean {
    return this.selectedSupervisorIds.includes(userId);
  }

  createTorneo(): void {
    if (!this.validateForm()) return;
    const request: TournamentRequestForm = {
      name: this.form.name,
      startTournament: this.form.startTournament,
      endTournament: this.form.endTournament,
      logotype: this.form.logotype ?? null,
      ownerId: this.form.ownerId || undefined
    };
    const create$ = this.auth.isAdmin
      ? this.tournamentsService.create(request)
      : this.tournamentsService.ownerCreate(request);

    create$.subscribe({
      next: (created) => {
        this.torneos.unshift(created);
        if (this.selectedSupervisorIds.length > 0) {
          const assigns = this.selectedSupervisorIds.map(id =>
            this.tournamentsService.assignSupervisor(created.id, id).pipe(catchError(() => of(null)))
          );
          forkJoin(assigns).subscribe();
        }
        this.closeCreateModal();
        this.toast.success('Torneo creado', `El torneo ${this.form.name} ha sido creado.`);
        this.loadTorneos();
      },
      error: (err) => {
        const msg = err?.error?.message || err?.error || 'No se pudo crear el torneo';
        this.toast.error('Error', typeof msg === 'string' ? msg : 'No se pudo crear el torneo');
      }
    });
  }

  openEditModal(torneo: TournamentItem): void {
    this.selectedTorneo = torneo;
    this.form = {
      name: torneo.name,
      startTournament: torneo.startTournament,
      endTournament: torneo.endTournament
    };
    this.showEditModal = true;
  }

  closeEditModal(): void {
    this.showEditModal = false;
    this.selectedTorneo = null;
  }

  updateTorneo(): void {
    if (!this.selectedTorneo) return;
    const request: TournamentPatchDto = {
      name: this.form.name,
      startTournament: this.form.startTournament,
      endTournament: this.form.endTournament
    };
    this.tournamentsService.update(this.selectedTorneo.id, request).subscribe({
      next: (updated) => {
        const idx = this.torneos.findIndex(t => t.id === updated.id);
        if (idx >= 0) this.torneos[idx] = updated;
        this.closeEditModal();
        this.toast.success('Torneo actualizado', 'Los cambios han sido guardados.');
      },
      error: () => this.toast.error('Error', 'No se pudo actualizar el torneo')
    });
  }

  deleteTorneo(torneo: TournamentItem): void {
    this.tournamentsService.remove(torneo.id).subscribe({
      next: () => {
        this.torneos = this.torneos.filter(t => t.id !== torneo.id);
        this.toast.success('Torneo eliminado', `${torneo.name} ha sido eliminado.`);
      },
      error: () => this.toast.error('Error', 'No se pudo eliminar el torneo')
    });
  }

  openDetails(torneo: TournamentItem): void {
    this.selectedTorneo = torneo;
    this.tournamentsService.getById(torneo.id).pipe(
      catchError(() => of<TournamentDetails | null>(null))
    ).subscribe({
      next: (details) => {
        if (!details) {
          this.toast.error('Error', 'No se pudo cargar el detalle del torneo');
          return;
        }
        this.selectedDetails = details;
        // details.workers is UserResponseDto[]; load the machine-assignment map separately
        this.loadWorkers(details.id);
        this.supervisors = details.supervisors;
        this.showDetailsModal = true;
        this.loadAvailableHelpers();
      }
    });
  }

  closeDetails(): void {
    this.showDetailsModal = false;
    this.selectedDetails = null;
    this.workers = [];
    this.supervisors = [];
    this.workerForm = { userId: '', machineName: 'Machine-1' };
    this.supervisorForm = { supervisorId: '' };
  }

  private loadWorkers(tournamentId: string): void {
    this.tournamentsService.getWorkers(tournamentId).pipe(
      catchError(() => of([]))
    ).subscribe((list) => {
      this.workers = list;
    });
  }

  private loadAvailableHelpers(): void {
    forkJoin({
      enc: this.usersService.listEncorders({ size: 200 }).pipe(catchError(() => of({ content: [] as UserProfile[] }))),
      sup: this.usersService.listUsers({ findSupervisors: true, size: 200 }).pipe(catchError(() => of({ content: [] as UserProfile[] })))
    }).subscribe(({ enc, sup }) => {
      this.availableEncorders = enc.content as UserProfile[];
      this.availableSupervisors = sup.content as UserProfile[];
    });
  }

  assignWorker(): void {
    if (!this.selectedDetails || !this.workerForm.userId || !this.workerForm.machineName) {
      this.toast.error('Datos requeridos', 'Selecciona encordador y máquina');
      return;
    }
    this.tournamentsService.assignWorker(this.selectedDetails.id, this.workerForm.userId, this.workerForm.machineName).subscribe({
      next: (details) => {
        this.toast.success('Asignado', 'Encordador asignado al torneo');
        this.selectedDetails = details;
        this.loadWorkers(details.id);
        this.workerForm = { userId: '', machineName: 'Machine-1' };
      },
      error: () => this.toast.error('Error', 'No se pudo asignar el encordador')
    });
  }

  removeWorker(username: string): void {
    if (!this.selectedDetails) return;
    // El back espera el Ulid en el body como string plano.
    const worker = this.workers.find((w) => w.user.username === username);
    if (!worker) return;
    // No tenemos el id del usuario en la respuesta; usamos el endpoint con la lista de encordadores.
    const userProfile = this.availableEncorders.find((e) => e.username === username);
    const userId = userProfile?.id;
    if (!userId) {
      this.toast.error('Error', 'No se encontró el ID del encordador');
      return;
    }
    this.tournamentsService.removeWorker(this.selectedDetails.id, userId).subscribe({
      next: (details) => {
        this.toast.success('Eliminado', 'Encordador eliminado del torneo');
        this.selectedDetails = details;
        this.loadWorkers(details.id);
      },
      error: () => this.toast.error('Error', 'No se pudo eliminar el encordador')
    });
  }

  assignSupervisorToTournament(): void {
    if (!this.selectedDetails || !this.supervisorForm.supervisorId) {
      this.toast.error('Datos requeridos', 'Selecciona un supervisor');
      return;
    }
    this.tournamentsService.assignSupervisor(this.selectedDetails.id, this.supervisorForm.supervisorId).subscribe({
      next: (details) => {
        this.toast.success('Asignado', 'Supervisor asignado al torneo');
        this.selectedDetails = details;
        this.supervisors = details.supervisors;
        this.supervisorForm = { supervisorId: '' };
      },
      error: () => this.toast.error('Error', 'No se pudo asignar el supervisor')
    });
  }

  removeSupervisorFromTournament(user: UserResponse): void {
    if (!this.selectedDetails) return;
    const profile = this.availableSupervisors.find((s) => s.username === user.username);
    if (!profile?.id) {
      this.toast.error('Error', 'No se encontró el ID del supervisor');
      return;
    }
    this.tournamentsService.removeSupervisor(this.selectedDetails.id, profile.id).subscribe({
      next: (details) => {
        this.toast.success('Eliminado', 'Supervisor eliminado del torneo');
        this.selectedDetails = details;
        this.supervisors = details.supervisors;
      },
      error: () => this.toast.error('Error', 'No se pudo eliminar el supervisor')
    });
  }

  formatRange(t: TournamentItem | TournamentDetails): string {
    const start = this.formatDate(t.startTournament);
    const end = this.formatDate(t.endTournament);
    return `${start} - ${end}`;
  }

  private formatDate(iso: string): string {
    if (!iso) return '';
    const date = new Date(iso);
    if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return '';
    return date.toLocaleDateString('es-ES', { day: '2-digit', month: '2-digit', year: 'numeric' });
  }

  private resetForm(): void {
    this.form = { name: '', startTournament: '', endTournament: '', logotype: null, ownerId: '' };
    this.selectedSupervisorIds = [];
  }

  private validateForm(): boolean {
    return !!(this.form.name && this.form.startTournament && this.form.endTournament);
  }

  getStatus(torneo: TournamentItem): 'activo' | 'pendiente' | 'cerrado' {
    const now = new Date();
    const start = new Date(torneo.startTournament);
    const end = new Date(torneo.endTournament);
    if (start > now) return 'pendiente';
    if (end < now) return 'cerrado';
    return 'activo';
  }

  goToDetail(torneo: TournamentItem): void {
    this.router.navigate(['/torneos', torneo.id]);
  }

  private loadTorneos(): void {
    this.tournamentsService.list({ page: 0, pageSize: 100, sortBy: 'name', direction: 'asc' }).subscribe({
      next: (page) => {
        this.torneos = page.content;
      },
      error: () => this.toast.error('Error', 'No se pudieron cargar los torneos')
    });
  }

  private loadOwners(): void {
    // El back no expone filtro directo por rol OWNER; mostramos los users con rol owner usando /api/User?findEncorders=false&findSupervisors=false que devuelve OWNER incluido.
    // Como fallback se permite escribir el id manual desde admin.
    this.usersService.listUsers({ page: 0, size: 200, sortBy: 'name', direction: 'asc' }).pipe(
      catchError(() => of({ content: [] } as { content: UserProfile[] }))
    ).subscribe((page) => {
      this.owners = page.content;
    });
  }
}
````

````html
  @if (showCreateModal) {

            <input class="input input-bordered w-full" [(ngModel)]="form.telefono" placeholder="+34 600 000 000" />
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- BONO field — solo si es tenista -->
        <div *ngIf="isTenistaRoleSelected" class="p-4 rounded-xl bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200">
          <label class="block text-[12px] font-bold text-amber-800 mb-1.5 uppercase tracking-wider">Saldo inicial de bonos (€)</label>
          <input type="number" class="input input-bordered w-full bg-white" [(ngModel)]="form.bonos" min="0" step="0.01" placeholder="0" />
          <p class="mt-1.5 text-[11px] text-amber-700">Este saldo se descontará automáticamente cada vez que el tenista pague un encordado u orden de taller.</p>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="modal-footer">
        <button class="btn btn-ghost rounded-xl" (click)="closeCreate()" [disabled]="creating">Cancelar</button>
        <button class="btn btn-primary rounded-xl" (click)="submitCreate()" [disabled]="creating">
          <span *ngIf="creating" class="spinner spinner-sm"></span>
          {{ creating ? 'Creando...' : (createMode === 'encorder' ? 'Crear encordador' : 'Crear usuario') }}
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
  }

  <!-- ─────────── MODAL asignar encordador a torneo ─────────── -->
  @if (showAssignModal && assignUser) {
  <div class="modal">
    <div class="modal-backdrop" (click)="closeAssign()"></div>
    <div class="modal-card max-w-md">
      <div class="modal-header">
        <div>
          <h2 class="modal-title">Asignar a torneo / taller</h2>
          <p class="modal-subtitle">{{ assignUser.name || assignUser.username }} · @{{ assignUser.username }}</p>
        </div>
        <button class="modal-close" (click)="closeAssign()" aria-label="Cerrar">
          <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor">
            <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M6 18L18 6M6 6l12 12"/>
          </svg>
        </button>
      </div>

      <div class="modal-body space-y-4">
        <div>
          <label class="block text-[12px] font-bold text-slate-700 mb-1.5 uppercase tracking-wider">Torneo / Taller *</label>
          <select class="select select-bordered w-full" [(ngModel)]="assignTournamentId">
            <option *ngIf="torneos.length === 0" value="">Sin torneos disponibles</option>
            <option *ngFor="let t of torneos" [value]="t.id">{{ t.name }}</option>
          </select>
        </div>
        <div>
          <label class="block text-[12px] font-bold text-slate-700 mb-1.5 uppercase tracking-wider">Máquina *</label>
          <input class="input input-bordered w-full" [(ngModel)]="assignMachine" placeholder="Machine-1" />
          <p class="mt-1.5 text-[11px] text-slate-500">El encordador trabajará en esta máquina durante el torneo.</p>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="modal-footer">
        <button class="btn btn-ghost rounded-xl" (click)="closeAssign()" [disabled]="assigning">Cancelar</button>
        <button class="btn btn-primary rounded-xl" (click)="submitAssign()" [disabled]="assigning">
          <span *ngIf="assigning" class="spinner spinner-sm"></span>
          {{ assigning ? 'Asignando...' : 'Asignar' }}
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
  }

  <!-- ─────────── MODAL restaurar backup — confirmación en 4 pasos ─────────── -->

          <div class="p-4 rounded-xl bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200">

          <p *ngIf="restoringBackup" class="text-[13px] text-slate-500 flex items-center gap-2">
````

````typescript
import { Component, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms';
import { ToastService } from '../components/toast-notification/toast.service';
import { AuthService } from '../services/auth.service';
import { UsersService, UserProfile } from '../services/users.service';
import {
  AdminService,
  EncorderCreateRequest,
  AdminUserCreateRequest
} from '../services/admin.service';
import { TournamentsService, TournamentItem } from '../services/tournaments.service';
import { UserRole, ROLE_LABELS, ROLE_COLORS } from '../models/roles.model';

type CreateMode = 'admin' | 'encorder';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-usuarios-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule, FormsModule],
  templateUrl: './usuarios.page.html',
  styleUrl: './usuarios.page.css'
})
export class UsuariosPage implements OnInit {
  private toast = new ToastService();

  users: UserProfile[] = [];
  isLoading = false;
  searchTerm = '';

  // CREATE flow — flexible: admin builds any user, owner builds encordadores
  showCreateModal = false;
  creating = false;
  createMode: CreateMode = 'encorder';
  form: AdminUserCreateRequest = this.emptyAdminForm();

  // Backend roles available in dropdown
  backendRoleOptions: { value: string; label: string }[] = [
    { value: 'USER',       label: 'Tenista (Jugador)' },
    { value: 'ENCORDER',   label: 'Encordador' },
    { value: 'SUPERVISOR', label: 'Supervisor' },
    { value: 'OWNER',      label: 'Jefe de taller / Owner' },
    { value: 'ADMIN',      label: 'Administrador' }
  ];

  // ASSIGN-TO-TOURNAMENT flow (owner & admin)
  showAssignModal = false;
  assigning = false;
  assignUser: UserProfile | null = null;
  torneos: TournamentItem[] = [];
  assignTournamentId = '';
  assignMachine = '';

  // BACKUP / RESTORE (admin only)
  showBackupModal = false;
  backupStep = 0;
  backupConfirmText = '';
  backupConfirmText2 = '';
  selectedBackupFile: File | null = null;
  restoringBackup = false;
  exportingBackup = false;

  ROLE_LABELS = ROLE_LABELS;
  ROLE_COLORS = ROLE_COLORS;

  constructor(
    private usersService: UsersService,
    private adminService: AdminService,
    private tournamentsService: TournamentsService,
    public auth: AuthService
  ) {}

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.load();
    // Pre-fetch tournaments for the assign modal
    this.tournamentsService.list({ page: 0, pageSize: 100 }).subscribe({
      next: (page) => { this.torneos = page.content; },
      error: () => {}
    });
  }

  load(): void {
    this.isLoading = true;
    this.usersService.listUsers({ size: 200 }).subscribe({
      next: (page) => { this.users = page.content; this.isLoading = false; },
      error: () => { this.isLoading = false; this.toast.error('Error', 'No se pudieron cargar los usuarios'); }
    });
  }

  get filtered(): UserProfile[] {
    const term = this.searchTerm.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!term) return this.users;
    return this.users.filter(u =>
      (u.name || '').toLowerCase().includes(term) ||
      (u.username || '').toLowerCase().includes(term) ||
      (u.email || '').toLowerCase().includes(term)
    );
  }

  // ---------- Permission helpers ----------
  get canCreateAnyUser(): boolean { return this.auth.isAdmin; }
  get canCreateEncorder(): boolean { return this.auth.can('users:create_encorder'); }
  get canAssignWorker(): boolean { return this.auth.isAdmin || this.auth.role === 'owner'; }
  get canBackup(): boolean { return this.auth.can('backup:export'); }
  get canRestore(): boolean { return this.auth.can('backup:import'); }

  // ---------- CREATE user / encordador ----------
  openCreate(mode: CreateMode): void {
    this.createMode = mode;
    this.form = mode === 'admin' ? this.emptyAdminForm() : this.emptyEncorderForm();
    this.showCreateModal = true;
  }

  closeCreate(): void {
    if (this.creating) return;
    this.showCreateModal = false;
  }

  get isTenistaRoleSelected(): boolean {
    return this.createMode === 'admin' && this.form.role === 'USER';
  }

  submitCreate(): void {
    if (!this.form.username || !this.form.email || !this.form.password) {
      this.toast.error('Faltan datos', 'Usuario, email y contraseña son obligatorios');
      return;
    }
    if (this.createMode === 'admin' && !this.form.role) {
      this.toast.error('Falta el rol', 'Selecciona el rol del nuevo usuario');
      return;
    }

    this.creating = true;
    const obs = this.createMode === 'encorder'
      ? this.adminService.createEncorder(this.toEncorderRequest(this.form))
      : this.adminService.createUser(this.normalizeBonos(this.form));

    obs.subscribe({
      next: () => {
        this.creating = false;
        const label = this.createMode === 'encorder' ? 'Encordador creado' : 'Usuario creado';
        this.toast.success(label, `${this.form.username} añadido correctamente.`);
        this.closeCreate();
        this.load();
      },
      error: (err) => {
        this.creating = false;
        const msg = err?.error?.message || 'No se pudo crear el usuario';
        this.toast.error('Error', msg);
      }
    });
  }

  // ---------- ASSIGN to tournament ----------
  openAssign(user: UserProfile): void {
    if (!this.canAssignWorker) return;
    this.assignUser = user;
    this.assignTournamentId = this.torneos[0]?.id || '';
    this.assignMachine = '';
    this.showAssignModal = true;
  }

  closeAssign(): void {
    if (this.assigning) return;
    this.showAssignModal = false;
    this.assignUser = null;
  }

  submitAssign(): void {
    if (!this.assignUser?.id || !this.assignTournamentId || !this.assignMachine.trim()) {
      this.toast.error('Faltan datos', 'Selecciona torneo y escribe una máquina');
      return;
    }
    this.assigning = true;
    this.adminService.assignWorkerToTournament({
      userId: this.assignUser.id,
      tournamentId: this.assignTournamentId,
      machineName: this.assignMachine.trim()
    }).subscribe({
      next: () => {
        this.assigning = false;
        const tName = this.torneos.find(t => t.id === this.assignTournamentId)?.name || 'torneo';
        this.toast.success('Asignado', `${this.assignUser?.name || this.assignUser?.username} → ${tName} (${this.assignMachine})`);
        this.closeAssign();
      },
      error: (err) => {
        this.assigning = false;
        const msg = err?.error?.message || 'No se pudo asignar al torneo';
        this.toast.error('Error', msg);
      }
    });
  }

  // ---------- BACKUP ----------
  exportBackup(): void {
    if (!this.canBackup) return;
    if (!confirm('Vas a descargar un BACKUP COMPLETO de la base de datos. ¿Continuar?')) return;

    this.exportingBackup = true;
    this.adminService.exportBackup().subscribe({
      next: (blob) => {
        this.exportingBackup = false;
        const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        const a = document.createElement('a');
        a.href = url;
        a.download = `backup-encordados-${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 19).replace(/[:.]/g, '-')}.zip`;
        document.body.appendChild(a);
        a.click();
        document.body.removeChild(a);
        URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
        this.toast.success('Backup descargado', 'Guarda este archivo en un lugar seguro.');
      },
      error: () => {
        this.exportingBackup = false;
        this.toast.error('Error', 'No se pudo generar el backup');
      }
    });
  }

  openBackupImport(event: Event): void {
    if (!this.canRestore) return;
    const input = event.target as HTMLInputElement;
    const file = input.files?.[0];
    input.value = '';
    if (!file) return;
    this.selectedBackupFile = file;
    this.backupStep = 1;
    this.backupConfirmText = '';
    this.backupConfirmText2 = '';
    this.showBackupModal = true;
  }

  closeBackupModal(): void {
    if (this.restoringBackup) return;
    this.showBackupModal = false;
    this.backupStep = 0;
    this.selectedBackupFile = null;
    this.backupConfirmText = '';
    this.backupConfirmText2 = '';
  }

  advanceBackupStep(): void {
    if (this.backupStep === 1) {
      this.backupStep = 2;
    } else if (this.backupStep === 2) {
      this.backupStep = 3;
    } else if (this.backupStep === 3) {
      if (this.backupConfirmText.trim() === 'ELIMINAR TODO') {
        this.backupStep = 4;
      } else {
        this.toast.error('Texto incorrecto', 'Debes escribir exactamente: ELIMINAR TODO');
      }
    } else if (this.backupStep === 4) {
      if (this.backupConfirmText2.trim().toLowerCase() === 'confirmo') {
        this.executeRestore();
      } else {
        this.toast.error('Texto incorrecto', 'Debes escribir exactamente: confirmo');
      }
    }
  }

  private executeRestore(): void {
    if (!this.selectedBackupFile) return;
    this.restoringBackup = true;
    this.adminService.importBackup(this.selectedBackupFile).subscribe({
      next: () => {
        this.restoringBackup = false;
        this.toast.success('Restauración completada', 'La base de datos ha sido restaurada.');
        this.closeBackupModal();
        this.load();
      },
      error: (err) => {
        this.restoringBackup = false;
        const msg = err?.error?.message || 'No se pudo restaurar el backup. La BD puede estar en estado inconsistente.';
        this.toast.error('Error crítico', msg);
      }
    });
  }

  // ---------- Helpers ----------
  initial(name: string | undefined): string {
    return (name || '?').charAt(0).toUpperCase();
  }

  inferRole(user: UserProfile): UserRole {
    const backend = (user.role || '').toUpperCase();
    if (backend === 'ADMIN') return 'admin';
    if (backend === 'OWNER') return 'owner';
    if (backend === 'SUPERVISOR') return 'supervisor';
    if (backend === 'ENCORDER') return 'encordador';
    if (backend === 'USER') return 'tenista';

    const u = (user.username || '').toLowerCase();
    if (u.includes('admin')) return 'admin';
    if (u.includes('owner') || u.includes('jefe')) return 'owner';
    if (u.includes('superv')) return 'supervisor';
    if (u.includes('encord') || u.includes('string')) return 'encordador';
    if (u.includes('organiz')) return 'organizador';
    return 'tenista';
  }

  isEncorder(user: UserProfile): boolean {
    return this.inferRole(user) === 'encordador';
  }

  private toEncorderRequest(req: AdminUserCreateRequest): EncorderCreateRequest {
    return {
      username: req.username,
      email: req.email,
      password: req.password,
      name: req.name,
      telefono: req.telefono
    };
  }

  private normalizeBonos(req: AdminUserCreateRequest): AdminUserCreateRequest {
    // Bonos only sent when role is USER (tenista)
    if (req.role === 'USER') {
      return { ...req, bonos: Number(req.bonos) || 0 };
    }
    const { bonos, ...rest } = req;
    return rest as AdminUserCreateRequest;
  }

  private emptyAdminForm(): AdminUserCreateRequest {
    return { username: '', email: '', password: '', name: '', telefono: '', role: 'USER', bonos: 0 };
  }

  private emptyEncorderForm(): AdminUserCreateRequest {
    return { username: '', email: '', password: '', name: '', telefono: '', role: 'ENCORDER' };
  }
}
````

````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { HttpClient, HttpParams } from '@angular/common/http';
import { Observable, of, switchMap, map, catchError, throwError } from 'rxjs';
import { API_URL } from './api.config';

export interface EncorderCreateRequest {
  username: string;
  email: string;
  password: string;
  name?: string;
  telefono?: string;
}

export interface AdminUserCreateRequest {
  username: string;
  email: string;
  password: string;
  name?: string;
  telefono?: string;
  role: string;          // 'ADMIN' | 'OWNER' | 'SUPERVISOR' | 'ENCORDER' | 'USER'
  bonos?: number;        // only meaningful for USER/tenista
}

export interface AssignWorkerRequest {
  tournamentId: string;
  userId: string;
  machineName: string;
}

interface AuthResponseDto {
  token: string;
  user: { id: string; username: string; email: string; role: string; createdAt: string };
}

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class AdminService {
  constructor(private http: HttpClient) {}

  // ----------------------------------------------------------------
  // USER CREATION
  // ----------------------------------------------------------------
  /**
   * Owner crea encordador en dos pasos:
   *  1) POST /api/Auth/signup → crea usuario base con rol USER
   *  2) POST /api/User/create-encoder con el id devuelto → lo promueve a ENCORDER
   */
  createEncorder(req: EncorderCreateRequest): Observable<unknown> {
    return this.http.post<AuthResponseDto>(`${API_URL}/Auth/signup`, {
      username: req.username,
      email: req.email,
      password: req.password
    }).pipe(
      switchMap((authRes) => {
        const id = authRes.user?.id;
        if (!id) return throwError(() => new Error('No se obtuvo id del usuario creado'));
        // Promueve el usuario a encordador y, si se dieron, actualiza datos opcionales
        const promote$ = this.http.post(`${API_URL}/User/create-encoder`, JSON.stringify(id), {
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }
        });
        return promote$;
      })
    );
  }

  /**
   * Admin crea cualquier usuario:
   *  1) POST /api/Auth/signup → crea usuario base (rol USER por defecto)
   *  2) Si role !== 'USER': POST /api/User/{id}/roles con el rol elegido
   *  3) Si role === 'USER' y bonos > 0: POST /api/User/{id}/bonos
   */
  createUser(req: AdminUserCreateRequest): Observable<unknown> {
    return this.http.post<AuthResponseDto>(`${API_URL}/Auth/signup`, {
      username: req.username,
      email: req.email,
      password: req.password
    }).pipe(
      switchMap((authRes) => {
        const id = authRes.user?.id;
        if (!id) return throwError(() => new Error('No se obtuvo id del usuario creado'));

        // Si el rol no es USER, asignarlo
        if (req.role && req.role !== 'USER') {
          return this.assignRoleRequest(id, req.role).pipe(
            switchMap(() => this.applyExtras(id, req))
          );
        }
        // Si es USER y trae bonos, añadirlos
        return this.applyExtras(id, req);
      })
    );
  }

  private applyExtras(userId: string, req: AdminUserCreateRequest): Observable<unknown> {
    if (req.role === 'USER' && req.bonos && req.bonos > 0) {
      return this.addBonos(userId, req.bonos);
    }
    return of({});
  }

  private assignRoleRequest(id: string, role: string): Observable<unknown> {
    return this.http.post(`${API_URL}/User/${id}/roles`, JSON.stringify(role), {
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }
    });
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------------
  // BONOS (solo Owner/Admin pueden añadir)
  // ----------------------------------------------------------------
  /** Suma `cantidad` al saldo de bonos del usuario (POST /api/User/{id}/bonos) */
  addBonos(userId: string, cantidad: number): Observable<unknown> {
    return this.http.post(`${API_URL}/User/${userId}/bonos`, cantidad, {
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }
    });
  }

  /** Descuento = añadir cantidad negativa. Devuelve nuevo saldo si el backend lo retorna. */
  discountBonos(userId: string, amount: number, _reference?: string): Observable<{ bonos: number }> {
    if (amount <= 0) return of({ bonos: 0 });
    return this.http.post<any>(`${API_URL}/User/${userId}/bonos`, -Math.abs(amount), {
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }
    }).pipe(
      map((res) => ({ bonos: typeof res?.bonos === 'number' ? res.bonos : 0 }))
    );
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------------
  // ASIGNAR ENCORDADOR A TORNEO
  // ----------------------------------------------------------------
  assignWorkerToTournament(req: AssignWorkerRequest): Observable<unknown> {
    return this.http.patch(`${API_URL}/Tournaments/add-worker/${req.tournamentId}`, {
      userId: req.userId,
      machineName: req.machineName
    });
  }

  removeWorkerFromTournament(tournamentId: string, userId: string): Observable<unknown> {
    return this.http.patch(`${API_URL}/Tournaments/remove-worker/${tournamentId}`, JSON.stringify(userId), {
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }
    });
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------------
  // EXCEL: paths reales del backend
  // ----------------------------------------------------------------
  /** Supervisor: GET /api/Excel/export/{tournamentId}  →  xlsx */
  exportExcelSupervisor(tournamentId: string): Observable<Blob> {
    return this.http.get(`${API_URL}/Excel/export/${tournamentId}`, { responseType: 'blob' });
  }

  /** Owner/Admin: GET /api/Excel/advanced/export?tournamentId=X[&types=...]  →  xlsx */
  exportExcelAdmin(tournamentId: string, types?: string[]): Observable<Blob> {
    let params = new HttpParams().set('tournamentId', tournamentId);
    if (types && types.length) params = params.set('types', types.join(','));
    return this.http.get(`${API_URL}/Excel/advanced/export`, { params, responseType: 'blob' });
  }

  /** Owner/Admin: POST /api/Excel/advanced/import (multipart file + tournamentId query) */
  importExcel(file: File, tournamentId: string, types?: string[]): Observable<unknown> {
    const fd = new FormData();
    fd.append('file', file);
    let params = new HttpParams().set('tournamentId', tournamentId);
    if (types && types.length) params = params.set('types', types.join(','));
    return this.http.post(`${API_URL}/Excel/advanced/import`, fd, { params });
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------------
  // BACKUP de BD (solo admin)
  // ----------------------------------------------------------------
  /** GET /api/Export */
  exportBackup(): Observable<Blob> {
    return this.http.get(`${API_URL}/Export`, { responseType: 'blob' });
  }

  /** POST /api/Export/import (multipart file=.zip) */
  importBackup(file: File): Observable<unknown> {
    const fd = new FormData();
    fd.append('file', file);
    return this.http.post(`${API_URL}/Export/import`, fd);
  }
}
````

````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { HttpClient, HttpParams } from '@angular/common/http';
import { Observable, BehaviorSubject } from 'rxjs';
import { map, tap } from 'rxjs/operators';

import { API_URL } from './api.config';

export interface AuthResponse {
  token: string;
  expiresIn: number;
}

export interface UserDto {
  username: string;
  email: string;
  phoneNumber: string;
  imageUrl: string;
  name: string;

export interface TournamentDto {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  startDate: string;
  endDate: string;
  place: string;
  category: string;
  type: string;
}

export interface PageResponse<T> {
  content: T[];
  totalPages: number;
  totalElements: number;
  pageSize: number;
  pageNumber: number;
  totalPageElements: number;
  sortBy: string;
  direction: string;
}

@Injectable({
  providedIn: 'root'
})
export class ApiService {
  private tokenKey = 'atp_token';
  private tokenSubject = new BehaviorSubject<string | null>(this.getToken());

  constructor(private http: HttpClient) {}

  get token$(): Observable<string | null> {
    return this.tokenSubject.asObservable();
  }

  private getToken(): string | null {
    return localStorage.getItem(this.tokenKey);
  }

  private setToken(token: string): void {
    localStorage.setItem(this.tokenKey, token);
    this.tokenSubject.next(token);
  }

  clearToken(): void {
    localStorage.removeItem(this.tokenKey);
    this.tokenSubject.next(null);
  }

  isLoggedIn(): boolean {
    return !!this.getToken();
  }

  private getAuthHeaders(): { [header: string]: string } {
    const token = this.getToken();
    return token ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } : {};
  }

  signin(username: string, password: string): Observable<any> {
    return this.http.post<any>(`${API_URL}/Auth/signin`, { username, password })
      .pipe(tap(res => {
        this.setToken(res.token);
      }));
  }

  signup(data: { email: string; password: string; username: string }): Observable<any> {
    return this.http.post<any>(`${API_URL}/Auth/signup`, data)
      .pipe(tap(res => {
        this.setToken(res.token);
      }));
  }

  logout(): void {
    this.clearToken();
  }

  getMe(): Observable<UserDto> {
    return this.http.get<UserDto>(`${API_URL}/User/me`, {
      headers: this.getAuthHeaders()
    });
  }

  getEncorders(page = 0, size = 50, search = ''): Observable<any> {
    let params = new HttpParams()
      .set('page', page.toString())
      .set('size', size.toString());
    if (search) params = params.set('search', search);

    return this.http.get<any>(`${API_URL}/User/encorders`, {
      headers: this.getAuthHeaders(),
      params
    });
  }

  getUsers(page = 0, size = 50, search = ''): Observable<any> {
    let params = new HttpParams()
      .set('findUsers', 'true')
      .set('page', page.toString())
      .set('size', size.toString());
    if (search) params = params.set('search', search);

    return this.http.get<any>(`${API_URL}/User`, {
      headers: this.getAuthHeaders(),
      params
    });
  }

  getTournaments(page = 0, pageSize = 20, search = ''): Observable<any> {
    let params = new HttpParams()
      .set('page', page.toString())
      .set('pageSize', pageSize.toString());
    if (search) params = params.set('search', search);

    return this.http.get<any>(`${API_URL}/Tournaments`, {
      headers: this.getAuthHeaders(),
      params
    });
  }

  getTournamentById(id: number): Observable<any> {
    return this.http.get<any>(`${API_URL}/Tournaments/${id}`, {
      headers: this.getAuthHeaders()
    });
  }

  getTournamentByName(name: string): Observable<any> {
    return this.http.get<any>(`${API_URL}/Tournaments/name/${name}`, {
      headers: this.getAuthHeaders()
    });
  }
}
````

````typescript
import { HttpErrorResponse, HttpInterceptorFn } from '@angular/common/http';
import { inject } from '@angular/core';
import { Router } from '@angular/router';
import { catchError } from 'rxjs/operators';
import { throwError } from 'rxjs';
import { AuthService } from './auth.service';

export const authInterceptor: HttpInterceptorFn = (req, next) => {
  const auth = inject(AuthService);
  const router = inject(Router);
  const token = auth.token;

  const headers: Record<string, string> = {};
  if (token) {
    headers['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${token}`;
  }
  // El backend tiene RespectBrowserAcceptHeader=true + ReturnHttpNotAcceptable=true
  // y registra formatters XML; sin Accept: application/json puede devolver XML o 406.
  if (!req.headers.has('Accept')) {
    headers['Accept'] = 'application/json';
  }

  const authReq = Object.keys(headers).length ? req.clone({ setHeaders: headers }) : req;

  return next(authReq).pipe(
    catchError((error: HttpErrorResponse) => {
      if (error.status === 401) {
        auth.logout();
        router.navigate(['/login']);
      }
      // 403 is handled at component level — don't redirect globally
      return throwError(() => error);
    })
  );
};
````

````typescript
interface AuthUserDto {
  id: string;
  username: string;
  email: string;
  role: string;
  createdAt: string;
}

interface AuthResponseDto {
  token: string;
  user: AuthUserDto;
}

interface UserProfileDto {
  username: string;
  imageUrl: string;
  name: string;
  bonos?: number;
}

@Injectable({
  providedIn: 'root'
})
export class AuthService {
  private state: AuthState = { user: null, token: null };

  constructor(private http: HttpClient) {
    this.loadFromStorage();
  }

  private loadFromStorage(): void {
    try {
      const storedUser = localStorage.getItem('atp_user');
      const storedToken = localStorage.getItem('atp_token');
      if (storedUser && storedToken) {
        this.state = {
          user: JSON.parse(storedUser),
          token: storedToken
        };
      }
    } catch {
      this.logout();
    }
  }

  private saveToStorage(): void {
    if (this.state.user) {
      localStorage.setItem('atp_user', JSON.stringify(this.state.user));
    } else {
      localStorage.removeItem('atp_user');
    }
    if (this.state.token) {
      localStorage.setItem('atp_token', this.state.token);
    } else {
      localStorage.removeItem('atp_token');
    }
  }

  login(username: string, password: string): Observable<{ success: boolean; user?: AppUser; error?: string }> {
    return this.http.post<AuthResponseDto>(`${API_URL}/Auth/signin`, { Username: username, Password: password }).pipe(
      map((response) => {
        const user = this.mapAuthUser(response.user);
        this.state = { user, token: response.token };
        this.saveToStorage();
        return { success: true, user };
      }),
      catchError((error: HttpErrorResponse) => {
        const message = error.error?.message || 'Credenciales incorrectas';
        return of({ success: false, error: message });
      })
    );
  }

  signup(username: string, email: string, password: string): Observable<{ success: boolean; user?: AppUser; error?: string }> {
    return this.http.post<AuthResponseDto>(`${API_URL}/Auth/signup`, { Username: username, Email: email, Password: password }).pipe(
      map((response) => {
        const user = this.mapAuthUser(response.user);
        this.state = { user, token: response.token };
        this.saveToStorage();
        return { success: true, user };
      }),
      catchError((error: HttpErrorResponse) => {
        const message = error.error?.message || 'No se pudo completar el registro';
        return of({ success: false, error: message });
      })
    );
  }

  logout(): void {
    this.state = { user: null, token: null };
    localStorage.removeItem('atp_user');
    localStorage.removeItem('atp_token');
  }

  refreshProfile(): Observable<AppUser | null> {
    if (!this.state.user) return of(null);
    return this.http.get<UserProfileDto>(`${API_URL}/User/me`).pipe(
      map((profile) => {
        const updated: AppUser = {
          ...this.state.user!,
          username: profile.username || this.state.user!.username,
          imageUrl: profile.imageUrl || this.state.user!.imageUrl,
          name: profile.name || this.state.user!.name
        };
        this.state = { ...this.state, user: updated };
        this.saveToStorage();
        return updated;
      }),
      catchError(() => of(this.state.user))
    );
  }

  get isAuthenticated(): boolean {
    return !!this.state.token && !!this.state.user;
  }

  get token(): string | null {
    return this.state.token;
  }

  get user(): AppUser | null {
    return this.state.user;
  }

  get role(): UserRole | null {
    return this.state.user?.role || null;
  }

  can(permission: string): boolean {
    if (!this.state.user) return false;
    return hasPermission(this.state.user.role, permission);
  }

  hasRole(roles: UserRole[]): boolean {
    if (!this.state.user) return false;
    return roles.includes(this.state.user.role);
  }

  get isAdmin(): boolean {
    return this.state.user?.role === 'admin';
  }

  get isJefeTaller(): boolean {
    return this.state.user?.role === 'jefe_taller' || this.state.user?.role === 'owner';
  }

  get isOrganizador(): boolean {
    return this.state.user?.role === 'organizador' || this.state.user?.role === 'owner';
  }

  get isTenista(): boolean {
    return this.state.user?.role === 'tenista';
  }

  get isSupervisor(): boolean {
    return this.state.user?.role === 'supervisor' || this.state.user?.role === 'owner';
  }

  get isEncordador(): boolean {
    return this.state.user?.role === 'encordador';
  }

  // NUEVO: Solicitar cambio de contraseña (envía email de recuperacion)
  requestPasswordChange(email: string): Observable<{ success: boolean; error?: string }> {
    return this.http.post<void>(`${API_URL}/Auth/change-password-request`, JSON.stringify(email), {
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }
    }).pipe(
      map(() => ({ success: true })),
      catchError((error: HttpErrorResponse) => {
        return of({ success: false, error: error.error?.message || 'No se pudo procesar la solicitud' });
      })
    );
  }

  // NUEVO: Cambiar contraseña con token
  changePassword(token: string, newPassword: string): Observable<{ success: boolean; error?: string }> {
    return this.http.post<void>(`${API_URL}/Auth/change-password/${token}`, JSON.stringify(newPassword), {
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }
    }).pipe(
      map(() => ({ success: true })),
      catchError((error: HttpErrorResponse) => {
        return of({ success: false, error: error.error?.message || 'No se pudo cambiar la contraseña' });
      })
    );
  }

  private mapBackendRole(role: string): UserRole {
    switch ((role || '').toUpperCase()) {
      case 'ADMIN':    return 'admin';
      case 'ENCORDER': return 'encordador';
      case 'OWNER':    return 'owner';
      case 'SUPERVISOR': return 'supervisor';
      case 'USER':
      default:         return 'tenista';
    }
  }

  private mapAuthUser(user: AuthUserDto): AppUser {
    const mappedRole = this.mapBackendRole(user.role);
    return {
      id: user.id,
      username: user.username,
      email: user.email,
      phoneNumber: '',
      imageUrl: '',
      name: user.username,
      role: mappedRole,
      backendRole: user.role,
      createdAt: user.createdAt
    };
  }
}
````

````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { HttpClient, HttpParams } from '@angular/common/http';
import { Observable } from 'rxjs';
import { map } from 'rxjs/operators';
import { API_URL } from './api.config';
import { PageResponse } from '../models/api.model';

interface CuerdaResponseDto {
  id: number;
  tournamentId: string;
  marca: string;
  modelo: string;
  stock: number;
  precio: number;
  stringFormat: string;
  stringsType: string;
}

export interface CuerdaItem {
  id: string;
  brand: string;
  model: string;
  stock: number;
  price: number;
  stringFormat: string;
  stringsType: string;
}

export interface CuerdaRequestDto {
  marca: string;
  tournamentId: string;
  modelo: string;
  stock: number;
  precio: number;
  stringFormat: string;
  stringsType: string;
}

export interface CuerdaPatchDto {
  marca?: string;
  modelo?: string;
  stock?: number;
  precio?: number;
  stringFormat?: string;
  stringsType?: string;
}

@Injectable({
  providedIn: 'root'
})
export class CuerdasService {
  constructor(private http: HttpClient) {}

  list(params: { page?: number; size?: number; sortBy?: string; direction?: string; search?: string; tournamentId?: string } = {}): Observable<PageResponse<CuerdaItem>> {
    let httpParams = new HttpParams()
      .set('page', (params.page ?? 0).toString())
      .set('size', (params.size ?? 10).toString())
      .set('sortBy', params.sortBy ?? 'id')
      .set('direction', params.direction ?? 'asc');

    if (params.search) {
      httpParams = httpParams.set('search', params.search);
    }

    if (params.tournamentId) {
      httpParams = httpParams.set('tournamentId', params.tournamentId);
    }

    return this.http.get<PageResponse<CuerdaResponseDto>>(`${API_URL}/Cuerdas`, { params: httpParams }).pipe(
      map((page) => ({
        ...page,
        content: page.content.map((dto) => this.mapCuerda(dto))
      }))
    );
  }

  getById(id: number): Observable<CuerdaItem> {
    return this.http.get<CuerdaResponseDto>(`${API_URL}/Cuerdas/${id}`).pipe(
      map((dto) => this.mapCuerda(dto))
    );
  }

  getByName(name: string): Observable<CuerdaItem> {
    return this.http.get<CuerdaResponseDto>(`${API_URL}/Cuerdas/name/${encodeURIComponent(name)}`).pipe(
      map((dto) => this.mapCuerda(dto))
    );
  }

  create(request: CuerdaRequestDto): Observable<CuerdaItem> {
    return this.http.post<CuerdaResponseDto>(`${API_URL}/Cuerdas`, request).pipe(
      map((dto) => this.mapCuerda(dto))
    );
  }

  update(id: number, request: CuerdaPatchDto): Observable<CuerdaItem> {
    return this.http.put<CuerdaResponseDto>(`${API_URL}/Cuerdas/${id}`, request).pipe(
      map((dto) => this.mapCuerda(dto))
    );
  }

  remove(id: number): Observable<void> {
    return this.http.delete<void>(`${API_URL}/Cuerdas/${id}`);
  }

  private mapCuerda(dto: CuerdaResponseDto): CuerdaItem {
    return {
      id: dto.id.toString(),
      brand: dto.marca,
      model: dto.modelo,
      stock: dto.stock,
      price: dto.precio,
      stringFormat: dto.stringFormat,
      stringsType: dto.stringsType
    };
  }
}
````

````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { HttpClient, HttpParams } from '@angular/common/http';
import { Observable } from 'rxjs';
import { API_URL } from './api.config';

export interface ExcelImportResultDto {
  imported: number;
  errors: string[];
  updated: number;
}

@Injectable({
  providedIn: 'root'
})
export class ExcelService {
  constructor(private http: HttpClient) {}

  // Exportar datos de un torneo a Excel
  exportTournament(tournamentId: string): Observable<Blob> {
    return this.http.get(`${API_URL}/Excel/export/${tournamentId}`, {
      responseType: 'blob'
    });
  }

  // Exportacion avanzada (múltiples tipos de datos)
  exportAdvanced(tournamentId: string, types: string[]): Observable<Blob> {
    let params = new HttpParams().set('tournamentId', tournamentId);
    types.forEach(t => {
      params = params.append('types', t);
    });
    return this.http.get(`${API_URL}/Excel/advanced/export`, {
      params,
      responseType: 'blob'
    });
  }

  // Importar datos desde Excel
  importAdvanced(tournamentId: string, types: string[], file: File): Observable<ExcelImportResultDto> {
    const formData = new FormData();
    formData.append('file', file);
    
    let params = new HttpParams().set('tournamentId', tournamentId);
    types.forEach(t => {
      params = params.append('types', t);
    });

    return this.http.post<ExcelImportResultDto>(`${API_URL}/Excel/advanced/import`, formData, { params });
  }
}
````

````typescript
import { Injectable, signal, computed } from '@angular/core';

export interface KeyboardShortcut {
	key: string;
	ctrl?: boolean;
	shift?: boolean;
	alt?: boolean;
	action: () => void;
	description: string;
}

@Injectable({
	providedIn: 'root'
})
export class KeyboardService {
	private shortcuts = signal<KeyboardShortcut[]>([]);
	private globalSearchOpen = signal(false);

	readonly isGlobalSearchOpen = computed(() => this.globalSearchOpen());

	constructor() {
		this.setupGlobalListeners();
	}

	register(shortcut: KeyboardShortcut): void {
		this.shortcuts.update(s => [...s, shortcut]);
	}

	unregister(key: string, ctrl = false): void {
		this.shortcuts.update(s => s.filter(shortcut => 
			!(shortcut.key === key && shortcut.ctrl === ctrl)
		));
	}

	toggleGlobalSearch(): void {
		this.globalSearchOpen.update(v => !v);
	}

	openGlobalSearch(): void {
		this.globalSearchOpen.set(true);
	}

	closeGlobalSearch(): void {
		this.globalSearchOpen.set(false);
	}

	private setupGlobalListeners(): void {
		if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;

		window.addEventListener('keydown', (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
			const ctrl = event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey;
			const shift = event.shiftKey;
			const alt = event.altKey;
			const key = event.key.toLowerCase();

			if (ctrl && key === 'k') {
				event.preventDefault();
				this.toggleGlobalSearch();
				return;
			}

			if (key === 'escape' && this.globalSearchOpen()) {
				event.preventDefault();
				this.closeGlobalSearch();
				return;
			}

			if (ctrl && key === 'n') {
				event.preventDefault();
				this.triggerAction('new');
				return;
			}

			if (ctrl && key === 's') {
				event.preventDefault();
				this.triggerAction('save');
				return;
			}

			if (ctrl && key === 'f') {
				event.preventDefault();
				this.triggerAction('search');
				return;
			}

			if (ctrl && shift && key === 'z') {
				event.preventDefault();
				this.triggerAction('undo');
				return;
			}

			if (ctrl && key === 'b') {
				event.preventDefault();
				this.triggerAction('bulk');
				return;
			}

			if (ctrl && key === 'e') {
				event.preventDefault();
				this.triggerAction('export');
				return;
			}

			if (key === 'f' && !ctrl) {
				const active = document.activeElement;
				if (active?.tagName !== 'INPUT' && active?.tagName !== 'TEXTAREA') {
					event.preventDefault();
					this.triggerAction('search');
				}
			}
		});
	}

	private triggerAction(action: string): void {
		const shortcuts = this.shortcuts();
		const found = shortcuts.find(s => s.key === action);
		if (found) {
			found.action();
		}
	}
}
````

````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { HttpClient, HttpParams } from '@angular/common/http';
import { Observable } from 'rxjs';
import { map } from 'rxjs/operators';
import { API_URL } from './api.config';
import { PageResponse } from '../models/api.model';
import { MaterialCategory, MaterialItem } from '../models/material.model';

interface MaterialResponseDto {
  id: number;
  tournamentId: string;
  marca: string;
  modelo: string;
  stock: number;
  precio: number;
  materialType: string;
}

export interface MaterialRequestDto {
  marca: string;
  tournamentId: string;
  modelo: string;
  stock: number;
  precio: number;
  type: string;
}

export interface MaterialPatchDto {
  marca?: string;
  modelo?: string;
  stock?: number;
  precio?: number;
  type?: string;
}

@Injectable({
  providedIn: 'root'
})
export class MaterialsService {
  constructor(private http: HttpClient) {}

  list(params: { page?: number; size?: number; sortBy?: string; direction?: string; search?: string; tournamentId?: string } = {}): Observable<PageResponse<MaterialItem>> {
    let httpParams = new HttpParams()
      .set('page', (params.page ?? 0).toString())
      .set('size', (params.size ?? 10).toString())
      .set('sortBy', params.sortBy ?? 'id')
      .set('direction', params.direction ?? 'asc');

    if (params.search) {
      httpParams = httpParams.set('search', params.search);
    }
    if (params.tournamentId) {
      httpParams = httpParams.set('tournamentId', params.tournamentId);
    }

    return this.http.get<PageResponse<MaterialResponseDto>>(`${API_URL}/Materials`, { params: httpParams }).pipe(
      map((page) => ({
        ...page,
        content: page.content.map((dto) => this.mapMaterial(dto))
      }))
    );
  }

  getById(id: number): Observable<MaterialItem> {
    return this.http.get<MaterialResponseDto>(`${API_URL}/Materials/${id}`).pipe(
      map((dto) => this.mapMaterial(dto))
    );
  }

  getByName(name: string): Observable<MaterialItem> {
    return this.http.get<MaterialResponseDto>(`${API_URL}/Materials/name/${encodeURIComponent(name)}`).pipe(
      map((dto) => this.mapMaterial(dto))
    );
  }

  /** POST /api/Materials (RequireAdminRole) */
  create(request: MaterialRequestDto): Observable<MaterialItem> {
    return this.http.post<MaterialResponseDto>(`${API_URL}/Materials`, request).pipe(
      map((dto) => this.mapMaterial(dto))
    );
  }

  update(id: number, request: MaterialPatchDto): Observable<MaterialItem> {
    return this.http.put<MaterialResponseDto>(`${API_URL}/Materials/${id}`, request).pipe(
      map((dto) => this.mapMaterial(dto))
    );
  }

  remove(id: number): Observable<void> {
    return this.http.delete<void>(`${API_URL}/Materials/${id}`);
  }

  private mapMaterial(dto: MaterialResponseDto): MaterialItem {
    return {
      id: dto.id.toString(),
      category: this.mapMaterialType(dto.materialType),
      name: dto.modelo,
      brand: dto.marca,
      model: dto.modelo,
      color: '',
      price: dto.precio,
      stock: dto.stock,
      minStock: 5,
      description: '',
      imageUrl: ''
    };
  }

  private mapMaterialType(type: string): MaterialCategory {
    const normalized = (type || '').toLowerCase();
    const map: Record<string, MaterialCategory> = {
      raqueta: 'raqueta',
      cordaje: 'cordaje',
      grip: 'grip',
      overgrip: 'overgrip',
      antivibrador: 'antivibrador',
      bolsa: 'bolsa',
      calzado: 'calzado',
      ropa: 'ropa',
      pelotas: 'pelotas',
      accesorio: 'accesorio',
      herramienta: 'herramienta'
    };

    return map[normalized] ?? 'accesorio';
  }
}
````

````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import {
  TournamentDetails,
  WorkerMachineAssignmentResponseDto
} from './tournaments.service';
import { UserWithId } from './users.service';

export interface TournamentDetailCache {
  details: TournamentDetails;
  workerMachines: WorkerMachineAssignmentResponseDto[];
  users: UserWithId[];
  savedAt: number;
}

const TOURNAMENT_KEY = (id: string) => `atp_cache_tournament_${id}`;
const ENCORDERS_KEY = 'atp_cache_encorders';
const MACHINES_KEY = 'atp_cache_machines';
const WORKER_MACHINE_KEY = 'atp_cache_worker_machine_map';

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class OfflineCacheService {

  // Tournament detail (used by torneo-detail and nuevo-pedido offline)
  saveTournamentDetail(id: string, payload: Omit<TournamentDetailCache, 'savedAt'>): void {
    try {
      const data: TournamentDetailCache = { ...payload, savedAt: Date.now() };
      localStorage.setItem(TOURNAMENT_KEY(id), JSON.stringify(data));

      // Also store encordadores and máquinas globally for offline new-pedido
      const allEncorders = payload.workerMachines.map(w => ({
        username: w.user.username,
        name: w.user.name,
        imageUrl: w.user.imageUrl,
        machineName: w.machineName
      }));
      const existing = this.getEncorders();
      const merged = this.mergeEncorders(existing, allEncorders);
      localStorage.setItem(ENCORDERS_KEY, JSON.stringify(merged));

      const allMachines = Array.from(new Set(payload.workerMachines.map(w => w.machineName).filter(Boolean)));
      const existingMachines = this.getMachines();
      const mergedMachines = Array.from(new Set([...existingMachines, ...allMachines]));
      localStorage.setItem(MACHINES_KEY, JSON.stringify(mergedMachines));

      // worker → machine mapping for auto-fill on nuevo pedido
      const map = this.getWorkerMachineMap();
      for (const w of payload.workerMachines) {
        if (w.user?.username && w.machineName) {
          map[w.user.username] = w.machineName;
        }
      }
      localStorage.setItem(WORKER_MACHINE_KEY, JSON.stringify(map));
    } catch {
      // ignore quota errors
    }
  }

  getTournamentDetail(id: string): TournamentDetailCache | null {
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(TOURNAMENT_KEY(id));
      if (!raw) return null;
      return JSON.parse(raw) as TournamentDetailCache;
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }

  // Cached encordadores list (offline fallback)
  getEncorders(): { username: string; name: string; imageUrl?: string; machineName?: string }[] {
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(ENCORDERS_KEY);
      if (!raw) return [];
      return JSON.parse(raw);
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  }

  // Cached machines list (offline fallback)
  getMachines(): string[] {
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(MACHINES_KEY);
      if (!raw) return [];
      return JSON.parse(raw);
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  }

  getWorkerMachineMap(): Record<string, string> {
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(WORKER_MACHINE_KEY);
      if (!raw) return {};
      return JSON.parse(raw);
    } catch {
      return {};
    }
  }

  machineForWorker(username: string): string | null {
    const map = this.getWorkerMachineMap();
    return map[username] || null;
  }

  get isOnline(): boolean {
    return typeof navigator !== 'undefined' ? navigator.onLine : true;
  }

  private mergeEncorders(
    a: { username: string; name: string; imageUrl?: string; machineName?: string }[],
    b: { username: string; name: string; imageUrl?: string; machineName?: string }[]
  ) {
    const byUsername = new Map<string, typeof a[number]>();
    for (const item of [...a, ...b]) {
      if (item.username) byUsername.set(item.username, item);
    }
    return Array.from(byUsername.values());
  }
}
````

````typescript
import { Injectable, signal, computed } from '@angular/core';
import { HttpClient } from '@angular/common/http';
import { liveQuery } from 'dexie';
import { firstValueFrom } from 'rxjs';
import { offlineDB, SyncJob, tablesForResource } from '../offline/offline-db';

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class OfflineSyncService {
  private readonly _online = signal<boolean>(typeof navigator !== 'undefined' ? navigator.onLine : true);
  private readonly _pending = signal<number>(0);
  private readonly _syncing = signal<boolean>(false);
  private initialized = false;

  readonly online = this._online.asReadonly();
  readonly pending = this._pending.asReadonly();
  readonly syncing = this._syncing.asReadonly();
  readonly status = computed(() => this._online() ? 'online' : 'offline');

  constructor(private http: HttpClient) {}

  init(): void {
    if (this.initialized) return;
    this.initialized = true;

    window.addEventListener('online', () => {
      this._online.set(true);
      void this.drainQueue();
    });
    window.addEventListener('offline', () => this._online.set(false));

    liveQuery(() => offlineDB.syncQueue.count()).subscribe({
      next: (count) => this._pending.set(count)
    });

    if (this._online()) {
      void this.drainQueue();
    }
  }

  async enqueue(job: Omit<SyncJob, 'id' | 'createdAt' | 'attempts'>): Promise<number> {
    const id = await offlineDB.syncQueue.add({
      ...job,
      createdAt: Date.now(),
      attempts: 0
    });
    if (this._online()) {
      void this.drainQueue();
    }
    return id as number;
  }

  async drainQueue(): Promise<void> {
    if (this._syncing()) return;
    if (!this._online()) return;
    this._syncing.set(true);
    try {
      // Process jobs sequentially in creation order
      // eslint-disable-next-line no-constant-condition
      while (true) {
        const jobs = await offlineDB.syncQueue.orderBy('createdAt').limit(1).toArray();
        if (jobs.length === 0) break;
        const job = jobs[0];
        const ok = await this.runJob(job);
        if (!ok) break;
      }
    } finally {
      this._syncing.set(false);
    }
  }

  private async runJob(job: SyncJob): Promise<boolean> {
    try {
      const opts: any = { observe: 'body' };
      if (job.headers) opts.headers = job.headers;
      let resp: any;
      switch (job.method) {
        case 'POST':
          resp = await firstValueFrom(this.http.post(job.url, job.body, opts));
          break;
        case 'PUT':
          resp = await firstValueFrom(this.http.put(job.url, job.body, opts));
          break;
        case 'PATCH':
          resp = await firstValueFrom(this.http.patch(job.url, job.body, opts));
          break;
        case 'DELETE':
          resp = await firstValueFrom(this.http.delete(job.url, opts));
          break;
      }

      // If this was a temp create, replace tempId in cache with real id
      if (job.tempId && resp && typeof resp === 'object') {
        await this.replaceTempInCache(job.resource, job.tempId, resp);
      }

      await offlineDB.syncQueue.delete(job.id!);
      return true;
    } catch (err: any) {
      const status: number | undefined = err?.status;
      const isNetwork = !status || status === 0;
      const attempts = (job.attempts ?? 0) + 1;

      if (isNetwork) {
        this._online.set(navigator.onLine);
        await offlineDB.syncQueue.update(job.id!, { attempts, lastError: 'network' });
        return false;
      }

      // Server rejected the change. After several attempts, drop it so the queue does not block.
      await offlineDB.syncQueue.update(job.id!, { attempts, lastError: `HTTP ${status ?? '?'}` });
      if (attempts >= 5) {
        await offlineDB.syncQueue.delete(job.id!);
        console.warn('[OfflineSync] Job dropped after 5 attempts', job);
        return true;
      }
      return false;
    }
  }

  private async replaceTempInCache(resource: SyncJob['resource'], tempId: string, real: any): Promise<void> {
    const realId = real?.id ?? real?.Id ?? null;
    if (!realId) return;
    const tables = tablesForResource(resource);
    if (!tables) return;

    const tempKey = String(tempId);
    const realKey = String(realId);

    await offlineDB.transaction('rw', tables.entity, tables.list, async () => {
      await tables.entity.delete(tempKey);
      await tables.entity.put({ key: realKey, data: real, updatedAt: Date.now() });

      const lists = await tables.list.toArray();
      for (const list of lists) {
        const items = (list.items as any[]) ?? [];
        const idx = items.findIndex((it) => String(it?.id ?? it?.Id) === tempKey);
        if (idx >= 0) {
          items[idx] = real;
          await tables.list.put({ ...list, items, updatedAt: Date.now() });
        }
      }
    });
  }

  /** Forzar una sincronización manual. */
  async syncNow(): Promise<void> {
    await this.drainQueue();
  }

  /** Borra toda la caché offline y la cola. Útil al cerrar sesión. */
  async clearAll(): Promise<void> {
    await Promise.all([
      offlineDB.pedidos.clear(),
      offlineDB.pedidosList.clear(),
      offlineDB.materials.clear(),
      offlineDB.materialsList.clear(),
      offlineDB.cuerdas.clear(),
      offlineDB.cuerdasList.clear(),
      offlineDB.tournaments.clear(),
      offlineDB.tournamentsList.clear(),
      offlineDB.users.clear(),
      offlineDB.usersList.clear(),
      offlineDB.genericCache.clear(),
      offlineDB.syncQueue.clear(),
      offlineDB.meta.clear()
    ]);
  }
}
````

````typescript
import { HttpEvent, HttpHandlerFn, HttpRequest, HttpResponse } from '@angular/common/http';
import { inject } from '@angular/core';
import { Observable, from, of, catchError, switchMap, tap } from 'rxjs';

import { API_URL } from './api.config';
import { OfflineSyncService } from './offline-sync.service';
import { offlineDB, detectResource, tablesForResource } from '../offline/offline-db';

function isApi(url: string): boolean {
  return url.startsWith(API_URL);
}

function listKey(url: string): string {
  // Strip the API base so the key is short and stable per query
  return url.startsWith(API_URL) ? url.slice(API_URL.length) : url;
}

function isCollectionResponse(body: any): boolean {
  return body && typeof body === 'object' && Array.isArray(body.content) && typeof body.totalElements !== 'undefined';
}

function extractId(body: any): string | null {
  if (!body || typeof body !== 'object') return null;
  const id = body.id ?? body.Id;
  return id != null ? String(id) : null;
}

function genTempId(): string {
  return `tmp_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`;
}

export const offlineInterceptor = (req: HttpRequest<unknown>, next: HttpHandlerFn): Observable<HttpEvent<unknown>> => {
  if (!isApi(req.url)) {
    return next(req);
  }

  // Never intercept auth endpoints - login/signup must hit the network.
  if (/\/Auth(\/|$)/i.test(req.url)) {
    return next(req);
  }

  const sync = inject(OfflineSyncService);
  const resource = detectResource(req.url);
  const tables = tablesForResource(resource);

  // ---- GET: network first, fall back to cache; cache on success ----
  if (req.method === 'GET') {
    return next(req).pipe(
      tap((event) => {
        if (event instanceof HttpResponse && event.status >= 200 && event.status < 300) {
          void cacheGetResponse(req.url, resource, event.body);
        }
      }),
      catchError((err) => {
        const status = err?.status ?? 0;
        if (status !== 0) {
          // Real HTTP error - bubble up
          throw err;
        }
        // Network error -> try cache
        return from(readCache(req.url, resource)).pipe(
          switchMap((cached) => {
            if (cached === null) {
              throw err;
            }
            return of(new HttpResponse({ status: 200, body: cached, url: req.url }));
          })
        );
      })
    );
  }

  // ---- Mutations ----
  const method = req.method.toUpperCase();
  if (method === 'POST' || method === 'PUT' || method === 'PATCH' || method === 'DELETE') {
    return next(req).pipe(
      tap((event) => {
        if (event instanceof HttpResponse && event.status >= 200 && event.status < 300) {
          void applyMutationToCache(method, req.url, resource, req.body, event.body);
        }
      }),
      catchError((err) => {
        const status = err?.status ?? 0;
        if (status !== 0) {
          // Real server error, don't queue
          throw err;
        }
        // Offline: enqueue and return optimistic response
        return from(handleOfflineMutation(method, req.url, resource, req.body, req.headers.keys().reduce((acc, k) => {
          const v = req.headers.get(k);
          if (v != null) acc[k] = v;
          return acc;
        }, {} as Record<string, string>), sync)).pipe(
          switchMap((body) => of(new HttpResponse({ status: 200, body, url: req.url })))
        );
      })
    );
  }

  return next(req);
};

async function applyMutationToCache(
  method: 'POST' | 'PUT' | 'PATCH' | 'DELETE',
  url: string,
  resource: ReturnType<typeof detectResource>,
  _reqBody: any,
  respBody: any
): Promise<void> {
  const tables = tablesForResource(resource);
  if (!tables) return;
  const now = Date.now();

  if (method === 'DELETE') {
    const m = url.match(/\/([^/?]+)(?:\?|$)/);
    const id = m ? decodeURIComponent(m[1]) : null;
    if (id) {
      await offlineDB.transaction('rw', tables.entity, tables.list, async () => {
        await tables.entity.delete(id);
        const lists = await tables.list.toArray();
        for (const list of lists) {
          const items = (list.items as any[]).filter((it) => String(it?.id ?? it?.Id) !== id);
          await tables.list.put({ ...list, items, total: Math.max((list.total ?? items.length) - 1, items.length), updatedAt: now });
        }
      });
    }
    return;
  }

  const id = extractId(respBody);
  if (!id || !respBody) return;
  await offlineDB.transaction('rw', tables.entity, tables.list, async () => {
    await tables.entity.put({ key: id, data: respBody, updatedAt: now });
    if (method === 'POST') {
      const lists = await tables.list.toArray();
      for (const list of lists) {
        const items = [respBody, ...(list.items as any[])];
        await tables.list.put({ ...list, items, total: (list.total ?? items.length - 1) + 1, updatedAt: now });
      }
    } else {
      const lists = await tables.list.toArray();
      for (const list of lists) {
        const items = (list.items as any[]).map((it) => (String(it?.id ?? it?.Id) === id ? respBody : it));
        await tables.list.put({ ...list, items, updatedAt: now });
      }
    }
  });
}

async function cacheGetResponse(url: string, resource: ReturnType<typeof detectResource>, body: any): Promise<void> {
  const tables = tablesForResource(resource);
  const now = Date.now();
  if (!tables) {
    await offlineDB.genericCache.put({ key: listKey(url), data: body, updatedAt: now });
    return;
  }
  if (isCollectionResponse(body)) {
    await offlineDB.transaction('rw', tables.list, tables.entity, async () => {
      await tables.list.put({ key: listKey(url), items: body.content, total: body.totalElements, updatedAt: now });
      // Also index each item by id
      for (const item of body.content) {
        const id = extractId(item);
        if (id) {
          await tables.entity.put({ key: id, data: item, updatedAt: now });
        }
      }
    });
  } else {
    const id = extractId(body);
    if (id) {
      await tables.entity.put({ key: id, data: body, updatedAt: now });
    } else {
      await offlineDB.genericCache.put({ key: listKey(url), data: body, updatedAt: now });
    }
  }
}

async function readCache(url: string, resource: ReturnType<typeof detectResource>): Promise<any | null> {
  const tables = tablesForResource(resource);
  const key = listKey(url);

  if (!tables) {
    const cached = await offlineDB.genericCache.get(key);
    return cached?.data ?? null;
  }

  // Try as a list/collection first
  const list = await tables.list.get(key);
  if (list) {
    return {
      content: list.items,
      totalElements: list.total,
      totalPages: 1,
      pageSize: list.items.length,
      pageNumber: 0,
      totalPageElements: list.items.length,
      sortBy: 'id',
      direction: 'asc'
    };
  }

  // Try as a single entity by trailing id in URL
  const m = url.match(/\/([^/?]+)(?:\?|$)/);
  const tail = m ? decodeURIComponent(m[1]) : null;
  if (tail) {
    const ent = await tables.entity.get(tail);
    if (ent) return ent.data;
  }

  return null;
}

async function handleOfflineMutation(
  method: 'POST' | 'PUT' | 'PATCH' | 'DELETE',
  url: string,
  resource: ReturnType<typeof detectResource>,
  body: any,
  headers: Record<string, string>,
  sync: OfflineSyncService
): Promise<any> {
  const tables = tablesForResource(resource);
  const now = Date.now();
  let tempId: string | undefined;
  let optimistic: any = body;

  if (tables) {
    if (method === 'POST') {
      tempId = genTempId();
      optimistic = { ...(body as object), id: tempId, _offlineTemp: true, createdAt: new Date(now).toISOString(), updatedAt: new Date(now).toISOString() };
      await offlineDB.transaction('rw', tables.entity, tables.list, async () => {
        await tables.entity.put({ key: tempId!, data: optimistic, updatedAt: now });
        const lists = await tables.list.toArray();
        for (const list of lists) {
          const items = [optimistic, ...(list.items as any[])];
          await tables.list.put({ ...list, items, total: (list.total ?? items.length - 1) + 1, updatedAt: now });
        }
      });
    } else if (method === 'PUT' || method === 'PATCH') {
      const idMatch = url.match(/\/([^/?]+)(?:\?|$)/);
      const id = idMatch ? decodeURIComponent(idMatch[1]) : null;
      if (id) {
        const prev = await tables.entity.get(id);
        const merged = { ...(prev?.data as object ?? {}), ...(body as object), id, updatedAt: new Date(now).toISOString(), _offlinePending: true };
        optimistic = merged;
        await offlineDB.transaction('rw', tables.entity, tables.list, async () => {
          await tables.entity.put({ key: id, data: merged, updatedAt: now });
          const lists = await tables.list.toArray();
          for (const list of lists) {
            const items = (list.items as any[]).map((it) => (String(it?.id ?? it?.Id) === id ? merged : it));
            await tables.list.put({ ...list, items, updatedAt: now });
          }
        });
      }
    } else if (method === 'DELETE') {
      const idMatch = url.match(/\/([^/?]+)(?:\?|$)/);
      const id = idMatch ? decodeURIComponent(idMatch[1]) : null;
      if (id) {
        await offlineDB.transaction('rw', tables.entity, tables.list, async () => {
          await tables.entity.delete(id);
          const lists = await tables.list.toArray();
          for (const list of lists) {
            const items = (list.items as any[]).filter((it) => String(it?.id ?? it?.Id) !== id);
            await tables.list.put({ ...list, items, total: Math.max((list.total ?? items.length) - 1, items.length), updatedAt: now });
          }
        });
        optimistic = null;
      }
    }
  }

  await sync.enqueue({
    method,
    url,
    body,
    headers,
    resource,
    tempId
  });

  return optimistic;
}
````
